# Ordinary spells — first playtest packet

**Provisional spell development.** This packet adds individual operational specifications to preserved source spells. It does not replace the approved books or live companion catalog.

[Development roadmap](DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md) · [Spell integration rules](SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md) · [All classes](CLASS_PLAYTEST_INDEX.md) · [Data](../../data/public/spell_playtests/catalog.json) · [Unfinished queue](../../data/public/spell_playtests/incomplete_queue.json)

**276 drafted spells; 572 still awaiting operational review.** All 848 source IDs and 936 placements are retained.

Counts refer to stable spell identities, not closure of every source variant. [Unassigned variant register](SPELL_VARIANT_REVIEW_STATUS.json) preserves separately unfinished placement decisions.

A catalog record alone is not a playable spell. Only entries marked operational in this packet are available for this test configuration. Class spell cards remain usable under their own printed rules. Known/prepared counts, school access and class-level gates still apply.

## Source reconciliation

The companion catalog leaves four fields unspecified for every spell. Core V2 does supply additional blocks, but 817 of its 936 entries say “Automatic or opposed as described.” Both sources are preserved per record. Eleven potential historical name changes are comparison evidence, not silent merges. Core V2 owns common RP costs; class-specific ranks come from the catalog. Exact targets, timing, component interpretation, limits and any changed values below are explicitly playtest proposals.

### Arcane Ward

**ID:** `arcane-ward` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you can see within 30 feet, including yourself | Until the start of your next regular turn |

**Resolution:** None. The chosen target gains the AC bonus after this Action resolves.

The target gains +1 AC until the start of your next regular turn.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Repeated Arcane Ward effects on one creature do not stack; keep the later expiry. It cannot retroactively change a resolved attack. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest under the integration rules. Refrain still applies.

### Dispel Minor

**ID:** `dispel-minor` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One ongoing magical effect created by a rank-0 spell, or one harmless cosmetic magical effect, that you can perceive within range | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** None. If the target is eligible, the selected ongoing effect ends immediately.

End one ongoing rank-0 spell effect or harmless cosmetic magical effect. This can end a cantrip-created light, minor illusion, temporary magical mark, minor ward, or equivalent ongoing rank-0 effect.

<a id="spell-resonance-shield"></a>

### Resonance Shield

**ID:** `resonance-shield` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within 30 feet | Until the temporary HP are lost or you complete a long rest |

**Resolution:** None.

In addition to the class-specific rank cost and any Dissonance surcharge, spend 1 RP. Roll 1d4; the chosen creature gains that many temporary HP. It keeps the higher of these or its existing temporary HP; they never add together.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** The additional 1 RP conversion cost is mandatory. Temporary HP never restore real HP and cannot generate resources when gained or lost. Recasting requires a new paid cast and roll; keep the higher remaining amount. Rank is class-specific, so this spell is not necessarily a cantrip for every class. If the Core source placement matching the class-specific school and rank includes F, an existing class casting focus is additionally required.

**Design decisions:** Conference decision: use the rank-0 1d4 effect plus mandatory1RP as the provisional single-ID rule. Retain all variants: rank0 catalog/Core1d4; rank2 catalog5tempHP perRP; rank2 Core2tempHP perRP. Rank2 alternatives are preserved as evidence, not cumulative effects or optional upgrades. Use Core30ft range and placement-specific focus requirement. Temporary HP end on next long rest; no fixed5 buff.

### Shield

**ID:** `shield` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reaction — when the chosen creature is targeted by an attack roll or Magic Missile, before the attack or damage resolves | 30 ft | Self or one willing creature you can perceive within 30 feet | Until the start of your next regular turn |

**Resolution:** None. Re-evaluate the triggering attack against the chosen creature's increased AC; negate Magic Missile damage to that creature while the spell lasts.

The chosen creature gains +5 AC until the start of your next regular turn. During the same duration, Magic Missile cannot deal damage to that creature.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Does not protect against saving-throw effects, attacks that already resolved, or other automatically hitting effects unless explicitly named Magic Missile. Multiple Shield casts do not stack. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

<a id="spell-alarm-ward"></a>

### Alarm Ward

**ID:** `alarm-ward` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One fixed 10-foot-radius ground area centered on a point you can perceive within range; choose up to 3 creatures when cast that will not trigger it | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** None.

Ward the chosen area. The first time each round a Tiny-or-larger creature not excluded when cast enters the area, the ward emits a magical chime audible to you and creatures within 60 feet of the ward. The chime identifies that the ward triggered but not the intruder's identity or exact statistics.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Only one Alarm Ward from you may exist at a time; recasting ends the previous ward. Total cover does not prevent a creature physically entering the ward from triggering it, but teleportation that never occupies the ward does not trigger it. The ward cannot distinguish intent, alignment, disguise, or hidden identity and cannot reveal protected or secret facts beyond physical entry. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Core Action and one-minute concentration restored; the first draft eight-hour duration was rejected. Alarm is a separate catalog spell.

<a id="spell-sanctuary"></a>

### Sanctuary

**ID:** `sanctuary` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing living creature you can perceive within range | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** The first time on each attacker's turn that it attempts a direct attack against the warded creature, the attacker makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On success it may attack normally and does not save again against this Sanctuary during that turn. On failure that specific attack cannot target the warded creature; the attacker may choose another legal target for the same attack.

Ward one creature against direct attacks. Attackers that fail the required Wisdom save must redirect that attack to another legal target or forgo that specific attack.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Does not block area effects, environmental hazards, effects that do not target the warded creature directly, or attacks from creatures immune to this ward. Sanctuary ends immediately if the warded creature intentionally deals damage or forces a hostile creature to make a saving throw. It never compels belief or allegiance and does not remove an attacker's entire Action unless no legal alternative exists. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. This is defensive target restriction, not permission to impose another whole-Action denial: on a failed save the attacker may choose a legal different target or a different Action if its Action has not otherwise resolved.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions.

<a id="spell-repelling-pulse"></a>

### Repelling Pulse

**ID:** `repelling-pulse` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | One Small or Tiny creature you can perceive, or one discrete unattended and unsecured object no larger than Small and no heavier than 10 pounds, within range. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** A creature makes a Strength save against your spell DC: failure permits the push; success means no movement. Eligible objects move automatically.

A creature that fails its Strength save, or an eligible object, is pushed up to 5 feet directly away from you. Stop before solid terrain or an illegally occupied space.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Worn, held, attached, restrained, locked or secured objects are ineligible. Ordinary ground, table or shelf support alone does not make an otherwise movable object ineligible. No chain push, Prone, disarm, free attack or collision damage. Removing support begins ordinary Falling; this spell adds no impact damage. Known/prepared access, class level, legal components, line of effect, payment, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic level scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 5 feet, V/S, instantaneous and 5-foot push. NEW: Small/Tiny creature interpretation, 10-pound object ceiling, Strength save, custody and collision rules. Ground-support clarification is an explicit provisional clarification.

| Eligible class | Rank | Earliest class level | Base RP |

<a id="spell-warding-gesture"></a>

### Warding Gesture

**ID:** `warding-gesture` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within range, including yourself. | If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual source-start phase through initiative changes. If applied outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends. Ends earlier when consumed. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting; no spell attack or saving throw.

The target gains advantage on its next saving throw caused by a spell or an effect explicitly classified as magical. Consume the benefit after that qualifying save, regardless of success, failure or advantage from another source.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** A target has only one pending Warding Gesture across all casters. Recasting replaces the older pending benefit and its concentration dependency; it never stores an extra save. Nonmagical hazards and ordinary weapon effects do not qualify. If no qualifying save occurs, the benefit expires when its concentration or duration ends. Known/prepared access, class level, legal components, line of effect, payment, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic level scaling. A replacement is a new application with its own endpoint. An expiration or consumption event belonging to an older application cannot remove the current replacement. Replacing Warding Gesture ends the old effect and releases that old casting's concentration dependency. The new casting owns only its own concentration dependency.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, concentration 1 minute, M/F interpreted as the class focus and next magical-save advantage. NEW: one willing target rather than self-only reading of gain, exact eligibility, all-caster replacement and consumption.

<a id="spell-fortify-object"></a>

### Fortify Object

**ID:** `fortify-object` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One discrete Small-or-smaller object you can perceive within range, with actual structural HP or a defined integer Integrity-stage record. Its current custodian must be willing if worn, held or carried. | If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's first future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual marker through initiative changes. If applied outside initiative, expires 6 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when consumed. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting; no spell attack or saving throw.

When you cast this spell, choose one damage track the target actually possesses: structural HP or Integrity. The first later damage event that would cause a positive loss on that track is modified after the object's ordinary defenses. For structural HP, reduce that event's structural-HP damage by 2, minimum 0. For Integrity, reduce the number of Integrity stages that event would cause the object to lose by 1, minimum 0. Then consume the ward. It never modifies both tracks from one casting.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** No HP, temporary HP, repair, healing, maximum HP, AC, resistance, permanence, charges, ammunition or immunity is granted. A packet already reduced to 0 by ordinary defenses does not consume the ward; a positive packet reduced to 0 by this ward does. No protection against routine time-based wear or non-damage costs. One pending Fortify Object per object across all casters; later casting replaces the ward rather than queuing reductions. An undefined object damage track cannot be invented by the spell. Known/prepared access, class level, legal components, line of effect, payment, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic level scaling. A replacement is a new application with its own endpoint. An expiration or consumption event belonging to an older application cannot remove the current replacement. A target possessing neither actual structural HP nor a defined Integrity track is ineligible. If it possesses both, choose one at casting. An otherwise two-stage loss becomes one stage; an otherwise one-stage loss becomes zero. This prevents loss rather than repairing afterward.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action,30 feet,V/S and temporarily strengthening a small object. NEW CONFLICT RULING: one-source-round, one-event ward replaces Instantaneous metadata. Choose the native track at casting: prevent 2 structural-HP damage or 1 Integrity stage of damage-caused loss. These are separate provisional ward values, not unit conversions. The staged integrity 0..3 table is preserved as source evidence; the spell does not promote the whole equipment system.

<a id="spell-repel-vermin"></a>

### Repel Vermin

**ID:** `repel-vermin` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | Self; ordinary eligible vermin within a 30-foot avoidance field. | If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual source-start phase through initiative changes. If applied outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting; no spell attack or saving throw.

Ordinary natural nonmagical insects and rodents no larger than Small do not willingly move closer to you. When already nearby and free to choose movement, they prefer a safe unobstructed route farther away.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Summons, transformed creatures, trained companions, controlled or magical creatures, internal parasites and creatures currently participating in an encounter as combatants are ineligible. No creature must enter hazards or barriers, abandon necessary shelter, Dash or spend an Action to flee. It may remain if no safe route exists. No Charmed/Frightened, attack prevention, summon dismissal, disease cure, parasite expulsion or immunity to bites/contamination. Known/prepared access, class level, legal components, line of effect, payment, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic level scaling. Merely possessing a stat block or recorded statistics does not make a nuisance animal a combatant. If it genuinely joins combat as a combatant, this spell stops governing its behavior while it participates.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action,30 feet,V/S,1 minute and ordinary insects/rodents avoiding you. NEW: Self-centered field, no concentration, natural nuisance-only eligibility and safe voluntary behavior. A creature participating as a combatant is excluded, regardless of whether its incidental statistics were previously written down.

<a id="spell-warding-mark"></a>

### Warding Mark

**ID:** `warding-mark` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One fixed solid surface or ground point you can perceive within range. | If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual source-start phase through initiative changes. If applied outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting; no spell attack or saving throw.

Place one visible magical mark. Choose one named species/template genuinely known to the caster and represented by a current source-authorized creature record, or one exact canonical creature type/tag defined by current operational source data. The mark glows while at least one creature whose current canonical mechanical record matches that descriptor is within 10 feet of it with line of effect.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Do not infer or invent creature taxonomy. With no explicit matching record, it does not guess. Walls and closed barriers block triggering. Teleportation counts when the creature actually occupies the area. The mark directly reports only presence, not which creature, square, identity, disguise, alignment, statistics, intent or lore. Recasting uses normal concentration replacement. Dispel Minor may end this ongoing rank-0 mark when legally targeted. Known/prepared access, class level, legal components, line of effect, payment, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic level scaling. Matching does not infer a record from apparent shape, disguise, name, reputation, guessed ancestry or Director-only identity. Appearance-only changes do not alter matching descriptors. A transformation changes a species/type/tag only if its exact source expressly changes that record; current Druid and bounded spell-form profile names create no new creature types. If an exact source changes a canonical descriptor, use that current changed record while it lasts. Ordinary observers may draw reasonable mundane conclusions from the binary glow.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action,30 feet,V/S/F,concentration 1 minute and a mark glowing for creature types. NEW: fixed surface,10 foot trigger, one exact descriptor, current presence with line of effect, no inferred taxonomy and no extra information. A viewer may make ordinary deductions from the visible binary result; the spell does not prevent reasoning.

<a id="spell-protective-sphere"></a>

### Protective Sphere

**ID:** `protective-sphere` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 10 ft | One fixed point you can perceive within range and line of effect; a stationary sphere extends 10 feet in every direction from it. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal placement. The boundary cannot initially intersect a Tiny or Small creature's occupied space; such creatures may start wholly inside or outside. No creature is displaced or damaged on creation.

The boundary blocks physical projectiles and Tiny/Small creatures crossing in either direction. Physical projectiles are discrete objects fired, thrown, launched or explicitly propelled as projectiles. They stop at the boundary and then obey ordinary gravity. Medium or larger creatures can cross normally with their worn, held and carried objects; carrying a Tiny/Small creature does not bypass that creature's boundary restriction.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Rays, beams, gas, sound, ordinary falling debris and non-projectile spell effects are not blocked. This grants no cover, concealment, structural support, floor, platform or one-way firing privilege. NEW REVIEWED CLARIFICATION: unsupported ordinary Falling crosses the boundary without being arrested or creating support; the restriction cannot suspend a creature in midair. Walking, flying, jumping or carried/forced bodily travel otherwise obeys the size restriction. The stationary boundary does not follow its caster. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 10-foot casting range, 10-foot radius, V/S/F and concentration 1 minute. NEW: fixed geometry, two-way crossing, explicit projectile/custody and initial-overlap rules. Falling exception reconciles no support with Small-creature boundary blocking.

<a id="spell-dispel-resonance"></a>

### Dispel Resonance

**ID:** `dispel-resonance` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One perceptible ongoing magical effect created by a rank-0 or rank-1 spell within range and line of effect. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** Automatic for an eligible effect; no spell attack, save or opposed check.

End the selected ongoing effect. Eligibility uses its original generating cast's actual recorded spell rank, using that caster's class placement when class-cast, not its RP cost or your own access rank. Ending an effect invokes only that effect's ordinary end procedure and releases only its own dependencies.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Does not end permanent enchantments, magic items, class engines, creature traits, instantaneous effects or historical consequences, or effects expressly protected from dispelling. It cannot dispel an unknown-rank effect by guessing. Core's Tier 1 is resolved here as spell rank 1, not a multi-rank character tier. A perception effect that reports only unspecified magic presence does not identify a selectable individual effect. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast. A curse is eligible only if it is itself an otherwise eligible ongoing rank-0/1 spell effect; permanent curses and expressly protected effects are not dispellable here.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous, one low-rank magical effect. NEW CONFLICT RULING: catalog's 1st level governs the ambiguous Core Tier 1; exact ongoing-effect eligibility and generating-cast rank.

### Binding Circle

**ID:** `binding-circle` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |

| Action | 5 ft | One fixed point on solid ground or another approximately horizontal immobile solid surface that can contain the 5-foot-radius circle, within range and line of effect. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal placement; no saving throw. The circular boundary cannot initially intersect the occupied space of a creature it would affect.

Create a visible 5-foot-radius circle with a boundary extending 10 feet vertically above its surface. Creatures with an explicit current source-authorized extraplanar record or tag cannot physically cross that boundary. They can move normally wholly inside or outside and retain their legal Actions, attacks and magic.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** No creature type is inferred from species name, apparent form, ancestry, faction or guessed lore. Other creatures, objects, projectiles, spells and attacks are not blocked. The boundary is a finite side wall with no magical cap or floor: travel wholly above or below it is outside this spell. Teleportation or planar relocation does not physically cross the wall and is not prevented. It causes no damage, forced relocation, Action loss, magic suppression or support. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 5-foot casting range and extraplanar-crossing restriction; M/F uses the existing focus alternative. NEW CONFLICT RULING: source's ambiguous 5-foot circle is a 5-foot radius with 10-foot vertical boundary; ongoing concentration 1 minute replaces Instantaneous metadata. Initial placement, exact-tag and relocation rules are provisional.

**ID:** `detect-poison` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

Divination rank 0: learn only whether the selected creature or object currently contains or is affected by an explicit poison record. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Neither mode reports dose, save DC, severity, onset, duration, cure or unrelated medical conditions. Divination never reports poison type or identity; ordinary deductions from an authorized result remain possible.

**Resolution:** Automatic for eligible objects; no spell attack or saving throw.

Push each eligible object up to 5 feet directly away from you, stopping before solid terrain or an illegal occupied space. The pulse grants no collision damage. Loss of support starts ordinary Falling.

**Scaling:** None. The preserved rank-6 variant is not an upgrade or selectable mode.

**Limits:** Cannot move creatures or objects worn, held, attached, restrained, locked or secured. Ordinary ground, table or shelf support alone does not secure an object. No chain pushes, disarm, projectile interception or retroactive interruption of an already resolving attack. Current class-access records all grant the rank-1 object pulse; the distinct rank-6 creature/Charisma-save source placement remains preserved and pending its own access/operational review. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: rank-1 small-object pulse, Action, 5 feet, V/S/F and instantaneous. NEW: 10-pound ceiling, Small size, 5-foot displacement and custody/obstacle limits. CONFLICT RULING: rank-6 creature approach prohibition supplies no power to the rank-1 entry.

<a id="spell-warding-bond"></a>

### Warding Bond

**ID:** `warding-bond` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing ally other than yourself, perceived within range and line of effect. Neither participant may already participate in another Warding Bond, as caster or protected ally. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends. Also ends if either participant dies. Reaching 0 HP alone is not a separate ending condition; ordinary Incapacitated/concentration rules still apply. |

**Resolution:** Automatic on legal casting. On each eligible positive incoming damage packet to the ally, apply the mandatory post-defense transfer described below; a rounded-zero transfer claims no transfer operation.

The ally gains +1 AC and +1 to saves, subject separately to the strongest applicable flat bonus. After the ally's defenses and legal prevention, before temporary HP, transfer floor(remaining damage / 2) to you and leave the remainder on the ally. Keep the damage type. Your transferred share skips a second mitigation/prevention stage and cannot transfer again; apply your temporary HP, HP, applicable life-state protections, Wounds and concentration consequences normally. The ally retains the hit, failed-save, critical and attached-rider identity; you were not hit and did not fail that save merely because damage transferred.

**Scaling:** None. The rank-2 duplicate grants no upgrade or extra effect.

**Limits:** Use DAMAGE_SHARING_PLAYTEST.md: one transfer operation per original-recipient damage root, across all owners. A prior pre-mitigation split preempts this transfer; competing positive mandatory post-defense claims are chosen by the original target. The retained ally portion cannot subsequently be transferred again after this split. Complete the current packet's split and life consequences before concentration failure caused by that packet ends the bond; never undo a committed share. One Warding Bond per participating creature across all casters; casting cannot create chains or cycles. Initial range/line of effect are required, but no continuing distance or line-of-effect tether is imposed. This ordinary spell neither consumes nor increases the Paladin class redirection round ledger and grants none of its named healing/resource riders or proc permissions. Unrelated downstream triggers still require their own exact source authorization. Direct HP payments are not damage and cannot be transferred. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, concentration 1 minute, +1 AC/saves and half-damage sharing; M/F uses focus. NEW: willing ally, conserved mandatory post-defense split, rounding, participation and life endpoints, no continued tether and ordinary-spell/class-engine separation. CONFLICT RULING: source-derived class access is rank 1; duplicate rank-2 block is retained as evidence only.

<a id="spell-alignment-shield"></a>

### Alignment Shield

**ID:** `alignment-shield` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One willing creature you can perceive with line of effect, including yourself. Actual range is 30 feet when cast through Abjuration rank 1, or 60 feet through Conjuration rank 3; the 60-foot header is the maximum across these modes. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting. For each incoming attack roll, compare the attacker's explicit current canonical alignment with the protected recipient's explicit current canonical alignment.

Grant +2 AC against attack rolls from a creature explicitly opposed to the protected recipient on at least one alignment axis: Lawful versus Chaotic, or Good versus Evil. Neutral is not opposite to any value. An unknown or missing axis supplies no opposition; a known exact opposite on another axis still qualifies. Both class-specific modes use this same bounded bonus.

**Scaling:** None. Only your casting class's listed school/rank mode is available; higher level or extra RP cannot switch modes.

**Limits:** Never infer alignment from ancestry, faction, reputation, faith, appearance or behavior. The bonus does not identify or announce the attacker's alignment; observers may make ordinary deductions from visible results. The spectral shield creates no equipment, item HP, hand requirement, cover, projectile blocking, saleable object or immunity. It does not affect saving throws or automatically hitting effects. Use only the strongest applicable flat AC bonus. Other concurrent shields retain their own endpoints and concentration dependencies. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, V/S/F, +2 AC from Abjuration, class-specific 30/60-foot ranges and Conjuration concentration 1 minute. NEW CONFLICT RULINGS: Abjuration Instantaneous becomes concentration 1 minute; Conjuration blocks-attacks prose uses +2 AC rather than immunity. NEW: explicit recipient-versus-attacker axis comparison and spectral-only effect.

### Resonance Lock

**ID:** `resonance-lock` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you can perceive within range and line of effect. | On a failed save, until the target's first future regular-end marker after application; the current in-progress turn end does not count. Preserve the virtual target-end marker through initiative changes. Outside initiative, expires 6 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell DC. Success: no effect. Failure: the RP-spending prohibition applies.

The target cannot make a payment spending any positive amount of Resonance Points while locked. It can still use legal actions and effects whose final payable RP cost is zero. An RP-upkeep payment due during the lock cannot be paid; resolve the originating effect's printed failure-to-pay rule without inventing a new consequence.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Does not drain RP, alter maximum RP, undo completed payments, stop ongoing concentration merely because it once cost RP, or block RC and unrelated class resources. A cantrip with an explicit positive additional RP cost is blocked; a truly zero-RP cast is not. This is not whole-Action hard denial and does not consume that combined ledger. Record a separate source-character/target/encounter Resonance Lock guard when this target actually fails this character's Resonance Lock save. After that failure, this character cannot impose this spell on that target again in the encounter; later casts cannot refresh or extend the old lock. Successful saves do not spend the guard. Boss immunities, save defenses and other exact source protections remain effective. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, Wisdom save, 1 round, V/S/F and RP-use prevention. NEW: target-end clock, exact RP-payment boundary, upkeep handling and distinct source-character/target/encounter successful-lock guard.

<a id="spell-faction-seal"></a>

### Faction Seal

**ID:** `faction-seal` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One fixed point on an immobile solid surface you can perceive within range and line of effect; designate one exact canonical factionId the campaign permits you to invoke. | 1 hour: expires 3,600 seconds after application. Initiative changes do not reset the deadline. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting. Before using this spell, the Director records which existing canonical factions this caster is permitted to invoke, using an established source permission or an explicit campaign permission. No listed permission means that faction is not an eligible choice.

Place a visible seal and a fixed area extending 10 feet in radius and 10 feet above its surface. The seal flares while at least one creature occupying the area, with line of effect to the seal, has an actual reputation score of -3, -2 or -1 for the selected faction. It stops flaring when no qualifying creature remains. Its only direct report is that at least one qualifying negative-standing creature is present.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Zero or positive standing does not trigger; missing reputation is unknown and does not trigger. Hidden or invisible creatures can trigger it, but the flare reveals no creature, square, disguise, true identity, alignment, intent, statistics or exact score, and does not cancel invisibility. Teleportation counts only when the creature actually occupies the area. Ordinary observers can draw mundane conclusions from the signal. Naming or invoking a faction grants no membership, credentials, legal authority, standing change or institutional protection. Overlapping seals do not grant extra information beyond each seal's own binary result. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, V/S/F, faction marker and negative-reputation detection. NEW CONFLICT RULING: fixed 10-foot-radius/10-foot-high area, visible binary flare, explicit invocation permission and 1 hour without concentration replace unresolved Instantaneous area metadata. Campaign permission procedure is an explicit reviewed playtest completion; no existing source permission is fabricated.

<a id="spell-barrier-of-faith"></a>

### Barrier of Faith

**ID:** `barrier-of-faith` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 10 ft | A fixed 10-foot-long, 10-foot-high, negligible-thickness vertical wall on solid ground or a suitable approximately horizontal immobile surface. Its entire wall must fit in legal space within range and line of effect. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Choose one exact current source-authorized creature type or tag. No saving throw. The initial wall cannot intersect a matching creature's occupied space.

Matching creatures cannot physically cross the wall in either direction; being carried does not bypass their restriction. Creatures can start on either side. Nonmatching creatures, objects, attacks, spells, gas and sound pass normally. Teleportation or planar relocation does not physically cross it and is not blocked.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** No inferred taxonomy from appearance, name, ancestry, faction or lore. No HP, floor, platform, structural support, cover, collision damage or Action denial. Unsupported ordinary Falling is not arrested and gains no extra distance or lateral displacement. If unsupported Falling leaves a matching creature overlapping the wall, and the creature had a determinate legal side immediately before that overlap, it must clear the overlap back to that side using ordinary legal movement. If it descended from above with no determinate prior side, it may clear the overlap to either side using ordinary legal movement. Clearing overlap grants no free movement, added displacement, damage, or later permission to cross the wall. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: 10-foot wall, Action, 10-foot range, V/S/F, concentration 1 minute and chosen-type blocking. NEW: height/thickness, full placement legality, exact type/tag, two-way crossing, carriage and no-support limits. The reviewed Falling-overlap procedure preserves a determinate prior side and grants no free movement.

<a id="spell-counterspell"></a>

### Counterspell

**ID:** `counterspell` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves | 60 ft | One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.

Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.

**Limits:** One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: both Abjuration/Universal rank-3 placements, Reaction, 60 feet, V/S/F and instantaneous interruption. NEW: actual casting ability+PB against DC 10+2*rank, one attempt per pending cast, hidden-rank handling and nested timing. REVIEWED SOURCE CORRECTION: the earlier binary-check proposal is superseded by the existing Core fixed-DC task rule, with natural shifts and collapsed success/failure outcomes. Exact source permission may override the shared attempt limit; another Reaction alone cannot.

<a id="spell-barrier-field"></a>

### Barrier Field

**ID:** `barrier-field` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 15 ft | One fixed center point on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface within range and line of effect, with space for a 15-foot-radius hemisphere. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal placement. Creation neither displaces nor damages creatures. The field is faintly visible.

Create a 15-foot-radius hemisphere, 15 feet high, with no floor. In both directions its curved boundary blocks attack rolls whose attack/effect path crosses it, including melee reach, and blocks the directly damaging portion of harmful effects crossing it, including save-based or automatic magical damage. Damage from an area on one side does not propagate through the boundary to the other. REVIEWED ORIGIN CLARIFICATION: for a cast that directly deals damage, trace from its caster to the target or initial area origin; merely choosing the area center beyond the field does not bypass it. A damaging part that must cross is blocked regardless of friendly intent or recipient willingness. Other legal, separable non-damaging parts resolve normally. The initial establishment of a persistent damaging source must also satisfy this boundary rule. Once legally established, its subsequent packets use its actual current origin.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Creatures and ordinary nonattack movement cross freely. The field does not block ordinary light, sound or gas, nondamaging control or information magic, teleportation, or effects genuinely originating and resolving entirely on the same side. A previously established independent effect uses its actual source origin and is not ended by field creation. It grants no one-way attacks, HP, item identity, cover item, entrapment, floor, platform or structural support. Unsupported Falling crosses normally without extra movement. It does not erase resolved damage or negate an entire spell merely because its damage across the boundary is blocked. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 15-foot cast range, 15-foot hemisphere, V/S/F, concentration 1 minute and physical/magical attack protection. NEW: fixed visible hemisphere, two-way attack/direct-damage boundary, no floor, free creature passage and explicit nondamaging exceptions. Direct-damage origin/intent and persistent-source establishment follow the reviewed interpretation.

| Eligible class | Rank | Earliest class level | Base RP |
|---|---:|---:|---:|

<a id="spell-remove-curse"></a>

### Remove Curse

**ID:** `remove-curse` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One creature or object you can perceive within range and line of effect. No willingness or prior curse-detection requirement. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** Pay and cast against the legal creature/object target before resolving its hidden afflictions. No saving throw. Select a known distinguishable curse; if eligible curse identities are hidden and more than one actual removable curse exists, the Director selects one without revealing unrelated metadata. If none is eligible, no curse ends and no paid cost is refunded; the spell grants no separate diagnostic report.

End one actual inflicted affliction record classified as a curse that affects the selected target, invoking that curse's own ending procedure. No general spell-rank ceiling applies: this is curse removal rather than dispelling.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Explicit non-removability, required special cures, protected information and source-specific restrictions override this generic removal. A name containing curse is not an affliction classification. Oracle intrinsic Curse, Burden, Boons and Manifestation cannot be removed or suspended. Ending a curse does not undo historical HP damage, alignment/reputation changes, resource payments, Wounds, death or other consequences unless that curse's actual ending rule explicitly does so. Ordinary observations of a real change remain possible. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous and ending one curse on creature/object. NEW: actual inflicted curse metadata, hidden-curse selection without prior detection, no fabricated rank cap or willingness, and distinct legal-target/payment versus hidden-effect-result timing.

<a id="spell-protection-from-scrying"></a>

### Protection from Scrying

**ID:** `protection-from-scrying` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within range and line of effect, including yourself. | 1 hour: expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application; entering, leaving or reordering initiative does not change that deadline. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting. Check an information-gathering effect's actual generating source classification, using its real casting-class school placement where applicable.

The target supplies no new information to effects explicitly classified as Divination or Scrying that attempt to perceive, locate, inspect, read, identify or otherwise obtain information about it. Apply this protection equally against hostile, neutral and beneficial information gathering. A multi-subject or area effect may still obtain permitted information about other subjects.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** No ordinary invisibility, concealment, false identity, attack defense, memory erasure, record deletion or retroactive protection. A class sense is blocked only insofar as its actual source classifies it as Divination/Scrying; the underlying class engine remains intact. Theme or guessed purpose is not classification. Known information remains known. Independent applications do not stack extra power and each retains its own endpoint. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and divination/scrying immunity. NEW CONFLICT RULING: ongoing 1 hour without concentration replaces Instantaneous metadata; immunity is operationally defined as prevention of new information about one willing target, not a blanket damage/benefit immunity against a school name.

### Resonance Anchor

**ID:** `resonance-anchor` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One perceptible ongoing magical effect with a discrete spatial origin/area within range and line of effect, created by you or explicitly permitted for anchoring by its current source owner/controller. It cannot be Resonance Anchor, an effect permanently attached to a creature/carried object, or an effect currently dependent on your own existing concentration. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends. Also ends when the anchored target effect ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal casting. Check the own-concentration exclusion before committing this cast: it forbids targeting an effect that beginning Anchor would itself end.

Fix the selected effect's spatial origin in its current position; a movable/recenterable zone loses that relocation permission while anchored. Ordinary dispelling cannot end the target, including otherwise eligible Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) or Dispel Magic. Anchor itself remains normally dispellable at its own actual rank. REVIEWED CLARIFICATION: anchoring fixes location, not the target's unrelated source-authorized evolution of radius, shape or nonspatial effects; it neither freezes nor manufactures those source changes.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Cannot target itself or another Resonance Anchor. No duration extension, replacement of the target's concentration, use/cost reset, revival, restored pulse, frozen expiry or retroactive Counterspell protection. The target can still end by its own concentration, duration, destruction, source conditions, special removal or explicit anchor-bypassing effect. Its original owner/controller can still exercise a printed ending permission. Another caster's anchored concentration spell still requires that caster's concentration. No class engine or full Time Loop implementation is granted. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, fixing a magical effect and preventing ordinary dispel. NEW CONFLICT RULING: concentration 1 minute replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: spatial eligibility/controller permission, own-concentration exclusion, Anchor's removability and no mutual anchoring. Location remains fixed while otherwise source-authorized size/shape evolution continues.

<a id="spell-alignment-sanctuary"></a>

### Alignment Sanctuary

**ID:** `alignment-sanctuary` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One fixed 10-foot-radius, 10-foot-high area centered on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface within range and line of effect. Your casting class selects Abjuration rank 3 or Shaman Conjuration rank 6; rank-6 Conjuration requires both of your canonical alignment axes explicitly recorded before casting. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Snapshot the caster's actual canonical alignment at application; do not infer it from ancestry, faction, reputation, faith, appearance or conduct. Abjuration rank 3 uses Wisdom saves against your spell DC for opposed entrants. Conjuration rank 6 uses exact matching admission with no save. The snapshot is fixed for this application.

Abjuration rank 3: a creature is opposed if at least one explicitly known axis is exact opposite to the snapshot (Lawful/Chaotic or Good/Evil). Neutral is never opposite; an unknown axis supplies no opposition, and does not erase a known opposite on the other axis. On an opposed creature's attempted entry from outside, roll its Wisdom save before entry, including forced movement, carriage or teleportation. REVIEWED CADENCE CLARIFICATION: record that success or failure for this source character, mode and target until the target's next regular-start marker; the current in-progress start never counts. A success permits entries during that window; failure blocks all non-Falling entry attempts during it without repeat rolls. Same-caster replacement/recasting does not reset this window. Outside initiative, use a fixed 6-second window and preserve its deadline if initiative starts. A failed physical entry stops before the boundary; a failed teleport leaves the creature at its origin without refunding committed teleport costs. Conjuration rank 6: only a creature with both explicit canonical axes exactly matching both snapshotted axes may enter from outside. Unknown is not matching. Nonmatching physical entry, forced movement and carriage stop before entry; a teleport attempt to place a nonmatching creature inside leaves it at origin after costs are committed.

**Scaling:** None. Shaman's preserved Conjuration rank-6 access costs 13 RP before ordinary surcharges; extra RP or character level cannot select another placement.

**Limits:** Both modes allow existing occupants to remain or leave; once outside, entry restrictions apply. Unsupported ordinary Falling is not arrested, supplies no platform and adds no movement; it can place a creature inside. No AC/save bonus, healing, rest guarantee, resource recovery, attack immunity, concealment, morality compulsion or alignment change. The ward denies entry rather than Actions and does not consume the shared hard-denial ledger. Multiple casters' wards retain independent source permissions and save windows; no single ward's success bypasses another ward. The preserved rank-6 Abjuration aligned-benefits placement has no actual class-access grant and stays unassigned/unavailable; its vague benefits are not imported. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, Abjuration rank-3 opposed-entry Wisdom save and Shaman Conjuration rank-6 same-alignment safe haven. NEW CONFLICT RULINGS: fixed 10-foot-radius/height and concentration 1 minute replace Instantaneous metadata; actual modes stay separate, unassigned rank-6 Abjuration benefits remain blocked. NEW: snapshots, entry/teleport/Falling handling and exact two-axis Conjuration matching. Save-window/recast and rank-6 snapshot-validity completions are jointly reviewed provisional rules.

<a id="spell-conjure-water"></a>

### Conjure Water

**ID:** `conjure-water` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One open container or unoccupied surface you can see within 30 feet; up to 1 gallon | Up to 1 hour; ends earlier if consumed, dispersed, or you cast Conjure Water again |

**Resolution:** None.

Create up to 1 gallon of clean, drinkable water in the chosen legal location. A creature may satisfy its ordinary water need from Conjure Water once per 24 elapsed in-world hours. This replaces no food, equipment, camp supplies or abstract expedition Supply units.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** You can maintain only one batch of water from this spell at a time; casting it again causes any unconsumed prior conjured water to vanish. Cannot create water inside a creature, sealed object, occupied body space, machinery, or a location where creation itself would deal damage. Conjured water cannot be sold, stockpiled beyond the one active batch, fermented into permanent commodities, or count as a permanent crafting/industrial ingredient. It provides ordinary hydration while it exists. Repeated cantrip casts use shared Refrain rules. Consuming or replacing batches never bypasses the once-per-recipient-per-24-hours hydration limit. Conjured water in a creature does not disappear harmfully. The limit is an explicit provisional expedition-economy guard.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Core instantaneous creation is given a one-hour conjured-object lifetime and one active batch, plus once-per-recipient hydration, as explicit new test limits. Conference decision: hydration resets on elapsed24hours, independent of ability to complete a long rest.

Conjure one simple nonmagical handheld tool weighing no more than 5 pounds, such as a hammer, screwdriver, wrench, shovel head, pry bar, saw, needle, cooking utensil, chalk-like marker, or similar ordinary tool. The tool functions as a mundane example of its type.

<a id="spell-summon-fire-pet"></a>

### Summon Fire Pet

**ID:** `summon-fire-pet` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Small fire elemental companion | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** No initial save or attack. The summoned pet uses your spell attack bonus for its commanded melee attack.

Summon a Small fire elemental with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet, and a melee fire attack with 5-foot reach using your spell attack bonus. On hit it deals 1d8 fire damage. It acts immediately after you. On your Bonus Action command it may move and either make its one melee attack or take another basic non-damaging action; without a command it may move and Dodge. Its saving throw bonus is your PB; ability checks use +0 unless its profile explicitly supplies another bonus. It has no innate resistances or immunities beyond this printed profile.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** You may have only one Summon Fire Pet from this spell at a time. It shares the owner's global companion command budget and one damaging companion action per round across all companions. It has no independent resource generation, class features, loot, corpse, death trigger, free healing, or autonomous attack. At 0 HP or when concentration ends it disappears. Recasting replaces the prior pet. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

<a id="spell-earthen-grip"></a>

### Earthen Grip

**ID:** `earthen-grip` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One Large-or-smaller creature touching solid ground that you can perceive within 30 feet | Concentration, until the end of the target's next turn |

**Resolution:** Target makes a Strength save. On failure it is Restrained until the end of its next turn. On success there is no effect.

Conjured earth grips the target in place, inflicting the CoreV2 Restrained condition until the end of its next turn on a failed Strength save; ending concentration ends the restraint sooner.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Does not affect creatures not touching a solid surface, creatures larger than Large, or targets whose anatomy or explicit immunity prevents restraint. The effect ends automatically at the stated time and does not require repeated escape checks. It is not a whole-Action denial. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. An affected target may use an Action for STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) against your spell DC to escape early.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Catalog one-round restraint limits Core one-minute metadata; retain Core concentration. The target can use an Action for STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) against your spell DC to end restraint early.

<a id="spell-dust-gust"></a>

### Dust Gust

**ID:** `dust-gust` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | Choose one mode: one discrete unattended, unsecured object you perceive, no larger than Small and no heavier than 10 pounds; or up to 10 pounds of existing loose nonmagical sand or dust contained within one 5-foot square. The selected object/material must be within range and line of effect. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** Automatic for an eligible object or selected loose material; no attack or save.

Object mode pushes the object up to 5 feet directly away from you. Dust/sand mode scatters the selected loose material up to 5 feet away from you. Stop movement before solid terrain or illegal occupancy; ordinary loose material may settle on an accessible supporting surface.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Worn, held, attached, restrained, locked, packed, structural or otherwise secured material is ineligible. Ordinary floor, table or shelf support alone is not security. The spell creates no material and grants no excavation, blindness, damage, disarm, collision damage or generated resource. Ordinary physical consequences, such as exposing a surface or removing support and beginning Falling, still follow. Moving some dust does not automatically erase tracks, remove a hazard or neutralize its independent effect. Known/prepared access, class level, components, line of effect, cast costs, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and the originating spell's line of effect. No automatic level scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 5-foot range, V/S, instantaneous, object push or 5-foot sand/dust scatter. NEW: Small/10-pound ceiling, exact two modes, existing loose material, 5-foot displacement and custody/obstruction limits.

### Minor Elemental Ward

**ID:** `minor-elemental-ward` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within range, including yourself. | If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual source-start phase through initiative changes, departure or death. If applied outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when consumed or concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic application after legal casting. The benefit modifies the target's next qualifying save; it creates no new save.

The target gains +1 to its next saving throw against an effect whose resolution can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage. Consume the benefit after that qualifying save regardless of success/failure, damage prevented by another defense, or a stronger flat saving-throw bonus superseding this +1.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Only the five listed damage types qualify; force, necrotic, radiant, poison, psychic, physical and Corruption damage do not qualify by themselves. Mixed effects qualify if their resolution can deal a listed type. A source with an elemental name but no such damage does not qualify. No immunity or resistance to damage/status is granted. One pending Minor Elemental Ward per target across all casters; a new application replaces the older one and releases only that older casting's concentration dependency. Each casting owns only its own concentration dependency. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale expiration or consumption of an older application cannot remove its replacement. A countered new cast creates no replacement. Known/prepared access, class level, components, line of effect, cast costs, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and the originating spell's line of effect. No automatic level scaling.

NEW: willing recipient, exact five-type eligibility, consumption, all-caster replacement and exact endpoint; deliberately distinct from the eight-type Protection from Energy list.

<a id="spell-resonance-kindle"></a>

### Resonance Kindle

**ID:** `resonance-kindle` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self only; the casting character's own RP pool. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** Automatic recovery only if this legal spell survives interruption and reaches resolution. Having no unused Kindle use makes the cast illegal before activation/payment.

At the beginning of the legal cast, spend your one Kindle use before the Counterspell window. At resolution, restore 1 RP to yourself, capped by your actual RP maximum. One use per character across all class repertoires, copied access and historical aliases refreshes only upon an actual completed beneficial long rest under the shared recovery rules.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** A countered cast leaves the use spent and recovers 0 RP. A cast at maximum RP is legal, spends the use and restores 0 if still full at resolution. Repeated nonbeneficial rest attempts do not refresh it. It neither clears Dissonance/Refrain nor restores other resources, heals, grants a check, or targets an ally. Only casting this spell produces this recovery; casting another cantrip does not trigger it. Copied effects, duplicate access, form changes and proxies grant no extra uses or repeated resource recovery. Known/prepared access, class level, components, line of effect, cast costs, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and the originating spell's line of effect. No automatic level scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: current catalog and V6 explicitly recover 1 RP after casting THIS cantrip, once per long rest. ALIAS RECONCILIATION: comparative Core Mana Kindle supports Action/V/S/instantaneous; its broader after-a-cantrip wording is not a repeatable trigger. Its historical 30-foot range remains evidence, while the operational range is Self. No exact-name Core block exists, and the comparative alias remains separately identified and preserved. NEW: character-wide use, begin-cast expenditure, beneficial-rest reset, cap and interruption handling.

<a id="spell-elemental-touch"></a>

### Elemental Touch

**ID:** `elemental-touch` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | One creature, or one unattended or willingly presented discrete object, within your body's actual normal touch reach. The 5-foot header is a normal-humanoid reference, not a grant of reach, a ranged touch or an override of actual anatomy. | Damage is instantaneous. On a successful touch, the cosmetic mark lasts for the following one-minute clock: If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual source-start phase through initiative changes, departure or death. If applied outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** Against an unwilling creature, make a melee spell attack using the casting class's spellcasting ability + PB. A willing creature or eligible unattended/willingly presented object requires no attack roll. A missed attack produces neither damage nor mark.

Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder when cast. A successful touch deals 1 flat damage of that type and leaves a harmless, visibly elemental mark on the touched target for 1 minute. A critical hit adds no damage dice and does not double the flat 1. Apply ordinary defenses; the mark appears even when the damage becomes 0.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** No ability modifier or automatic level scaling increases damage. Object damage requires an existing native track/rule that actually accepts this typed damage: reduce actual HP normally, or use an explicit native conversion if provided; never treat 1 damage as 1 Integrity stage or invent a conversion. The cosmetic mark is not the Marked condition, a tracker, beacon, extra damage, ignition, corrosion engine, parasite detector or another condition. It provides no magical information or extraordinary visibility through concealment; observers may see it normally. One mark from this caster on this target replaces that caster's prior Elemental Touch mark; marks from other casters remain separate. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale expiration or consumption of an older application cannot remove its replacement. A countered new cast creates no replacement. Known/prepared access, class level, components, line of effect, cast costs, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and the originating spell's line of effect. No automatic level scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, Touch, V/S, chosen-element 1 damage and a mark. NEW: melee spell attack against unwilling creatures, exact five types, object/native-track interface, 1-minute harmless mark, no concentration and per-caster/target replacement. rangeFeet=5 is a reference header; actual touch reach controls.

Apply existing unseen-attacker/target and perception rules only when their actual conditions hold, with ordinary advantage/disadvantage combination; the mist adds no new modifier or duplicated Invisible benefit. Extraordinary senses apply only as their own rules permit. One Mist Veil per caster; a successful new application replaces the prior one, and starting its concentration already ends incompatible old concentration. Ordinary wind or heat does not automatically end this magical mist; an effect expressly capable of dispersing magical mist may do so. No recoverable water or material is created. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale expiration or consumption of an older application cannot remove its replacement. A countered new cast creates no replacement. Known/prepared access, class level, components, line of effect, cast costs, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. CONFLICT RULING: concentration up to 1 minute supplies an ongoing procedure instead of the unusable Instantaneous cloud metadata.
