<a id="spell-phantom-key"></a>

### Phantom Key

**ID:** `phantom-key` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One perceived nonmagical, key-operated mechanical lock within range and line of effect; conjure its key into your free hand. A free hand able to receive/use an ordinary key is required at creation. | If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual source-start phase through initiative changes, departure or death. If applied outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. The temporary key vanishes at the endpoint, wherever it then is. |

**Resolution:** Automatic creation for an eligible lock. Actual insertion and operation require ordinary legal physical object interaction; spellcasting does not include remote opening or an extra interaction.

The temporary key works as the correct mundane key for that exact lock, requiring no lockpicking check. It can be handed to another creature and used normally for the duration, including locking or unlocking repeatedly if the actual mechanism and available interactions allow. It cannot operate another lock. Its vanishing does not retroactively undo the physical lock's resulting state.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** One Phantom Key per caster; a successful new application ends that caster's prior key. Ordinary hand, custody, carrying, access and object-interaction rules apply; a second interaction or a mechanism requiring an Action still costs that Action. It does not disable, detect or bypass traps, jams, barricades, combination/keyless locks or magical protections. A separable mundane physical mechanism on a magically warded lock can accept the key; the ward, including Arcane Lock, remains in force and requires its own permission or removal. A purely magical lock is ineligible. The key supplies no permanent key, harvestable/saleable material or automatic durable blueprint. Ordinary observations and deductions still work; no memory or inference is erased. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale expiration or consumption of an older application cannot remove its replacement. A countered new cast creates no replacement. Known/prepared access, class level, components, line of effect, cast costs, concentration transitions, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and the originating spell's line of effect. No automatic level scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: temporary key that WORKS on one nonmagical lock; Action/30 feet/V/S. NEW: key-operated mechanism, free-hand creation, finite 1-minute lifetime/no concentration, transferable custody, ordinary repeatable key use during that lifetime, one-key cap and trap/ward boundaries. The historical Instantaneous metadata is reconciled as creation followed by a finite temporary object. Thief Lockpick Mastery remains a separate +5 tool/check feature; the strong mundane-lock bypass is an explicit unresolved balance question, not silently rewritten into proficiency or advantage.

Use the existing soft-control procedure: evaluate each adverse slow against the same pre-control Speed and use the lowest result; do not multiply repeated halves. Movement already spent is not undone.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** This creates no ongoing sand/fire field, Burn, Prone, difficult terrain, blind condition, object damage or whole-Action/turn denial. The damage and soft-control rider are separate; immunity to the damage does not by itself waive the slow save. Independent slow records keep their own endpoints and obey CONTROL_STATES_PLAYTEST.md. The rod weighs 1 pound, has AC 12 and 3 HP, and has one charge. At activation start spend that charge, the original caster's Mod Rod supply use and the bearer's Mod Rod receipt use. ### Heat Metal (Conjured)

**ID:** `heat-metal-conjured` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One perceived metal weapon or metal suit/piece of armor within range. A nonmetal weapon/armor does not qualify merely because it has a small metal fitting. A weapon/armor primarily made of metal qualifies whether mundane, magical or conjured. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application and preserves that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends or the target item ceases to exist. |

**Resolution:** Automatic application; no save or immediate cast-resolution damage. Its periodic pulse deals 1d6 fire to the creature currently wearing or holding the item at a legal pulse marker, subject to ordinary defenses.

In initiative, the first possible pulse is the first future regular-start marker of a creature actually wearing/holding the item after application. Thereafter pulse at the first regular-start of a current wearer/holder in each numbered round, at most once per item per numbered round across all applications/casters. Replacing the application or handing the same item to another creature does not reset this item/round record. No user at a possible marker means no damage and no stored catch-up pulse. Outside initiative, the first pulse is application+6 seconds and then at most once each 6 seconds while actually used; preserve the next not-before deadline through initiative changes, and never award an extra pulse merely by entering or leaving initiative. Whenever this spell deals a pulse, record a next-pulse-not-before deadline 6 elapsed seconds after that pulse. No later pulse from this spell on this physical item can occur before that deadline, even if initiative begins, ends or is reordered. In initiative, after that deadline, the first otherwise eligible current-user regular-start in a numbered round may pulse, subject to the shared item/round guard. Leaving initiative preserves the same deadline; the first outside-initiative pulse cannot occur before it. Entering or leaving initiative never resets either the deadline or a spent item/round allowance. The physical item retains this deadline across replacement applications/casters just as it retains the shared round allowance. For a newly cast application with no preserved deadline, the first-future-user-start rule controls in initiative; outside initiative the initial deadline is application +6 seconds.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Only one Heat Metal (Conjured) application per physical item across all casters; successful replacement ends the prior one and releases its old concentration dependency. The first qualifying actual wearer/holder at a legal marker is the sole recipient of that pulse; ties use the current initiative order, or outside initiative a fixed order agreed before resolution. Mere touching by another creature is not wearing/holding use. Dropping, legally doffing, melding or losing actual item use prevents damage while that state lasts without ending concentration or resetting the spell clock. A later user may take a later legal pulse. Normal armor removal time and legal custody still apply. No forced drop, disadvantage, Bonus Action pulse, Burn, ignition, object damage or additional condition. Supernatural damaging heat ends with the spell; no residual damage clock. Recasting does not produce an instant pulse or erase a spent item/round allowance. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of an older application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting a concentration spell still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, components, line of effect, RP and other costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and originating line of effect. No automatic upcast or level scaling unless this card explicitly prints companion-profile scaling.

NEW: no save/immediate pulse, actual metal/use, future user-start timing, shared item/round guard through replacement and handling changes, finite elapsed-time pulse clock. Numeric source duration and periodic rules were missing; these are provisional authoring completions.

Create one 50-foot physical magical rope weighing 10 pounds, with AC 11 and 5 HP for the entire rope, not per segment. It supports at most 300 pounds total static load, including creatures and carried gear, when actually secured to a real support that can bear the load. Each command can coil/uncoil; slither up to 20 feet along existing supporting surfaces; tie or untie itself around an unattended object or actual fixed anchor within 5 feet of part of the rope; form/loosen a simple loop or knot; or draw in its own loose slack. Its actual length, unobstructed path and slack must permit the operation. Afterward it stays physically arranged and can be used as ordinary rope even outside command range.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** One rope per caster; a successful new application ends the old. It cannot create an anchor, fly, levitate, attack, automatically grapple/Restrain a resisting creature, haul or forcibly move a creature/load, operate weapons/traps, or secure unlimited cargo with one command. Tightening or drawing slack cannot lift/drag an attached load for free. Ordinary climbing, knot/support and cargo interactions remain required as appropriate. The command uses the available Bonus Action and grants no additional action or companion-command budget. A commanded untie can remove support, after which ordinary Falling applies. Exceeding 300 pounds causes immediate failure/disappearance rather than a discretionary caster veto; count actual load including applicable mass changes and gear. At 0 HP, spell end or overload the whole rope vanishes and unsupported loads fall. Cutting it into pieces cannot duplicate HP or leave persistent rope/material. It cannot move, recenter, tilt, become vertical, fly, act as a mobile shield, guillotine or crushing surface, or be created through a creature. ### Faction Messenger

**ID:** `faction-messenger` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; designate one canonical factionId, one specific intended recipient identified by name or reliable description and reasonably believed to belong, and one physical destination known to you within 300 feet where you expect that recipient. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application and preserves that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends or the courier reaches 0 HP. |

**Resolution:** Automatic summoning; no reputation or Faction Seal invocation gate. Supply one brief spoken message no longer than ordinarily spoken during one Action, using an actual language. Initial delivery instruction is included in casting; no extra initial command is required.

Summon a Small courier: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP 2 times casting class level, walking Speed 30 feet, saves PB, other checks +0, ordinary sight/hearing, no attack. It understands your delivery instructions and reproduces the exact message once but has no general speaking language/telepathy or translation ability. It acts immediately after you, moving toward the supplied destination by an ordinary route it can perceive and legally use. At that location, if it can ordinarily recognize/reach the intended recipient and the recipient is actually a member of the designated faction, it audibly delivers the message once, then remains harmless at that location until expiry. Hearing and language comprehension remain normal.

**Scaling:** Only explicit profile scaling: AC with PB, HP with casting class level, saves with PB. Speed, duration, destination distance and message capacity do not scale.

**Limits:** Delivery fails if the intended recipient is not actually a member, cannot be found at the designated location by ordinary senses, or cannot be legally reached before expiry. The spell supplies no magical identity authentication, membership report, hidden location, substitute member, unknown coordinates, scouting report, failure reason or return message. Disguises/concealment can prevent ordinary recognition; the courier does not pierce them. Observers may draw ordinary deductions from actual delivery/events. Later route changes or mundane instructions cost your Bonus Action in initiative, share the global companion-command budget, and require it within 60 feet and able to perceive your spoken command. It cannot be retargeted to a new recipient or given a second message. It has no damaging/control action and neither spends nor grants the damaging-companion allowance. It may carry only its message and optionally one supplied mundane paper note of at most 1 pound; no money, weapons, consumables, magic items, freight, autonomous investigation or economic labor. It cannot fly or teleport. One courier per caster; at 0 HP or spell end it vanishes without corpse/resources. A supplied ordinary paper note is not duplicated or destroyed by the summon: it remains with the recipient if handed over, otherwise drops at the courier's location under ordinary support/Falling rules. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of an older application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting a concentration spell still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, components, line of effect, RP and other costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and originating line of effect. No automatic upcast or level scaling unless this card explicitly prints companion-profile scaling. A description must identify one intended creature well enough that an ordinary observer using only the supplied description and currently perceivable facts could distinguish that creature from other creatures at the destination. If multiple creatures fit the description equally and the courier has no ordinary basis to distinguish the intended recipient, it delivers to none; the spell provides no magical tie-breaker or identity revelation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F/concentration 1 minute and small creature delivering a message to a faction member. NEW: specific recipient/known destination within 300 feet, ordinary routing and recognition, profile, one-action speech, initial delivery movement exception, later command interface, optional finite paper custody and no membership/location oracle. No positive-standing gate is invented.

The liquid disappears on consumption, while the empty vial remains to show the result and vanishes when that result ends. A viewer must ordinarily see and understand the symbols; the spell grants no remote message or language knowledge. The vial weighs one quarter pound, has AC 10 and 1 HP.

**Scaling:** None.

<a id="spell-elemental-barrage"></a>

### Elemental Barrage

**ID:** `elemental-barrage` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you can perceive within range. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Dexterity save against your spell DC. Roll 2d8 once: failure takes full damage; success takes floor(the rolled damage/2). Then apply its ordinary defenses.

Choose fire, cold or lightning when casting; deal the printed 2d8 damage of that chosen type to the target under the stated save.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The name grants no additional bolt, target or area. No Burn, slow, chain, terrain effect, persistent field, object damage or automatic spread. The spell supplies no attack roll, critical hit or ability modifier to damage. This differentiates it from rank-1 Elemental Bolt without silently increasing source damage or adding targets. Relative rank-2 value remains an explicit balance question.

<a id="spell-conjure-shield-of-sparks"></a>

### Conjure Shield of Sparks

**ID:** `conjure-shield-of-sparks` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within range, including yourself. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, absence or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; retain that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** Automatic ward application. When an attack roll actually resolves against the protected creature while this ward is active, hit or miss, it can earn the printed retaliation. A canceled declaration with no resolved attack roll does not qualify.

The target gains +3 AC, using the strongest applicable flat AC bonus. At the instant an attack roll resolves against the active ward, if its attacker is within 30 feet of the protected target and has line of effect to that target, queue 1d4 lightning damage to that attacker. Finish the triggering attack and its damage, interception, life and concentration consequences, then resolve the already-earned packet even if those consequences ended the ward. Range and line of effect are captured at the qualifying roll; later movement does not retroactively erase the earned packet. Both melee and ranged attack rolls can qualify. Retaliation is limited to once per protected-target/attacker/numbered-round across all Shield of Sparks applications/casters; replacement does not reset the record.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Only one Shield of Sparks affects a target across all casters; a successful new application ends the displaced application and releases only its old concentration dependency. Attacks from beyond the 30-foot retaliation reach or without the required line of effect still face the +3 AC if otherwise legal but generate no retaliation. The packet is new lightning damage, not a copied original attack, an attack roll or a hit by the protected creature. Ordinary defenses, temporary HP, concentration and death consequences apply. It cannot recursively trigger another Shield of Sparks, reflection/retaliation, resource gain, copied damage, derived healing, free Action/attack or generic on-hit rider absent an exact source expressly authorizing that interaction. No physical shield, hand/equipment requirement, electric field, extra illumination or condition is created. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F, +3 AC and 1d4 lightning to an attacker. CONFLICT RULING: finite 1-minute concentration ward replaces Instantaneous metadata; no physical shield is implied. NEW: willing recipient, all attack-roll types, trigger-time 30-foot/LoE retaliation qualification, queued after-attack resolution, all-caster replacement and persistent protected-target/attacker round cap.

<a id="spell-summon-weaponry-satchel"></a>

### Summon Weaponry Satchel

**ID:** `summon-weaponry-satchel` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | Your free hand, or one legal unoccupied supporting space you perceive within range, for one conjured satchel. | 1 hour (3,600 seconds) after application; preserve the absolute deadline through initiative changes. Ends earlier on replacement, spell ending or satchel destruction. |

**Resolution:** Automatic creation. Choose exactly one content mode and all its choices at creation. Actual drawing, loading, using or handing over contents uses ordinary legal object and weapon interactions; casting grants no extra use or attack.

Ammo mode creates either 20 arrows (1 pound total), 20 crossbow bolts (1.5 pounds), 20 sling bullets (1.5 pounds), or 50 blowgun needles (1 pound). They function as compatible ordinary ammunition, except attacks using them count as magical weapon attacks; there is no +X or extra damage. Each piece fired is expended and vanishes after that attack resolves, hit or miss. Tool mode instead creates one ordinary simple handheld tool of at most 5 pounds, chosen with the same eligibility as Summon Tool and weighing the actual ordinary tool weight. The satchel itself weighs 1 pound, has AC 11 and 5 HP; add remaining content mass when carrying it. Each ammunition piece has AC 10/1 HP and the tool has AC 12/3 HP if separately targeted. Destroying a content item consumes that item without refilling it or automatically damaging the satchel.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** One satchel per caster; successful recasting ends all that caster's earlier satchel contents. Its interior accepts only its own conjured contents; unrelated user property remains outside and is never deleted by this spell. Removed conjured contents remain dependent on this casting and vanish on expiry, spell end, replacement or satchel destruction. A piece already committed to an attack currently resolving, or a tool already used in an immediate check currently resolving, finishes that atomic resolution; this does not preserve it for later attacks, later checks or an entire ongoing project. No refilling, recovery of fired ammunition, sellable/crafting material, dismantling yield, copies or permanent stock. Ammo grants no weapon, attack, proficiency or loading/reload waiver. Tool mode grants no proficiency or numeric bonus and cannot make thieves' tools, a key, a combat weapon, powered or precision device, laboratory/alchemical kit, potion, reagent, ammunition, currency, rare material or expedition Supply. All ordinary hand/carrying/access rules apply; externally carried contents count in their actual custody, not again inside the bag. These are native HP objects; no Integrity track or HP/Integrity conversion is supplied. Damage/effects must actually be able to affect the relevant object; having HP grants no creature eligibility. No unstated resistance, immunity or organic-target eligibility is supplied. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F and magical ammunition OR tools usable for one hour. NEW: fixed finite mutually exclusive modes, one-satchel cap, no concentration, exact object profiles/custody and atomic-use ending rule. Ammo quantities/masses match the cited V6 equipment rows. The 1-pound satchel and separately targeted content AC/HP are explicit provisional completions; no infinite bag, weapon grant or permanent crafting stock.

### Planar Ally (Minor)

**ID:** `planar-ally-minor` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |

| Action | 30 ft | One unoccupied space you can perceive within range. | 10 minutes (600 seconds) after application; preserve the absolute deadline through initiative changes. Ends earlier at 0 HP, replacement or spell ending. |

**Resolution:** No initial roll. A commanded Planar Strike makes one melee spell attack using your actual casting-class spell attack bonus, reach 5 feet. On hit deal 1d8 of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing chosen and fixed at creation, with no added ability damage modifier. The strike counts as a magical attack while retaining that physical damage type.

Summon one Medium Minor Planar Ally with AC 14, HP 24, walking Speed 30 feet, saves equal to owner PB, other checks +0, ordinary sight/hearing, and body mass 100 pounds. Its explicit tags are summoned and extraplanar; this spell supplies no additional creature-type classification or world-faction identity. It understands your spoken commands but has no speaking language or telepathy. It has ordinary hands suitable for simple object manipulation. It acts immediately after you. Within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command movement plus its one strike or one basic legal action. Without a command it may defensively move and Dodge. It shares the owner-wide Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action per numbered round.

**Scaling:** Only the expressly printed owner PB saves and actual spell attack bonus change with the caster. AC14, HP24, 1d8 damage and all other profile capacities stay fixed; no S progression.

**Limits:** For noncombat assistance it may carry no more than 30 pounds AND 3 Load, manipulate simple unattended objects with its hands, or Search using its actual +0 check; source-required proficiency is not granted. Ordinary object/cargo/time/action rules still apply. It has no autonomous offense or opportunity attack, free Help advantage, planar travel, flight, special senses, resistance/immunity, supernatural knowledge, telepathy, automatic scouting report, faction/legal authority, contracts, casting, free economic labor, loot, harvestable body, corpse or resource/death triggers. One ally per caster. At 0 HP, expiry or replacement it disappears; ordinary borrowed/carried property is conserved and drops at its last location under normal support/Falling rules. This is a NEW summon-only tabletop profile for the source's intended CR-1 role, not a certified CR-1 Monster Manual creature or a grant to choose any published monster. Do not relabel Umbrin Arachnid or fractional-CR creatures to qualify. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. <a id="spell-resonance-well"></a>

### Resonance Well

**ID:** `resonance-well` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One fixed point you can perceive within range and line of effect for a nonphysical pool of resonance. | If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, absence or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; retain that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if the spell is ended or a later successful allowed application replaces it. |

**Resolution:** Before activation/payment confirm the caster's unused character-wide Resonance Well creation use. Spend it at legal cast start before the Counterspell window. On successful resolution roll 1d4 exactly once to establish the total RP reserve. This amount belongs to the entire Well, not each recipient.

One creation use per character across classes/copies refreshes only at that character's actual beneficial completed long rest. A countered cast spends the use and creates no Well. A creature with an actual RP pool, including the caster, can spend an Action within 5 feet and line of effect to draw. Verify its unused character-wide Resonance Well receipt use since its own last beneficial completed long rest and a positive remaining reserve. At draw start choose a positive amount no greater than that reserve, spend the recipient use and Action, and subtract that amount immediately. At resolution restore the chosen amount, capped at actual RP maximum. Over-cap recovery is wasted; a full recipient can deliberately spend a positive draw and recover 0. Zero draw is illegal. A preventing interrupt refunds nothing.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** One Well per caster. Receipt use is shared across all Wells/casters/classes and refreshes only at the recipient's own beneficial long rest; creation and receipt are separate records, including when caster draws from their own Well. Kindle and Mod Rod keep their separate named ledgers: Well neither resets nor shares them. At reserve 0 the Well is inert until its endpoint. Re-entry, suppression, replacement, dispelling, copying or recovery prevention never rerolls/refills the reserve or restores spent uses. Suppression prevents drawing while applicable and does not pause duration; if drawing was already committed, a subsequent actual prevention leaves its amount/use spent. This fixed nonphysical resonance cannot be carried as water, harvested, sold, used as Supply, drawn at range or treated as a pooled RP maximum. It provides no physical support, hazard or damage despite the historical Damage tag. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F and a pool from which allies draw 1d4 RP. CONFLICT RULING: finite 1-minute nonconcentration pool replaces Instantaneous metadata; Damage tag grants no unprinted damage. NEW: one rolled total reserve, explicit Action/5-foot draw, caster inclusion, positive committed withdrawals and distinct creation/receipt limits per beneficial long rest. Source supplied no daily limit; both anti-farm limits are explicitly provisional additions, not recovered canon.

It has no unstated Light, Finesse, Thrown, Versatile, Reach or other weapon property. Its attacks count as magical weapon attacks with the chosen physical type. On each successful hit compare the current wielder's actual current canonical alignment to that target's actual current alignment. At least one recorded exact opposite axis (Lawful/Chaotic or Good/Evil) adds 1d6 of the chosen physical damage type to that hit. Neutral is not opposite. Unrecorded/unknown axes supply no opposition; one recorded opposite axis suffices when the other is unknown. Records may be known to the Director without being known to the wielder. A normal critical doubles the base 1d6 and any qualifying alignment 1d6, while Strength remains flat.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The bonus applies per qualifying hit, with no invented once-turn cap. Ordinary Attack Actions, actual Extra Attack, opportunity attacks and weapon riders apply only when their own requirements accept this weapon. A change of wielder changes later alignment comparisons but refreshes no resource. No alignment announcement, personality/belief change, oath ruling, forced allegiance or magical secret report is produced; observers may make ordinary deductions from damage/events. One weapon per caster; ordinary handing, dropping, disarming, anatomy and custody apply. At 0 HP or concentration end it disappears. It is not autonomous, saleable, crafting material, ammunition or permanent inventory. For this card, if generic suppression suppresses spell effects without removing conjured objects, the weapon remains usable at its base physical 1d6 profile but loses magical-weapon qualification and alignment bonus until suppression ends; duration/concentration obligations continue. A source explicitly dismissing conjured objects overrides that default. Suppression ending restores only properties of the still-existing unexpired weapon, not lost HP, duration, spent actions or previous-hit riders. These are native HP objects; no Integrity track or HP/Integrity conversion is supplied. Damage/effects must actually be able to affect the relevant object; having HP grants no creature eligibility. No unstated resistance, immunity or organic-target eligibility is supplied. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

NEW: reviewed Minor Weapon base physical profile, finite 1-minute concentration instead of Instantaneous metadata, current-wielder/current-target two-axis comparison, exact per-hit rider/critical handling and suppression default confined to this card. A missing axis is never guessed from species, faction, appearance or player beliefs.

### Elemental Displacement

**ID:** `elemental-displacement` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | Yourself or one willing ally you perceive within 5 feet and line of effect. Choose one unoccupied destination you perceive within 30 feet of that recipient. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** No roll. At resolution confirm the willing recipient remains eligible and the destination is within 30 feet of its then-current position and can legally contain its whole body. Teleport the recipient and its legal noncreature belongings atomically. If a required condition or exact teleport ward prevents this, no movement occurs and paid cast costs remain spent.

Worn, held and carried noncreature property in lawful physical custody travels with the recipient, including legally melded possessions under the existing body/equipment rules. The recipient must satisfy its actual carrying and anatomy rules; the spell creates no extra capacity or free equipment transfer. No other creature travels with it: neither a grappled target, carried body, passenger nor mount. Such a creature remains at the origin with its own actual custody and position; ordinary lost support or released grapple consequences then apply. The recipient traverses no intervening terrain, spends no Speed and provokes no ordinary opportunity attack. Speed0 alone does not prevent teleportation.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The caster must perceive the arrival space, but no clear physical path or line of effect through the intervening terrain to that destination is required; this explicit destination exception permits teleporting past a visible transparent barrier, subject to exact wards. Direct selection of an allied recipient still requires 5 feet and line of effect. Arrival in unsupported open space is legal if the body fits; ordinary Falling begins if it lacks actual flight/hover/support. A blocked, occupied or otherwise illegal arrival fails without splitting bodies, dropping selected gear, damaging matter or finding a different square. No residual portal, planar travel, attack, action, RP refresh, clock reset or return trip is granted. <a id="spell-summon-spectral-steed"></a>

### Summon Spectral Steed

**ID:** `summon-spectral-steed` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One unoccupied space you perceive within range and line of effect large enough to contain the mount. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier at concentration end or steed0 HP. |

**Resolution:** No creation roll. A commanded Planar Crossing uses the steed's Action and its one crossing attempt. Spend that use when the attempt starts. It teleports the steed, any eligible mounted rider and permitted gear together to a specific known site on another plane, or fails safely at origin if arrival is illegal or an exact ward blocks it. Failure does not refund the attempt or actions and reveals no reason or hidden coordinates.

Create a Large noncombat spectral mount: AC 14, HP 30, walking Speed60, body mass 500 pounds, saves equal to owner PB, other checks+0, ordinary sight/hearing; it understands the owner's spoken commands without speech or telepathy. It acts immediately after the owner. An owner Bonus Action command within 60 feet and perceptible to it permits movement plus Dodge, Dash or Planar Crossing; Dash uses the ordinary movement-budget rules. It shares the owner-wide companion command allowance but supplies no damaging Action. Uncommanded it may move defensively and Dodge. It may carry one willing Medium-or-smaller rider plus that rider's legally carried noncreature gear, within 350 pounds AND 12 Load total. Count the rider's effective body weight plus every item once; count body casualty Load (Tiny 1.5/Small 3/Medium 6) plus all gear Load, including melded gear. At 6–12 Load it is Burdened under BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md: Speed reduced10 feet and relevant check disadvantage. These fixed capacities do not imply a Strength score. Mounting requires an Action while adjacent to the stationary steed and within both capacities. Dismounting voluntarily requires an Action while it is stationary, to a legal adjacent space; this Action includes that placement. While riding, select one 5-foot portion of the steed's footprint as the rider's position; it moves with that portion, without free repositioning among its squares. Other positioning requires actual legal movement/actions. If the steed disappears or the rider can no longer legally ride, the rider remains at their current rider position and ordinary support/Falling applies; use the body guide's minimum adjacent placement rule if a persistent steed/obstruction makes that position illegal, never teleport through a barrier. An imposed excess load or anatomy change cannot be vetoed to preserve riding.

For Planar Crossing, the owner chooses one specific arrival site on a different plane that they personally visited or can uniquely identify from a reliable map, description or established source. The command authorizes the attempt; the steed spends its Action after the owner. A mounted rider must still willingly accept and fit the capacity/anatomy rules. An unladen steed may also cross. Arrival needs legal space for the whole mount and rider; ordinary support requirements apply, so unsupported arrival leads to Falling rather than hover. Distance to the destination is not limited by the 60-foot summoning/command range. The spell provides the interplanar transition itself without requiring an existing portal, but no same-plane teleport. The group moves atomically, preserving relative rider position, belongings, conditions and ongoing clocks. Nothing is left in a between-planes buffer. No portal remains for followers.

**Scaling:** Only its expressly printed owner-PB saves change. Fixed AC 14/HP 30/Speed60 before ordinary burden/conditions,350 lb/12 Load capacity and one crossing do not automatically scale.

**Limits:** One Spectral Steed per caster; one crossing attempt per steed. Resummoning requires a new legal paid cast and new mounting/commands, never a free refresh. This profile grants no attack, autonomous opportunity attack, Help advantage, flight, hover, phase movement, special senses, resistance/immunity, spellcasting, sale value, loot, corpse or resource trigger. It cannot carry a second creature or independent casualty inside a bag, nor substitute cargo-only hauling for the printed rider-and-gear role. No additional carrying capacity, gear ownership change or magical location search is supplied. Its known destination need not be visible or in originating line of effect; the explicit interplanar exception is still subject to actual arrival legality and written blockers. The command must be valid at attempt start; crossing itself does not cancel that already committed command because distance/plane then changes. Future commands require their own actual range/perception. Concentration is not given an extra plane/range tether; clocks continue. Dismissal does not return or delete riders/property. Travel may avoid a geographic route segment but does not settle claims, contamination, law, Opening time or Extraction by declaration. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F/concentration 1 minute and a mount that truly travels between planes. NEW: complete finite mount/riding/command/crossing profile and one attempt, known-site eligibility and atomic custody. REVIEWED CORRECTION: source conference proposed6 Load, but reviewed BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md assigns a Medium transported body 6 Load before equipment. Use 12 Load total with unchanged350 lb ceiling, counting the body and applying ordinary Burdened at 6 Load. This explicitly changes the NEW proposal to support the promised rider plus gear; it is not a source-derived number. All fixed profile values require human balance review.

<a id="spell-resonance-conduit"></a>

### Resonance Conduit

**ID:** `resonance-conduit` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | Two distinct willing creatures with actual RP pools, each perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. You may be one participant. Each participant must be free of another active Resonance Conduit. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier with concentration or either participant willingly ending the link. |

**Resolution:** Automatic link creation, no RP transfer from the casting itself. Either participant may spend an Action to transfer a positive integer of existing RP to the other while both are on the same plane, within 60 feet of one another and have line of effect. At transfer start the recipient must accept; choose an amount no greater than donor currentRP or recipient currently missingRP. Commit the Action and immediately deduct that amount from the donor. At resolution credit the same amount, capped at recipient actual maximumRP; any newly excess amount is lost.

The two creatures retain separate RP pools and maxima. Deducted pendingRP is not spendable by either party and cannot be committed again; only a completed credit enters the recipient's pool. At resolution the link and recipient acceptance must still exist and same-plane/range/line-of-effect gates must still hold. If an exact interrupt or loss of these conditions prevents the transfer after commitment, its RP and Action are not refunded. Ordinary movement outside the transfer gate suspends permission without ending the link or pausing duration; returning restores only future permission. Either participant may voluntarily end the whole link without an Action, including before agreeing to a new conduit; ending one participant's link releases both, but never reverses completed or committed transfers. The caster can maintain only one conduit and each participant can belong to only one at a time.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The original cast pays its own 5 RP base cost and applicable surcharges before the link exists; future transfer cannot finance it retroactively. Transferring is not casting, recovery from rest or creation of RP. Casting/Dissonance/Refrain/resource-generation hooks do not apply unless an exact feature expressly names Conduit transfer. No joint maximum, discounts on the transfer amount, overflow store, negative balance, duplicate credits, borrowed casting rights, simultaneous double spending, future recovery, HP, charges or materials. Copies cannot duplicate transfers or create spendable RP. No daily limit is added; named recovery ledgers, Dissonance, Refrain, actions and clocks remain unchanged. Suppression prevents transfer while applicable without pausing the endpoint; it never refunds a committed transfer. Renewed consent alone cannot revive an ended application. A later legal casting may create a new Resonance Conduit normally, paying all costs and establishing a new application and endpoint. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F and RP sharing between allies. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes a NEW finite 1 minute concentration permission rather than an indefinite shared pool. NEW: two participants/one link each, Action transfer, actual-pool conservation,60 foot same-plane/line-of-effect gate, commitment/no-refund timing, current-cap clipping and explicit participant withdrawal.

<a id="spell-faction-portal"></a>

### Faction Portal

**ID:** `faction-portal` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One legal open local entrance space you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, on suitable ground. Choose one exact canonical factionId with a recorded current reputation score above 0 and one specific known headquarters of that faction. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends. |

**Resolution:** No roll. On successful casting create one visible, fixed, one-way doorway 5 feet wide and8 feet high. The destination is a known established public/default receiving point for the chosen headquarters, or, absent such a point, one specific known ordinary primary entrance/foyer. Identify it from personal experience or reliable public information; no existing portal infrastructure is needed. It may be on the same or another plane. Recheck each actual crossing against legal arrival space and exact teleport/planar blockers; failure leaves the crossing creature and belongings at the local entrance, with no split or deletion.

Any creature that physically fits the entrance under ordinary anatomy/squeezing rules may use it; passengers need no positive reputation or faction membership. Entering costs 5 feet of ordinary movement, subject to ordinary movement-cost adjustments, and atomically transports that creature and its legally carried belongings to a legal unoccupied space at or adjacent to the chosen receiving point. Ordinary carried creatures may accompany it only within the carrier's actual anatomy, pound and Load capacity and with room for the whole arriving group; this does not create willing-target immunity against being actually carried. Choose the receiving point when casting and keep it fixed. At each crossing use the nearest legal space at/adjacent to that point that fits the whole group, with a fixed neutral board order for ties, never a tactical remote choice or search through barriers. If none exists, the crossing fails and the attempted movement remains spent. Ordinary approach movement can provoke opportunity attacks; the teleport transition itself cannot. Items carried through remain the same items with actual ownership, contents, conditions and provenance. Loose unattended objects do not independently activate transit: a creature must physically carry or legally handle them as part of its own crossing; thrown projectiles, remote pushes and spells cannot deliver goods through by themselves.

The doorway is opaque to sight and sound and supplies no line of effect through it. Attacks, spells, areas, projectiles and remote sensing do not pass. There is no exit doorway or automatic return route. Complete a currently resolving legal crossing atomically before closing/suppressing the doorway; expiry never bisects a body or cargo. Later crossings require the still-active doorway. Suppression makes it unusable without pausing its endpoint. It has no physical HP, support or barrier body; when inactive there is no active transit surface. One portal per caster; a successful replacement closes the old one. Current positive reputation is checked as a creation gate at cast start and resolution, not a continuing passenger credential; a later standing change does not itself close a created portal.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Use the actual canonical reputation record: positive means above 0, normally+1 through+3 under REPUTATION.md; missing/0/negative standing fails the gate. This card does not replace that scale with the historical Gameplay Loop's -5..+5 scale. No faction membership, Seal invocation permission, headquarters infrastructure or automatic entry authorization is added. If there are several HQs, select exactly one known site; no hidden vault, secret room, unknown HQ, location search or knowledge report. The far endpoint needs no originating line of sight/effect and has no geographic range ceiling, but actual wards and legal placement still apply. A headquarters that ceases to exist or belong to the faction cannot receive new crossings; a purely clerical name change does not move the chosen physical point. Failed crossings reveal no cause beyond failure, although ordinary observers may draw inferences. The spell can bypass a geographic route leg and deliver people to Haven when that actual HQ is there. It never automatically completes Extraction, advances or resets the Opening clock, settles cargo claims, removes contamination, changes ownership/reputation, grants credentials, ignores guards/laws/taxes or refunds cast costs. No free actions, additional capacity, object duplication or attacker path across planes. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F, doorway to a faction headquarters with positive reputation, actual planar travel supported by Planar tag. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes NEW 1 minute concentration for a usable doorway. NEW: known ordinary receiving-site procedure, fixed one-way 5 x 8 ft entrance, local 5 foot movement cost, whole-group atomic arrival, opaque transport-only interface, any-passenger use, no later reputation tether and exact destination legality. Canon positive predicate is retained without silently changing the reputation scale; route bypass remains possible while actual settlement procedures persist.

### Guiding Spark

**ID:** `guiding-spark` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | Self; nearest eligible magical presence within 30 feet for detection mode | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** None.

Choose one mode. True North: immediately know the direction of true north from your current position. Magical Presence: if an active magical effect, magical creature aura, or magical object exists within 30 feet on the same plane and is not protected from divination, learn the direction of the nearest such presence, but not its identity, school, strength, distance, owner, or exact nature.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Magical Presence does not penetrate effects explicitly blocking divination and does not reveal protected/secret facts, hidden identities, intentions, traps, exact locations, or paths through barriers. If multiple presences are equally near, learn that there is a tie but not their count unless directly perceptible. Repeated cantrip casts use shared Refrain rules.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. ### Predict Movement

**ID:** `predict-movement` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within 30 feet | Until the end of your next regular turn or until consumed |

**Resolution:** None.

Choose attack or Dexterity save when cast. Before the duration ends, the target adds +1 to its next attack roll or next Dexterity save of the chosen kind; that roll consumes the benefit. The target must commit to applying it before the roll.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Choice cannot be changed after casting. Multiple Predict Movement effects do not stack; a new cast replaces the prior one. Cannot be applied after seeing the result of the roll. Grants no extra Action, movement, reroll, AC, or foreknowledge beyond the +1. Repeated cantrip casts use shared Refrain rules.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. The beneficial source effect does not call for a hostile Dexterity save despite Core resolution metadata. Retain Core30ft range; consuming the bonus before end of next turn operationalizes an otherwise instantaneous future-roll benefit. GPT conference: target is one willing creature, not self-only.

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |

**Resolution:** None.

For the duration, understand the literal semantic meaning of ordinary spoken and written languages you perceive within 30 feet. You do not gain the ability to speak or write those languages unless you already could.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

### Locate Object

**ID:** `locate-object` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; one specific object personally familiar to you through at least 1 minute of prior direct observation or handling | Concentration, up to 10 minutes |

**Resolution:** None.

If the specified familiar object is within 1,000 feet on the same plane and is not protected from divination, sense the direction from you to its current location. The directional sense updates while the spell lasts.

**Scaling:** None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.

**Limits:** Provides direction only, not exact distance, route, floor, container, bearer identity, object condition, surrounding creatures, or a path around barriers. **Design decisions:** Conference decision: casting range0/self is separate from the source effect's1000ft detection radius. Preserve conflicting Universal30ft metadata as evidence. Ten-minute concentration and familiarity threshold are provisional specifications; no exact location, distance or hidden properties are revealed.

<a id="spell-stitch-fate"></a>

### Stitch Fate

**ID:** `stitch-fate` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 120 ft | One living dying creature at 0 HP you can perceive within range and line of effect. Dead and Stable creatures are ineligible. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** Choose one mode before paying. Unravel Failure requires at least one recorded failed death save and removes one failure. Stitch Life clears death-save counters and restores 1 HP as direct state recovery.

Unravel Failure leaves the creature dying at 0 HP with its other recorded successes/failures intact. Stitch Life restores a living dying creature to 1 HP, ending its zero-HP dying state. If a broad cannot-regain-HP effect blocks that 1 HP, instead clear its death counters, make it Stable at 0, and roll its ordinary d4-hour recovery deadline from now. A still-active HP prohibition can defer that eventual recovery; damage or death cancels it normally.

**Scaling:** None. The spell changes only one recorded failure or the defined 1-HP state recovery.

**Limits:** An Action cannot interrupt or retroactively change a completed death. This is not resurrection or ordinary HP healing; ordinary healing bonuses/halves do not alter the 1-HP state value. It removes no Wounds, Corruption, class Curse, conditions, debt or spent-resource consequences. Normal class access, RP, Dissonance, Refrain, components and countering rules apply. No refund after a legally paid cast is countered or fails at resolution.

**Design decisions:** Core Divination rank8, 21RP, Action, 120ft, V/S/F and Instantaneous are preserved. Source says change one failed death save or auto-revive a dying target. NEW: two explicit modes; recorded-failure removal instead of a retroactive reroll; living-dying eligibility; 1-HP state recovery and blocked-recovery Stable bridge. Reviewed operational playtest overlay; provisional design decisions remain labeled NEW.

<a id="spell-foresight-flicker"></a>

### Foresight Flicker

**ID:** `foresight-flicker` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self. | Up to 1 minute, until consumed; no concentration. If applied in initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; outside initiative, ends 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve its virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and death; an already-passed start does not count. |

**Resolution:** The next eligible hostile d20 roll against you has disadvantage. Establish eligibility and consume this pending benefit before the roll, even if advantage cancels it or another source already imposes disadvantage. You cannot inspect the result before deciding whether to consume it.

An eligible roll is an attack targeting you or a hostile opposed/task check made directly against you as its opposing subject. Hostility is established from ordinary information available to you, not a magical allegiance report. A saving throw against your spell or feature is not a roll against you for this purpose. If one legal d20 roll affects you and other creatures together, disadvantage applies to that single roll for its whole resolution; do not reroll a separate version for the others.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.

**Limits:** One pending Foresight Flicker per caster across classes; successful recasting replaces the old benefit. Advantage/disadvantage combines normally and never supplies an automatic miss. No damage-die modifier, initiative bonus, retrospective reroll, future-event report, attack cancellation or action denial. The benefit changes an eligible roll without disclosing hidden information about its maker; an information-only divination ward is not immunity to this roll modifier. One successful application owns its endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove its replacement. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement and refunds no committed casting cost or strain. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S and disadvantage on the next enemy roll against you. CONFLICT RULING: functional Self range replaces raw30-foot metadata without adding an ally target. NEW: one-minute pending window, exact hostile d20 eligibility, pre-roll consumption and shared-roll handling.

<a id="spell-omen-whisper"></a>

### Omen Whisper

**ID:** `omen-whisper` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature, object or location you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; alternatively, one specific course of action you are considering beginning within the next minute in the current situation. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** No roll. The Director gives one brief, truthful, cryptic but usable phrase or sentence about the most immediately relevant circumstance, danger, opportunity or likely consequence connected to the chosen subject or proposed action.

Only you perceive and understand the whisper. It supplies a supernatural clue from current circumstances, including relevant hidden circumstances when their disclosure is permitted; it is not merely a cosmetic noise. Its wording may be symbolic but must convey a usable clue rather than deliberately contradict the relevant facts. No deity, spirit, speaker or binding promise is established. Recasting a materially equivalent inquiry about the same subject or proposed action while the materially relevant circumstances remain unchanged gives the same omen or a restatement, without cumulative extra detail. This equivalence applies across casters: rephrasing the inquiry, passing it to another caster, or subdividing it solely to extract additional detail about the same issue does not create new information. A genuinely different material question about that subject, or a material change in circumstances, may produce a different omen.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.

**Limits:** It does not guarantee future decisions, dice or events not yet caused, compel anyone to enact a predicted outcome, reveal a whole stat block/inventory/plot or automatically succeed at a task. New voluntary actions or genuinely new causes may make a previously truthful omen obsolete. Rephrasing the same inquiry, switching casters or serially subdividing it does not create extra information from an unchanged omen; use the same materially equivalent subject/circumstance boundary. No additional daily use cap is added. If all relevant information is specifically protected, the Director gives only an uninformative opaque omen without naming the protection; permitted information about other subjects remains available. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S/instantaneous and a cryptic supernatural tip. NEW: bounded subject/action input, one truthful usable private clue, current-circumstances scope and no incremental detail for materially repeated inquiry. No universal future-certainty or spirit-contact ability.

<a id="spell-far-echo"></a>

### Far Echo

**ID:** `far-echo` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One point you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; its capture area is a 5-foot-radius sphere. | One replay lasting at most 6 elapsed seconds; no concentration. The fixed playback window does not restart with initiative. |

**Resolution:** No roll. Sample the 6 elapsed seconds immediately before this cast began, excluding its own V component. Retrieve speech produced within the chosen capture sphere that was actually audible at its center during that historical window. Immediately replay that eligible speech once from the chosen point over the original relative timing.

Preserve the original language, approximate voice, overlapping speakers and relative volume as heard at the sampled center; listeners use ordinary hearing rules at the replay point. A quiet source remains quiet and overlapping voices remain overlapping. The spell neither isolates a speaker nor translates, authenticates, identifies or interprets speech. Speech that could not actually be heard at the historical center because of silence, sound-blocking barriers or other actual causes is absent. If no eligible speech occurred, the replay is silence. The Director needs only the relevant recent fictional speech facts, not a continuous audio engine.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.

**Limits:** The selected sphere is fixed for this cast and the historical window cannot be moved to an older time or another plane. Far Echo replay sounds cannot themselves supply source speech for another Far Echo. Current applicable divination protection can withhold new information about a protected subject from this retrieval; it does not erase the historical event, previously known speech or ordinary recordings. The replay creates no creature or new spell components and provides no magical command, oath, consent or proof of truth. Ordinary listeners may still hear and react to the sound. It creates no permanent recording item or increasing volume loop. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S and replay of the last6seconds of speech in a location. NEW: exact5-foot sphere, eligible speech produced there and audible at its center, pre-cast sample window, once-only ordinary-audible playback, no recursive Far Echo source. Core Instantaneous metadata becomes a finite at-most6-second replay without concentration. The precise capture predicate is an exact-card completion for review.

<a id="spell-soul-mark"></a>

### Soul Mark

**ID:** `soul-mark` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect that is not currently Dead or destroyed. An active Undead or Construct qualifies if its actual rules classify it as a creature; those tags alone do not make it ineligible. Objects and corpses are not eligible merely because they once were creatures. | 1 minute, no concentration. If applied in initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; outside initiative, ends 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve its virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and death; an already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if the marked creature dies, is destroyed, or its summoned existence ends. Mere travel out of range or to another plane does not end the mark. |

**Resolution:** No save. Apply one invisible, nonphysical mark to the selected creature. While that marked creature is on your plane and within 1 mile (5,280 feet), you continuously sense its direction from your current position, including meaningful vertical bearing.

The direction is a bearing, not its distance, exact coordinates, room, route, appearance, surroundings or condition. Ordinary cover and walls after application do not block the sense. A specific divination/masking protection applies to its actual scope; a blocked read supplies no bearing. Beyond 1 mile or on another plane also gives no bearing, without distinguishing why. Shapechange, disguise and appearance changes retain the same creature identity and do not detach or transfer the mark. Death, destruction or the ending of the marked summon’s existence ends this application. It does not resume on revival, reconstruction or resummoning and does not track a corpse, detached soul or replacement body. A shapechange that retains the same continuing creature identity does not by itself count as death, destruction or an ended summoned existence.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.

**Limits:** One active Soul Mark per caster across classes; successful recasting replaces it. Other casters may independently mark the same creature with their own endpoints. Protection from Scrying blocks the new directional information while applicable, not automatically the noninformational existence of this mark; an otherwise surviving mark can again report direction when protection ends. Expiry/death never leaves a removable item or corpse beacon. No condition, allegiance, identity-change announcement, precise location, passage through a wall or ownership of the target is granted. One successful application owns its endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove its replacement. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement and refunds no committed casting cost or strain. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,1minute tag and direction within1mile. NEW: creature-versus-corpse and death/destruction/summon-end boundary; no Undead/Construct exclusion based only on type, same-plane bearing, nonphysical marker, ordinary-wall continuation, independent caster records and explicit no-information result. No concentration or saving throw is added.

<a id="spell-sense-alignment"></a>

### Sense Alignment

**ID:** `sense-alignment` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature or object you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** No save. Privately receive a snapshot of the target's actual current canonical Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic and Good/Neutral/Evil axes. Each recorded axis is reported, including Director-hidden records if unprotected. An undefined or unrevealed-through-protection axis reads Indeterminate, never a guessed value.

An object is Unaligned unless it itself has an explicit alignment record. An aligned object is read by the same two-axis procedure; its owner, creator, faction, material, logo or visual theme does not confer alignment on it. Evaluate actual protection before drawing an Unaligned conclusion: a protected answer cannot be converted into a claim that the record is absent. A protection affecting only one axis leaves the other independently reportable when permitted. An actual masking source may alter the output only if its exact rules authorize doing so.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.

The historical Movement tag grants no movement or teleport. <a id="spell-glimpse-future"></a>

### Glimpse Future

**ID:** `glimpse-future` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self. | Instantaneous glimpse plus a pending initiative benefit for up to 1 minute, until consumed; no concentration. If applied in initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; outside initiative, ends 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve its virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and death; an already-passed start does not count. |

**Resolution:** No roll. On resolution the Director gives a brief qualitative glimpse of the most likely events during the next 6 seconds if current circumstances continue. Separately, your next new initiative roll during the pending window has advantage; consume the entitlement on that roll even if another source already supplies advantage.

The glimpse may concern imminent motion, an approach, attack, collapse, hazard or lack of meaningful immediate change. It is a limited current-circumstances projection, not a full transcript or future die result. Future choices and new events remain capable of changing it. The initiative benefit can apply to the next actual new combat initiative roll before its endpoint, including if that combat begins more than 6 seconds after casting. It cannot modify or reroll initiative already established for the current encounter.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.

**Limits:** One pending Glimpse Future initiative benefit per creature across classes; successful recasting replaces rather than accumulates it. If no qualifying roll occurs before expiry, the benefit is lost. Merely calling an ongoing scene a new combat does not grant another initiative roll or reset resources. Applicable information protection can hide details of the glimpse without automatically canceling the separate initiative modifier. This supplies no party-wide warning mechanic, free Action, completed task, condition removal, RP, round reset or guaranteed sequence of future choices. One successful application owns its endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove its replacement. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement and refunds no committed casting cost or strain. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S, six-second future glimpse and advantage on initiative for next combat. CONFLICT RULING: functional Self replaces raw30-foot metadata without ally access; Core Instantaneous glimpse is separated from NEW finite1-minute pending initiative entitlement. No concentration is added.
