**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save against your actual spell DC. Success gives no thought. Failure gives one immediate thought occupying its conscious attention at resolution, if such a thought exists and is not specifically protected. This spell grants no option to waive the save; any independently authorized save-failure rule retains its own scope.

Receive one brief phrase, image, emotion, sensory impression or simple idea. A verbal thought retains the language in which the target frames it; unknown words remain unintelligible without independent language comprehension. Nonverbal images and feelings are perceived as such, not automatically translated into a precise proposition. An actually unconscious creature has no conscious surface thought to supply. Ordinary sleep does not make its dreams eligible without an exact rule granting that permission. Thought eligibility follows actual present mental state, not an assumed creature-type stereotype.

A later legal cast uses a fresh save and reads only the thought then actually current, with ordinary Refrain; repeated casting cannot turn one thought into a hidden biography or force the target to think about a chosen subject. A blocked or absent thought gives no reason distinguishing save, protection or current lack of thought. <a id="spell-detect-weather"></a>

### Detect Weather

**ID:** `detect-weather` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One point you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect, on your current plane. | Instantaneous information about the following 24 hours; no continuing buff or concentration. |

**Resolution:** No roll. The Director gives an accurate 24-hour forecast for the local outdoor region within 1 mile horizontally of that point on the same plane. Describe meaningful local variations when the terrain makes the region's weather differ. An indoor or underground point refers to the outdoor local weather above/around that same geographical location rather than the room's climate.

Report relevant temperature bands/trends, precipitation type and approximate timing, wind direction/strength, weather-caused visibility and significant storm or environmental-weather hazards. The report is intelligible to the caster and accurate for the current natural processes and already-existing magical weather expected to continue; record the forecast as the current weather expectation. A weatherless environment reports that fact. It supplies useful specific conditions rather than a vague warning that weather might change.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.

**Limits:** A genuinely new later cause, such as a voluntary weather-changing spell, new supernatural event or catastrophe, can change actual conditions after the forecast without having been predicted. The Director must identify an actual intervening cause in the game record, not silently invalidate the forecast by rerolling unchanged weather; this need not reveal that cause to the caster. The spell does not control weather, grant exposure protection, reveal encounters/loot, complete travel, recover resources or predict unrelated events. Information about a specifically protected subject remains limited by that actual protection; ordinary ambient weather is not automatically protected by a creature standing in it. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S/instantaneous and accurate next24-hour weather prediction. NEW: finite1-mile local outdoor region, explicit indoor reference, forecast fields and current-processes/future-agency boundary. This is a tabletop forecast record, not a claim a weather simulation is implemented.

This magical sight reveals the creature itself sufficiently for ordinary sight-dependent targeting. It ends Hidden from you and removes Invisible’s own unseen attack modifiers for you under the current Core known-position exception. Solid opaque barriers and total cover still block the view. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. <a id="spell-warning-ward"></a>

### Warning Ward

**ID:** `warning-ward` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One point on solid ground or a suitable immobile surface that you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier with concentration; no glow survives the ward. |

**Resolution:** No roll. At each actual outside-to-inside entry, the Director determines whether that creature has an actual current hostile relationship toward you in the encounter/campaign state. A qualifying entry starts or refreshes the visible signal for 6 elapsed seconds from that entry, capped by the ward’s own endpoint.

Place one faintly visible magical sigil watching a fixed area 10 feet in radius and 10 feet high above its surface. Qualifying hostility may be secret if it is an actual current fictional fact; do not infer it from species, alignment, faction, reputation, appearance or suspicion. Undefined hostility does not become hostile merely to trigger the spell. Entry includes voluntary movement, forced movement and teleportation that actually occupies the area. Creation around an already-present creature is not entry; it must leave and reenter. Ordinary intervening cover within the area does not prevent physical entry from triggering, but a protection blocking the creature’s new Divination information can prevent its trigger. During a signal the mark is self-luminous and visible under ordinary line-of-sight rules; it does not illuminate surrounding squares. Its only direct report is that at least one qualifying entry occurred recently. Repeated entries refresh the same signal, without separate counted pulses or a stored log.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.

**Limits:** One Warning Ward per caster. The area stays fixed; moving or destroying its supporting surface ends the ward rather than making a portable detector. Ending concentration or suppressing the ward prevents new signals and removes its visible glow; suppression does not pause the ward’s duration or replay missed entries when it ends. A formerly signaled entry is not a new entry just because suppression ends. No damage, restraint, sound alarm, creature outline, square, count, identity, type, statistics or detailed intention is reported. Actual observers can make ordinary inferences from the glow and its timing. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/concentration1minute, a trap glowing on enemy entry and no damage; Core M/F follows shared F interpretation. NEW: fixed 10-foot-radius/height region, actual-hostility predicate, no trigger on creation, and signal lasting exactly 6 elapsed seconds rather than an ambiguous turn marker. Exact-card completion specifies self-luminous-only signal, ordinary-cover entry behavior, suppression and moved-surface endings.

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. On success you learn nothing. On failure privately learn one actual currently dominant deep desire or fear in the chosen category, subject to specific information protection.

The result is an intelligible concept, not necessarily a verbal quotation, and does not require a shared language. It is a fundamental motive rather than only the creature’s passing mood. ### Mark Omen

**ID:** `mark-omen` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; creature type alone adds no exclusion. | Up to 1 hour, until consumed; no concentration. Expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application, regardless of initiative changes, absence, death or planar travel. Ends earlier when the marked creature dies, is destroyed or its summoned existence ends. |

**Resolution:** No initial save. Once while the mark lasts, when you make an attack against that creature, you may consume the mark after the complete initial attack d20 result is visible but before hit/miss resolution. This costs no additional Action or Reaction. Replace the entire attack d20 procedure using the original modifiers and advantage/disadvantage state; use the replacement result even if worse.

The mark is invisible and nonphysical. A two-d20 advantage/disadvantage attack receives a complete new two-d20 set and the ordinary higher/lower selection; a single-d20 attack receives one new d20. Do not reroll damage or modifiers. Resolve natural 1, natural 20, expanded critical eligibility and the hit/miss result only from the final attack result under their actual rules. The attack must already be legal under its own range, sight and line-of-effect requirements; the mark adds no continuing 30-foot tether, tracking information or new targeting permission. One active Mark Omen per caster; a successful new mark replaces the old one. Different casters can independently mark a creature for their own attacks.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.

**Limits:** Ordinary shapechange retaining creature identity does not remove the mark. Actual death, destruction or ended summoned existence ends it; revival/reconstruction/resummoning does not revive that application. Information-only protection does not itself cancel this noninformational reroll permission. No ammo, RP, component, class use or other original attack cost is refunded or charged again, and the replaced result produces no separate hit/miss/on-hit outcome. A legally committed mark stays spent if an exact later interrupt prevents completion. Mark Omen and Fate Coin share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from either of these two spells, across all casters, coins, marks and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these two spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use a fixed neutral table order chosen before the roll. Only the first legal commitment spends a mark/coin; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Specific Divination protection can withhold new information about its subject while leaving unprotected ambient sounds available. The point is an ongoing magical effect that may be detected or ended only by another effect whose actual targeting, range and permissions apply; it has no physical body or HP.

Ordinary ambient silence is not proof of an empty room, and a blocked read reveals no reason. The point is not a creature, object, scout, summoned ear, portable token or loot. Duration continues during suppression. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. **Resolution:** Conjure one noncurrency Tiny magical coin, AC10/HP1, mass0.01pound. A current holder with a usable hand may flip and expend it as a Reaction after the complete original roll event has been rolled and its die faces are available under ordinary table information rules, but before that roll's mechanical consequences are applied. Choose one physical die from that completed original roll and reroll only it. There is no separate heads/tails success test. The coin vanishes and its use commits when the legal Reaction begins.

The roll can belong to the holder, an ally or an enemy; no target consent is required. Its result must actually be available to the reacting player under the table’s normal information rules; the coin does not reveal secret rolls or fabricate perception. Choose one physical die from that original roll. Reroll only it and use the new face: for two-d20 advantage/disadvantage reselect the higher/lower normally; for a multi-die damage, healing or resource pool recompute the original total; for a single-die attack/check/save use its new face. All original modifiers, other dice, target selection and source rules remain. If the roll is shared across targets, use the same modified shared result for all of them. An initial Resonance Well reserve d4 may be changed before the reserve is established, but an already established reserve cannot be rerolled or refilled.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.

**Limits:** One active Fate Coin per caster; successful recasting replaces the previous unspent coin wherever it is. Ordinary handing/dropping/custody and hands apply; a handoff never refreshes the charge, endpoint or caster cap. The spell adds no separate one-coin-per-holder cap: several casters may supply distinct coins, still constrained by actual hands, Reactions and the shared roll guard. At0HP, expiry or replacement, this conjured coin vanishes without creating material; it is not currency, sellable stock or a component. Its native HP is not an Integrity conversion. Ordinary Reaction prohibitions apply. A prevented committed use is not refunded. No already-resolved hit, HP loss, healing, RP grant/transfer, cost or completed outcome can be reversed. The spell grants no character-generation rewrite, out-of-fiction table control, automatic access to hidden Director dice or extra reroll of the entire pool. Mark Omen and Fate Coin share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from either of these two spells, across all casters, coins, marks and recasts. ### Resonance Map

**ID:** `resonance-map` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; active magical-energy records within 30 feet, on the same plane and in line of effect. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** No roll. Receive one private spatial snapshot of qualifying magical-energy concentrations: their current locations and actual footprints/extents within the sensing area. Ordinary total cover excludes the blocked portion.

Qualifying sources are actual active spell effects, magical zones/fields, active auras and magical objects/effects with active magical-energy records. Where a source has an actual comparable source-defined magnitude, rank or intensity, represent that actual value; without a comparable value, show presence and extent without inventing power units or relative ranking. Multiple eligible footprints can overlap in the snapshot without being collapsed into a fabricated total strength. A mere RP pool is not itself an active aura unless its own source says so. The map can reveal an otherwise unseen magical effect’s position. If an unprotected attached aura gives away a Hidden/Invisible creature’s location, ordinary known-location consequences follow, but this spell does not grant sight of that creature’s body.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.

**Limits:** The footprint is clipped to the permitted sensing area; it does not map an entire distant effect merely because one edge is nearby. Information protection on a creature cannot be bypassed by relabeling its attached magic as independent; genuinely independent environmental magic remains separately eligible. No automatic spell name, owner, alignment, faction, charges, recipe, RP amount, harvest right, spell control or permanent map item. It does not track later movement or drain/recover energy. Remembering or writing the permitted snapshot uses ordinary memory and tools. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. ### Read Memories

**ID:** `read-memories` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect, consenting to share one specific memory or sufficiently narrow topic. | Instantaneous compressed memory experience |

**Resolution:** No save. Confirm willingness at cast start and again at resolution. The recipient selects an actual remembered episode satisfying the agreed specific consent. You experience up to one continuous minute of that episode through its remembered perspective. If consent is withdrawn or the memory does not exist, transfer nothing and refund no committed costs.

The recipient identifies the start of the selected continuous interval as part of consenting; you cannot silently append other memories or move to another topic. Receive the remembered sensory and subjective experience, including whatever the recipient actually remembers rather than an external reconstruction. Mistaken, incomplete, altered, implanted or biased memories remain such. Speech is experienced as remembered, with no independent translation of an unfamiliar language. An active Undead or Construct can qualify when it has actual memories and can willingly consent. An unconscious creature cannot supply current willing consent merely through someone else’s assertion.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.

**Limits:** Specific information protection can prevent new information from its protected subject even when that subject consents; willingness alone does not waive Protection from Scrying. This neither verifies objective history nor reveals facts absent from the memory. No forced reading, memory deletion/editing, persistent recording object, skill/proficiency download, completed crafting/research action, altered elapsed clock or free project progress. A later cast can share a different actually consented memory normally; no daily cap is added. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

<a id="spell-corruption-insight"></a>

### Corruption Insight

**ID:** `corruption-insight` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; alternatively, a fixed10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you perceive within30feet and line of effect. | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** No save. Examine one current qualifying Corruption record and privately report its actual type and proximate causal source. The two fields independently report Indeterminate when undefined or specifically protected. Report No Corruption only when no actual Corruption is present and no relevant protection prevents determining that fact.

Creature mode examines Corruption actually affecting that creature. Area mode examines environmental Corruption belonging to the selected area itself, within the sphere and line of effect to its center; it does not inspect every occupant merely for standing there. Type means the actual recorded category, type or name. Source means the immediate established cause responsible for that record, such as a spell, curse, artifact, creature effect, site or environmental source. An explicit Corrupted condition can supply that actual type, but does not by itself invent who or what caused it. If the caster already distinguishes a qualifying current record, they may select it. Otherwise the Director uses a fixed deterministic order recorded for those applications before answering; materially unchanged repeat casts return that record rather than rotating through hidden applications. A distinct known record can be selected on a later cast.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.

**Limits:** Do not extrapolate an immediate cause into an upstream conspirator, current owner/controller location, complete history or unknown actor identity. A source actor protected against the information cannot be exposed merely through its causal association; report the permissible cause/type fields without the protected detail. Undefined data is not proof of absence. No new numeric Corruption track, save DC, full statistics, cure, cleansing, alignment report, poison/disease/species inference, suppression or harvest permission. The spell supplies information only. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F/instantaneous and source/type of Corruption affecting a creature or area. NEW:10-foot environmental-area mode, one-record deterministic selection, proximate-source meaning, independent known/protected fields and clipped center-LoE. Existing Corrupted definition is evidence, not a new universal cause or taxonomy.

<a id="spell-augury"></a>

### Augury

**ID:** `augury` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; one specifically declared course of action you intend to begin within the next minute, judged against one concrete goal for you, your party or another identified beneficiary. | Instantaneous forecast; evaluates the 30 minutes following the proposed beginning of the course. |

**Resolution:** No roll. State the course, its intended beginning within 60 elapsed seconds of resolution, and its concrete goal or interest before receiving the answer. The Director privately answers exactly Yes, No or Unclear using the most likely material consequences under current circumstances during the 30 minutes following that proposed beginning.

Yes means the course is more likely than not to materially advance the stated goal. No means it is more likely than not to materially harm, frustrate or move away from that goal. Unclear means favorable and unfavorable consequences are materially balanced/mixed, the course is too contingent to favor either result, or information necessary for the judgment is undefined or protected. A course with no material effect on the stated goal is Unclear. Good/bad refers to this practical goal, not moral alignment or the Director’s preferred plot; a dangerous action that advances the goal can be Yes. Uncertainty alone is not grounds for Unclear when current evidence materially favors Yes or No.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.

**Limits:** This predicts rather than fixes destiny. Later voluntary choices, new events and die results can change the outcome. It reveals neither future dice nor a full causal explanation, hidden actor identities, room contents or a guaranteed plan. Materially equivalent course/goal inquiries under unchanged circumstances return the same answer across casters, rephrasing and repeated casts. Genuinely different courses/goals or materially changed circumstances may yield different answers. No additional daily cap applies. The answer does not identify which protection or missing fact caused Unclear. The one-minute beginning requirement is an inquiry condition, not a sustained magical deadline or obligation forcing the caster to act. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and Yes/No/Unclear outcome inquiry. CONFLICT RULING: Self informational mode replaces raw 30-foot metadata. NEW: concrete goal, beginning within one minute, 30-minute forecast horizon, stable equivalent inquiries and useful likelihood standard. Exact completion anchors the horizon to the declared beginning and treats materially neutral outcomes as Unclear.

<a id="spell-clairvoyance"></a>

### Clairvoyance

**ID:** `clairvoyance` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5280 ft | One uniquely designated fixed point on your plane within 1 mile; only you receive the selected remote sense. | 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** No roll. Choose Sight or Hearing when casting; this mode cannot change during the application. Designate the point through direct perception, prior personal knowledge, a reliable map/description, or a precise relative position from a known reference. A uniquely specified unseen point qualifies; an unspecified hidden room does not. No originating sight or line of effect to the point is required. A point inside solid matter is invalid and yields no feed.

Sight lets you perceive from that point in all directions with ordinary local lighting, visibility, cover and obscurity; it grants no darkvision, true sight, wall vision or borrowed creature senses. Hearing follows ordinary local sound paths, barriers, silence, distances and volumes. Your normal local senses continue simultaneously. Blindness suppresses remote Sight and Deafened suppresses remote Hearing while applicable. Maintain the same-plane, 5,280-foot tether between you and the point. Leaving that tether suppresses the feed without ending or pausing the duration; returning restores only current information. Actual subject/area Divination protections withhold protected information within their scope, leaving independently readable information available.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.

**Limits:** One active Clairvoyance point per caster; a successful new cast replaces the old point. The point remains at its chosen location and cannot move, follow a creature or surface, or search through rooms; all-direction sight permits looking from that one point, not translating it. It is a nonphysical ongoing magical effect without HP, affected only by another effect with actual permission to detect, suppress or end it. Suppression pauses no clock and records no backlog. No remote attacks, interaction, spellcasting origin, line of effect for another power, translation, identity authentication, persistent recording object or replay is granted. A dark/silent/blocked feed does not diagnose its cause. A successful replacement owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. <a id="spell-vision-trap"></a>

### Vision Trap

**ID:** `vision-trap` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect and currently treat as an enemy from ordinary information. | Instantaneous damage; disorientation lasts until consumed or the end of the target’s first future regular turn, whichever comes first; no concentration. |

**Resolution:** The target makes an Intelligence save against your spell DC. Roll 2d6 psychic damage once. Failure: full rolled damage and disadvantage on its next attack roll before the rider’s endpoint. Success: floor(rolled damage / 2) psychic damage and no new disorientation rider. Apply actual damage defenses normally after determining full or half damage.

The false mental sight produces only this brief disorientation. The first qualifying attack roll consumes the rider even when advantage cancels it or another effect already imposes disadvantage. If no attack occurs by the endpoint, it expires. Use the end marker of the target’s first future regular turn. If application occurs during the target’s current turn, exclude that entire current turn’s end, whether still upcoming or already in progress. Outside initiative the rider lasts at most 6 elapsed seconds; preserve its assigned virtual marker or deadline when initiative changes. At the endpoint, ordinary already-scheduled end-phase effects resolve before cleanup under shared timing. One pending Vision Trap rider per target across all casters. A later failed save replaces that rider with its new endpoint, without stacking; a later successful save creates no rider and does not erase an earlier one. Instantaneous damage still resolves separately for each legal cast.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.

**Limits:** Damage and rider are separate: psychic resistance or immunity can reduce/prevent damage without removing a rider from a failed save unless the actual defense covers that rider. Blindness, Undead or Construct type alone is not immunity; written mental/illusion/psychic defenses keep their own scope. Enemy selection uses your ordinary understanding and does not reveal secret hostility. The spell imposes no Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated, Frightened, whole-Action denial, forced movement, command, lasting false memory or arbitrary false message. It creates no persistent physical trap. Protection from Scrying does not block this noninformational damage/disorientation merely because the spell is Divination. A successful replacement owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S,F, false sight/disorientation and 2d6 psychic. NEW: INT save, half damage on success, finite next-attack disadvantage, ordinary enemy predicate and per-target replacement. Exact completion distinguishes a later failed-save rider from a successful-save cast, preserving an existing rider in the latter case.

### Locate Person

**ID:** `locate-person` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; designate one intended specific person through personal acquaintance or a reliable identity description/name intended to refer to one actual individual. | Instantaneous bearing |

**Resolution:** No save. After costs are committed, resolve whether the designation identifies one actual qualifying person and whether that person currently exists as an eligible creature on your plane within 5,280 feet with readable location information. If so, privately learn the direction, including meaningful vertical bearing. Otherwise receive no direction, without distinguishing ambiguity, death/destruction, range, plane, eligibility or protection. Ordinary walls, cover and lack of originating line of effect do not block a permitted bearing; no prior 30-foot mark or encounter is required.

Person is an individual-identity predicate, not automatically Humanoid or biologically living. An active Undead or Construct can qualify if the campaign treats it as that continuing person. A corpse or object does not qualify merely because it belonged to or once was a person. Ordinary shapechange or disguise retaining the same continuing identity does not defeat designation. You learn direction only, without distance, precise coordinates, floor/room, route, appearance, condition or companions. This is a snapshot at resolution; later movement is not updated.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.

**Limits:** If the designation is ambiguous, or the person is dead/destroyed, outside the mile, on another plane, not an eligible creature/person, or protected, receive no direction without learning which reason applies. A mistaken name that does not reliably identify one actual individual is not a search through possible matches. This spell creates no mark, tracking token, map, teleport permission, ongoing detection or proof of life from an absent bearing. Repeated legal paid casts can provide new snapshots subject to the same limits. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. NEW: unambiguous individual identification, continuing-person predicate and indistinguishable no-direction outcomes.

### Faction Spy

**ID:** `faction-spy` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; choose one specifically identifiable headquarters of one exact canonical faction and the qualifying room/area to observe. | 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** No roll. Select the exact faction and a specific established headquarters belonging to it. Institutional identification can suffice without street coordinates, such as the faction’s established central headquarters in a named city. A faction name alone cannot discover an unknown or secret HQ. Select one specific named room/common area of that HQ you know, or use its established primary common/operations area. If no such area is established, use the ordinary main interior space nearest its primary public/working entrance. No reputation, membership, Faction Seal or special infrastructure is required.

Create a fixed nonphysical observation point at the center of the selected room/area’s ordinarily usable interior space, at an ordinary standing observer’s eye height. If that point is inside solid matter, use the nearest open point within the same selected space; the Director resolves equal choices with a fixed neutral spatial order. No point outside that space or inside a secret adjacent room is substituted. If the selected HQ does not exist, is not the identified HQ, no longer belongs to the chosen faction at resolution, or has no valid viewpoint, receive no feed. The observation feed operates at any distance, but only while the selected physical viewpoint and caster are on the same plane. If they are not, no remote sight or hearing is received and the spell does not identify plane separation as the reason. For the duration while this feed is available, receive ordinary sight in all directions and hearing from the point alongside your local senses. Local light, obscurity, walls and sound conditions apply; no enhanced senses are granted. Blindness suppresses remote sight and Deafened suppresses remote hearing. Subject/area Divination protections filter only information within their actual scope.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.

**Limits:** One active Faction Spy point per caster; successful recasting replaces it. The point stays fixed in the selected physical room/site. Later institutional relocation or ownership change does not relocate that point or choose a new HQ; an actually mobile structure carries its own room and point normally. Maintain a same-plane connection to the point; plane separation suppresses both feeds without ending or pausing the spell, and return restores current information only. Ordinary obstruction, suppression and destruction of the room do not select a replacement room or refresh the duration. This ongoing magic has no body or HP and can be detected/ended only by an effect whose actual permissions apply. It cannot move through rooms, search, remotely interact, grant attacks/casting/line of effect, issue credentials, alter reputation, authorize entry or create a recording/replay. All-direction observation from one fixed point does not allow moving the viewpoint. A successful replacement owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F and one minute observing HQ activities. CONFLICT RULING: Self informational receiver and any-distance same-plane reach replace raw 30-foot metadata; rangeFeet 0 denotes Self, not the remote distance. NEW: no concentration, exact institutional HQ/room selection and simultaneous ordinary sight/hearing. Exact completion adds one point per caster, a deterministic usable-room viewpoint, same-plane suppression/recovery and post-resolution site continuity rather than moving with institutional ownership.

<a id="spell-alignment-prediction"></a>

### Alignment Prediction

**ID:** `alignment-prediction` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; one concrete imminent situation, offer, confrontation or decision it is reasonably expected to encounter within the next minute. | Instantaneous forecast of the specified imminent situation |

**Resolution:** No save. State the particular scenario before the answer. The Director privately reports the creature’s single most likely voluntary response under current circumstances, using its actual individual state, including actual alignment where relevant. Valid results include likely refuses, likely cooperates cautiously, likely attacks, likely bargains, or a comparably specific response. Report Indeterminate when necessary facts are genuinely undefined/protected or materially coequal alternatives prevent a single most likely response.

Use the individual’s actual motives, relationships, danger, knowledge and other relevant facts; these can outweigh an alignment tendency. Hidden unprotected facts may inform the forecast without being separately disclosed. Alignment is not a behavioral command, and the spell does not force any response, dictate a player character’s choice, trigger automatic oathbreaking or authorize compulsory PvP. Uncertainty or free will alone does not make an otherwise supported prediction Indeterminate. The situation must be reasonably expected within 60 elapsed seconds of resolution; the result forecasts the immediate voluntary response to it, not an entire later chain of choices.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.

**Limits:** Do not separately disclose exact alignment axes, full motives, surface thoughts, future die results, guaranteed success or a complete conversation transcript. A naturally inferable tendency from the permitted response is ordinary inference, not additional direct disclosure. Later free choices or materially changed circumstances can invalidate the prediction without falsifying the earlier current-circumstances forecast. Materially equivalent scenarios under unchanged circumstances return the same forecast across casters/rephrasing; genuinely different scenarios or materially changed facts can be asked normally. There is no daily cap beyond legal casting costs and cadence, and an Indeterminate result does not identify the hidden/protected reason. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S,F/instantaneous and a behavior forecast informed by alignment. NEW: specified imminent scenario, one-minute horizon, single likely response or Indeterminate, no separate alignment read and stable equivalent inquiries. Source alignment relevance does not replace individual agency or actual facts with stereotypes.

<a id="spell-resonance-tracking"></a>

### Resonance Tracking

**ID:** `resonance-tracking` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; search the area within 30 feet and line of effect for one qualifying actual spell-casting trace, then track the selected event’s surviving local trace under this spell’s rules. | Concentration, up to 10 minutes (600 elapsed seconds after application). Each selected trace component also expires at its original cast start plus 3,600 elapsed seconds; concentration and trace age never pause. |

**Resolution:** No roll. At resolution, select a qualifying actual spell-casting event whose origin, actual resolved footprint or source-defined traversed path is locally within 30 feet and line of effect and whose cast began less than 3,600 elapsed seconds ago. The currently resolving Resonance Tracking cast is excluded from its own selection. If you already distinguish a particular qualifying event, select it; otherwise select the most recent qualifying unprotected event. For equal cast timestamps use actual cast-start order, or a fixed neutral event order recorded before the read if simultaneous. A selected known event whose trace is protected yields no read and does not automatically switch to another. Unchanged recasts do not rotate through older hidden events.

For the duration, privately perceive locally readable residual components of the selected cast: its exact casting-origin point, actual source-defined routes that its magic traversed, and actual resolved area/endpoint footprints. Read only components within 30 feet and line of effect on your current plane, clipped to that readable area. New components of the selected ongoing casting become readable only after they actually occur and remain subject to its original age deadline. Ordinary visual concealment does not hide this magical residue; solid total cover blocks it until line of effect is regained. Follow it using ordinary movement and navigation. At a fork, report actual spell paths rather than a route oracle. A teleport/remote effect without a traversed path has origin/endpoint traces but no invented connecting line; a Self or instantaneous spell can still have its useful origin trace. A locally readable actual path through a portal may lead to that transition, but grants no remote view onto the other plane. If you independently reach that plane before expiry, only its actual local trace is readable.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.

**Limits:** An actual committed spell cast can qualify even when Counterspelled: it has an origin trace but no never-resolved effect/path. A class technique, item activation, copied effect or other magic qualifies only if its own source expressly performs/counts as a spell cast. Sensing residue does not itself create another cast, a traversed spell path or a trail of your footsteps. An older actual Resonance Tracking cast can have its own origin trace under these rules, but does not copy or refresh the traces it observed. Every component expires at the original cast-start timestamp plus 3,600 seconds, even if created later by a continuing spell; casting this detector, recasting, changing observers, suppression and copies never refresh it. At that exact deadline nothing remains readable. Losing local range/line of effect suspends sensing without choosing a new event, pausing time or ending concentration; returning while both deadlines permit restores only the actual trace then available. If nothing qualifies initially, gain no trace and do not auto-acquire a future event. Specific information protection can withhold protected trace details/subject information; unprotected independent environmental traces remain eligible without revealing protected actor identity. No spell name/rank, caster identity/current location, RP, statistics, harvesting resource, free recharge or physical evidence token is granted. Ordinary inferences from permitted locations remain possible. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F and following the trail of a spell cast within the last hour. CONFLICT RULING: NEW concentration up to 10 minutes replaces Instantaneous metadata to support following; raw 30 feet becomes the initial and continuing sensing radius around Self. NEW: actual casting-origin/path/endpoint residue, deterministic event selection, fixed original one-hour age and no invented spatial route. Exact completions exclude only this currently resolving cast from self-selection, specify age strictly before expiry, tie order, ongoing-component age and independent later planar traversal; ordinary tracking casts never copy the observed event.

**ID:** `eyes-of-the-divine` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

A magical visual disguise or illusion reveals the appearance beneath that effect.

For an actual physical transformation, Polymorph or innate alternate form, perceive that the form is transformed only when that information is readable. An undefined or protected underlying appearance is Indeterminate; a protection also covering the presence of the transformation/disguise can withhold that fact too. Apply this independently through readable layers without inventing a root form beneath a permanently changed baseline. Ordinary clothes or appearance choices are not automatically disguises; the presentation must actually serve concealment/impersonation. **Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

Blindness, darkness, smoke, Hidden, Invisible and other ordinary sight limits still matter unless a separate actual sense overcomes them; solid total cover blocks targeting. A creature you can actually see through another permitted sense remains eligible. The snapshot does not follow later disguise/form changes. No legal name, ancestry, class, statistics, alignment, motive, possession controller, history or prior-form chronology is disclosed. An overlay can support ordinary recognition or inference from the appearance, without certifying an unknown identity. No reversion, dispel, undressing, physical exposure or forced confession occurs. <a id="spell-future-echo"></a>

### Future Echo

**ID:** `future-echo` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | Yourself and/or any willing allies you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect at resolution, each with an actual regular encounter initiative slot. | Pending until the next numbered round boundary, then one affected round of initiative permutation; no concentration. |

**Resolution:** No save. While an encounter initiative order exists, choose the eligible participants and record their desired relative order at resolution. Range, perception, willingness and allied status are checked then, with no later range tether. Outside initiative a legal cast has no scheduling effect and refunds no committed cost. This spell does not create initiative to manufacture a round. One pending Future Echo per caster; a later successful cast before execution replaces that caster’s pending schedule.

After the current round’s final slot and normal end-round events finish, and before the next round’s first regular start, restore any prior round’s Future Echo permutation to the baseline, retaining changes made by other exact initiative rules. Then resolve pending Future Echo schedules in application order, with stable source/mechanical order breaking genuinely simultaneous ties. For each schedule, remove selected participants who no longer possess regular encounter slots and those already claimed by an earlier Future Echo at this boundary. Gather only the remaining participants’ own baseline slot positions, sort those positions earliest to latest, and assign those participants to them in the recorded relative order. Every remaining participant is claimed by that application even if a one-person set leaves its position unchanged. Enemy, unselected and skipped participants’ slots do not move. Removed participants’ abandoned baseline slots are not redistributed. Late entrants not selected at cast resolution are not added automatically. An Incapacitated participant retaining a regular slot remains in the permutation and obeys its actual restrictions.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** Each affected participant receives exactly one ordinary regular turn in the affected numbered round, with its normal movement, Action/Bonus Action permissions and regular-start Reaction refresh/recharge/death-save processing as applicable. The permutation itself creates no turn, Action, Reaction, recharge, save, pulse, fall step or recovery. Existing effects retain their previously recorded virtual markers, absolute deadlines and actual periodic clocks; a moved regular turn must not replay an already-scheduled fixed event. Effects newly created during the affected round use the actual schedule then in force. At the following boundary, the prior baseline resumes unless another exact initiative rule changes it; no midround restoration creates a duplicate or missing turn. Pending schedules can be countered, dispelled or suppressed only under an actual applicable rule. A pending schedule unavailable at its execution boundary expires without a delayed makeup. Boundary execution consumes the pending magic and records a fixed one-round turn assignment; later dispelling/suppressing that completed cast does not reverse an already-committed schedule midround. A fresh cast during the affected round can prepare the following round, after baseline restoration. Caster death alone does not erase an independent pending schedule, but a selected caster who loses their actual slot is filtered normally. Source-specific companion turns qualify only if they genuinely own regular slots, not merely for acting after an owner. Full Time Loop and its unimplemented runtime are not enabled by this manuscript. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F and choosing ally initiative order next round. NEW: willing selected set, permutation among existing slots for one round, no concentration, baseline restoration and first-application claims. Exact completions specify baseline-before-next-permutation ordering, singleton claims, suppression at the execution boundary and an atomic schedule commitment that cannot be dispelled into a broken midround order.

### Reveal Weakness

**ID:** `reveal-weakness` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One creature you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. | Up to 1 minute or until consumed; no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** No initial save. The target’s next actual saving-throw event of any kind receives disadvantage. Consume this pending record immediately before that save resolves, even if another source already imposes disadvantage or advantage cancels it.

Any event explicitly classified by its source as a saving throw qualifies, including a concentration save or death saving throw where those actual rules classify it as a save. Ability/tool checks, attack rolls and opposed checks do not qualify merely for resisting an effect. If an actual save resolves with an automatic result and no dice under its own source, consume the pending record without overriding that automatic result. If immunity or another rule means no saving throw occurs at all, the record is not consumed. A later permitted reroll belongs to the same original save event; use its actual replacement procedure without creating another Reveal Weakness use. One pending Reveal Weakness per target across all casters; a successful new application replaces the old record rather than banking another disadvantaged save.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** This does not force a saving throw, alter its DC, reveal target statistics or weaknesses, invent critical-save rules, undo a resolved result or prevent another independently legal reroll. Expiry without a save consumes no other resource and creates no delayed use. Protection from Scrying does not block this noninformational roll modifier merely because its generating school is Divination. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F and disadvantage on the target’s next saving throw without a printed initial save. NEW: finite one-minute pending window, all actual saving throws and cross-caster replacement. Exact completion distinguishes an automatic-result saving throw from an effect that creates no save event.

<a id="spell-planar-window"></a>

### Planar Window

**ID:** `planar-window` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One local fixed point or surface you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, plus one intended specific location on a known plane other than your current plane. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** No roll. Identify the remote location through prior personal visitation or a reliable map, description or established source that uniquely identifies it. Knowing a plane alone does not identify a site; no universal corresponding coordinates are invented. After costs commit, resolve the actual destination and applicable planar/information wards. If the remote designation has no usable viewpoint or is blocked, no readable remote information is supplied and no hidden reason is diagnosed. Neither viewpoint may occupy solid matter. The local point must have room for a nonphysical 5-foot-wide by 5-foot-high window.

Create one fixed visible 5-by-5-foot viewing window. It displays ordinary vision from the fixed remote point in all directions; observers may direct their attention around that scene without moving the remote point. Anyone who can ordinarily see the local window can see the unprotected displayed scene. Local Blindness, actual visual obstructions and inability to see the window prevent this viewing. Remote light, darkness, smoke, walls and terrain work normally; the spell grants no darkvision or true sight. Separately, you privately detect the location and category of actual native beings and native ongoing effects/phenomena within 30 feet and line of effect of the remote point. Native means a genuine established native/origin relationship to that plane, supported by actual source or setting fiction. This added detection can locate a readable Hidden/Invisible native presence without providing sight of its body. A visitor or a spell merely cast there by a visitor is not thereby native. If a presence is otherwise visible through the window but its native provenance is undefined/protected, that classification is Indeterminate; it is not reported as nonnative. The additional detection does not reveal an otherwise unseen entity solely because its provenance is undefined. Protected presence/location/category fields remain protected independently.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** Only you receive native-detection reports; other observers receive the displayed ordinary vision. That private magical detection does not require your eyes or continued sight of the local window, but concentration and the remote 30-foot/line-of-effect limits still apply. Neither point moves, follows a creature/vehicle or searches rooms; ordinary translation of a chosen supporting surface does not carry the fixed window. No continuing 60-foot caster tether is added after legal placement, and no clock pauses on caster travel or suppression. One Planar Window per caster; successful recasting replaces it. Specific planar or information protections filter only their actual scope. The window is nonphysical magic, not a break in either barrier: no sound, passage, physical interaction, attack, remote target permission, line of effect or casting origin is supplied in either direction. It has no HP or harvestable surface and is affected only by an actually applicable detection/suppression/dispel rule. Suppression supplies no backlog or replay. The source’s remote visual scene is public, but it creates no recording object. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F, vision into another plane and detection of native beings/effects. CONFLICT RULING: raw 60 feet is local placement; NEW concentration up to one minute replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: known remote location, fixed 5-by-5 public vision, private 30-foot native detection. Exact completions bound unknown-provenance reports to otherwise observed presences, distinguish private detection from eyesight, and add no unprinted continuing caster tether.

<a id="spell-speak-with-dead"></a>

### Speak with Dead

**ID:** `speak-with-dead` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One perceived corpse or substantial apparent creature remains within 60 feet and line of effect; eligibility of its deceased identity and retained memories resolves after casting costs commit. | Up to 1 minute or until five question exchanges are spent; no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** No save or willing-soul gate. After costs commit, determine whether these are sufficient actual remains of one currently dead creature identity to support an associated retained memory echo. Bones or equivalent substantial creature remains can qualify without an intact mouth, tongue or biological flesh. An active Undead/Construct, an ordinary broken device that was never a creature, identityless ash, a stray blood trace or old remains of a currently living identity do not qualify. If no readable qualifying echo exists, obtain no answers without learning which eligibility/protection fact failed.

Invoke a retained memory echo associated with the addressed remains and deceased identity, not a soul, creature or resurrection. For this application you may spend up to five question exchanges. Each attempted materially unified inquiry and its answer uses one Action in initiative, or approximately six elapsed seconds outside initiative, and one question allowance; the original casting Action includes no free question. Distinct independent subquestions require their own exchanges, Actions and allowances even when spoken as one sentence. You must audibly address the remains from within 60 feet and line of effect; ordinary sound-blocking conditions apply. Each committed exchange spends its allowance even if the question is not understood or its answer is unknown/protected. The echo answers audibly from the remains, truthfully according to the deceased’s actual associated memories and beliefs before death. It uses a language the deceased knew and would reasonably use, with no automatic translation. If no mutually usable language or remembered answer supports a response, it may provide no intelligible answer, I do not know, I do not remember, or the appropriate equivalent. It cannot deliberately lie or withhold a known readable answer from hostility, but mistaken beliefs remain mistaken.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** Actual memories associated with the remains govern: this grants no post-death knowledge or automatic later-life memory update to an older fragment after resurrection and another death. Multiple fragments remain one deceased identity, not new people or duplicated souls. A fresh legal paid cast can ask another five; no daily immunity or exclusive global interview slot is added. Each application retains its own quota and deadline; asking an echo does not simultaneously question all other applications. The echo ends if the identity becomes living, the selected physical anchor no longer contains qualifying remains, the five exchanges are spent, or the spell expires/is actually ended. A temporary gap in speaking/range/sound/line of effect pauses no duration. Existing answers and ordinary remembered information persist after ending. Soul Bind or a resurrection-only blocker does not automatically block this memory echo; actual corpse, communication, memory or information protections keep their written scope. The spell generates Divination through Cleric, Mirrorsage, Ranger, Shaman, Wizard or Paladin, and Necromancy through Crimson Agent, Druid or Thief, exactly as the selected casting class’s access row states. A Divination-only ward cannot block a Necromancy cast merely because this shared identity has another school placement. Protection may also filter new information about a separately protected subject within its actual scope. No compelled living creature, identity creation, body animation, healing, resource refresh, skill/proficiency download, objective-history verification or usable recording token results. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: both rank-three Divination/Necromancy source placements and five questions/answers; Core M/F uses shared F. NEW: retained-memory echo, substantial-remains eligibility, truthful subjective answers and one-minute interview. Exact completions put hidden eligibility after payment, require separate paid Action/question exchanges after casting, retain local audible inquiry/range, and bind memories to the actual associated remains rather than silently updating old fragments across later lives.

<a id="spell-faction-divination"></a>

### Faction Divination

**ID:** `faction-divination` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; choose one exact known canonical factionId. | Instantaneous private institutional inquiry |

**Resolution:** No roll. Privately learn one actual current major institutional objective of the chosen faction. No physical representative, positive reputation, membership, Faction Seal permission, geographic distance or planar anchor is required.

A qualifying objective is a concrete established goal pursued or prioritized by the institution or its recognized governing authority, such as securing a trade route, recovering a stolen archive or removing a named governor from office. A member’s private wish, reputation inference or the Director’s preferred plot is not an institutional objective. If several objectives are genuinely coequal, the Director records one stable priority selection while that institutional state remains materially unchanged. Equivalent repeat casts across casters/rephrasing do not rotate through hidden coequal goals. Report No Current Major Objective only for genuine established absence; undefined or specifically protected institutional information reports Indeterminate. Independently readable portions of a meaningful goal may be stated while protected details remain Indeterminate, without identifying which ward or hidden record caused the limit.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** Protection of one leader’s personal information does not erase an independently established institutional objective, and a protected private plan does not become institutional merely to evade protection. A subfaction must have its own actual canonical identity to be selected separately; invented subdivisions are not extra inquiries. The spell does not directly reveal an operational plan, member list, exact locations, timetable, secret agents, resources or every subordinate objective. A goal can naturally mention a readable subject as necessary to make it concrete, but supplies no additional dossier. It changes neither reputation nor faction intent and forces no action. ### Alignment Revelation

**ID:** `alignment-revelation` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One creature you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. | Instantaneous public visual revelation |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Charisma save against your spell DC. Success: no revelation. Failure: magic displays two self-luminous symbolic sigils immediately around the target, one for its actual Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic axis and one for its actual Good/Neutral/Evil axis. Each readable axis displays its true current value; each undefined or specifically protected axis displays Indeterminate. Only an exact masking rule can alter a displayed result.

The sigils exist only during resolution, long enough to be ordinarily perceived, then vanish. An observer must actually be able to see the target to see and understand the corresponding symbolic revelation; no language or hearing is required. Blindness, solid visual obstruction or inability to see the target prevents that observation. The sigils emit no meaningful surrounding illumination and do not themselves grant sight of an Invisible/Hidden or otherwise unseen body. An observer who can see the target through another actual permitted sense can read them. The magic reveals the value; it does not make the target speak, confess, interpret a command or verify a lie.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** This grants no alignment change, behavior control, oathbreaking, compulsory PvP, crime/motive information or future-action guarantee. “True” does not silently bypass a written information protection. The failure creates only the public information event; known information is not erased when the sigils vanish. No automatic recording item, repeated-use immunity or daily cap is added. Its higher-rank price and CHA-save requirement remain despite overlap with lower-rank private readers; public disclosure is the reviewed distinction, not invented ward-piercing power. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. Relative balance against private lower-rank alignment spells remains open.

<a id="spell-resonance-sight-greater"></a>

### Resonance Sight (Greater)

**ID:** `resonance-sight-greater` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; magical effects within 60 feet on your plane and in line of effect. | Instantaneous private snapshot |

**Resolution:** No roll. Detect every currently existing qualifying magical effect with a readable portion in the area. Ordinary non-solid visual concealment and lack of mundane visibility, including Hidden/Invisible status, do not hide the effect itself. Solid total cover blocks the unreadable portion. This informational detection does not require ordinary visual sight of the effect.

For each qualifying effect, privately receive its readable local location/footprint, actual effect/spell/property identity when explicitly established and unprotected (otherwise its established broad magical category), and recorded readable proximate generating source. Undefined/protected identity and provenance fields independently report Indeterminate, without erasing other readable fields. Proximate source means the specific originating spell cast/caster identity, item producing an active property, creature/feature producing an aura, or site/zone/ritual generating that effect. A locally qualifying effect can disclose its recorded source identity even when that source is now beyond 60 feet, but not that source’s current remote location, condition or inventory. Record source identity as it actually exists; a missing personal name is not invented. A footprint is clipped to the readable area, rather than exposing the entire remote extent of a partially local effect.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** Active intrinsic magic requires an actual presently active magical effect/aura record; a creature’s species/theme or RP pool alone is not one. A permanent item qualifies through a currently active property/effect, not a dormant historical enchantment with no active record. An existing ongoing record that is suppressed remains detectable as suppressed if that state is readable; an ended/removed effect or mere extinguished residue does not qualify. Resonance Tracking separately governs one-hour spell traces. A copy is identified as the actual copied effect and its proximate copying source, not a fresh original cast. Readable explicitly recorded provenance may identify the immediate source relationship but grants no independent recursive search through upstream controllers or histories. An attached aura can reveal its creature’s location through ordinary inference without granting sight of that body. Actual subject information protections can withhold attached-magic details, while independent environmental magic remains separately readable. No universal spell-rank/slot/charge/RP total, recipe, full stat block, dispel, control, extraction, copied spell, remote attack/casting origin or permanent map is granted. Remembering or writing a permitted snapshot uses ordinary memory and tools. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and all magical effects and their sources within 60 feet. CONFLICT RULING: Self with a 60-foot same-plane/line-of-effect sensing radius. NEW: local readable footprint, effect identity/category and proximate provenance, non-solid concealment bypass, actual ongoing suppressed versus ended/dormant distinctions and no direct remote-current-location report.
