### Daze

**ID:** `daze` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reaction — when a creature you can perceive within 30 feet attempts to take a Reaction | 30 ft | One creature you can perceive within range that is attempting to use its Reaction | Until the start of the target's next regular turn |

**Resolution:** The target makes an Intelligence save against your spell save DC. On failure, the triggering Reaction is lost and the target cannot take another Reaction until the start of its next regular turn. On success, the triggering Reaction resolves normally.

Briefly disrupt the target's ability to react. A failed Intelligence save cancels the triggering Reaction and prevents further Reactions until the start of the target's next turn.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Does not remove the target's Action, Bonus Action, movement, or regular turn. Cannot be cast unless a legal Reaction is actually being attempted. Repeated casts on the same target do not extend the duration beyond the latest failed save. Cantrip repeats use Refrain even though base Dissonance is 0.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 casting time, 30-foot range, V/S components, Intelligence save, and one-round reaction loss are retained. The exact Reaction trigger and start-of-next-turn endpoint are NEW provisional timing needed to operationalize the source. Pasted text

**ID:** `calm-whispers` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

### Mental Flicker

**ID:** `mental-flicker` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One non-boss creature you can perceive within 30 feet | Damage instantaneous; attack penalty until the end of the target's next regular turn |

**Resolution:** The target makes an Intelligence save against your spell save DC. On failure, it takes 1d4 psychic damage and suffers -1 on its next attack roll before the end of its next regular turn. On success, no damage or penalty.

Create a brief mental disruption. A failed Intelligence save deals 1d4 psychic damage and imposes a bounded -1 penalty on the target's next attack.

**Scaling:** None; damage remains 1d4 at all class levels.

**Limits:** The source's undefined 'disorient' wording is represented only by the -1 next-attack penalty; it does not remove Actions, Reactions, movement, or awareness. No damage on a successful save. The penalty does not stack with another Mental Flicker. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S components, and Instantaneous damage are retained. Core resolution is 'Automatic or opposed as described,' which does not define an opposition mechanic; Intelligence save and the bounded disorientation rider are NEW provisional specifications. Conference decision: non-boss is the provisional meaning of source minor creature. Director encounter data determines boss/legendary status before targeting; no automatic bypass.

<a id="spell-charm-person"></a>

### Charm Person

**ID:** `charm-person` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One living person you can perceive within range | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On failure, it gains the CoreV2 Charmed condition toward you and regards you as friendly for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, and the first time each round you or your allies damage it, it repeats the Wisdom save; success ends the spell. On the initial save success, no effect.

Charm one person so it temporarily regards you as friendly. Charmed does not grant command authority, compel beliefs, reveal secrets, or force the target to obey requests.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** A player-controlled target retains full agency over choices and beliefs. The spell cannot force self-harm, confession, permanent allegiance, transfer of possessions, or actions beyond the CoreV2 Charmed restrictions. A creature that cannot be Charmed is unaffected. Only the first damage event each round grants the additional repeat save. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and Wisdom save are retained; F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Core lists Instantaneous duration, which conflicts with 'regards caster as friendly' and 'save ends early.' Concentration up to 1 minute and repeat-save cadence are NEW provisional operational decisions. Two source school placements are preserved externally; this record does not choose class access.

### Heroism

**ID:** `heroism` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing living creature you can perceive within range | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** None; a willing target receives the effect automatically.

The target gains S+M temporary HP when the spell is cast and is immune to Frightened while the spell lasts. Temporary HP remaining from this spell disappear when the spell ends. S is 1/2/3/4 at the casting class levels 1/5/11/17; M=max(1, that class casting ability modifier).

**Scaling:** Temporary HP equals S+M, using the caster's class-level S and casting-ability M.

Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and source fear immunity are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration and source gives no temporary-HP amount; concentration up to 1 minute and S+M temporary HP are NEW provisional mechanics chosen to make the effect finite and playable.

### Bane

**ID:** `bane` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |

**Resolution:** Make a separate spell attack against each selected target. On a hit, that target subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws for the duration. On a miss, that target is unaffected.

Afflict up to three creatures with a magical bane. Each creature successfully struck by the spell suffers -1d4 on all attack rolls and saving throws while concentration continues.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Roll the 1d4 separately whenever an affected creature makes an attack roll or saving throw. <a id="spell-false-comfort"></a>

### False Comfort

**ID:** `false-comfort` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. | Instantaneous sensation; pending distraction until consumed or its one-round endpoint. Ends at the end of the target's first future regular turn, excluding the entire current target turn if one is already in progress. Outside initiative, expires 6 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the selected virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes and absence; end-phase effects resolve before end-marker cleanup. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no new sensation or rider. Failure: it experiences a convincing subjective surge of relief or apparent recovery and receives disadvantage on its next actual Perception check before the endpoint. Consume the rider when that check begins, even if another source already imposes disadvantage or advantage cancels it.

The sensation can feel like warmth, easing pain or the beginning of healing. It restores no HP or temporary HP, stabilizes nothing, removes no Wound or condition and generates no healing/recovery event or trigger. Apparent comfort does not alter actual injury, damage, HP-dependent rules or knowledge made apparent by physical evidence. The target is never required to behave as though mechanically healed. One pending False Comfort distraction per target across all casters; a later failed save replaces it, while a later successful save leaves an existing rider intact.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** The one-use rider names an actual Perception check; it does not independently lower passive Perception or require a new check. No Action/turn loss, forced movement, belief about a specific medical fact, magical diagnosis, cure, enduring pain suppression or permanent memory change is granted. If no qualifying check occurs before expiry, the rider ends unused. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S and apparent healing with no actual healing effect. NEW: WIS save, fleeting relief and one-Perception-check distraction lasting one target round. The Healing tag supplies no healing trigger; the numeric distraction is an explicit reviewed addition.

<a id="spell-disrupt-memory"></a>

### Disrupt Memory

**ID:** `disrupt-memory` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; it need not already be concentrating or known to remember anything. | Instantaneous; the affected interval’s firsthand episodic recall is lost rather than temporarily suppressed. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no effect. Failure: remove its own episodic recollection of the six elapsed seconds immediately preceding this spell’s resolution, and end every actual Concentration application it is personally maintaining through each application’s normal ending procedure. No second concentration save is granted by this spell.

This changes recall, not the world or its state. Movement, attacks, damage, healing, deaths, conditions, resources, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, consumed uses, recorded choices, action budgets, physical evidence, other observers’ memories and completed outcomes stay as they occurred. The target can learn facts about that interval afterward from witnesses or evidence, creating new knowledge without restoring its erased firsthand memory. Each legal cast affects only its own resolution-relative six-second interval; overlaps never recursively reach older memories. A memory-only protection prevents only the memory change unless its scope also covers the concentration disruption; an empty remembered interval does not itself prevent ending actual concentration.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** Multiple actual concentration records maintained by this target all end, including the linked pairs permitted by Spell Tether or Crimson Harmony. Tethered Cast’s separately sustained concentration spell is included despite not occupying the normal slot; its separate damage-save rule is not immunity to an effect expressly ending all maintained concentration. Unrelated sustained or permanent non-concentration effects, class features merely named focus, intrinsic traits and other creatures’ concentration do not end. Use actual ending consequences for held readied spells, summons, forms and fields; do not restore displaced effects or refund costs. Remembering the encounter poorly does not itself consume an Action, rewind a turn, clear a mechanically retained nonspell Ready record, create Unconsciousness or reset initiative. The spell supplies no replacement memory, information about what was erased, blanket forgetting of older associations, automatic notification of success, or immunity to later casts. Separate features that actually repair lost memories retain their own permissions. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S/instantaneous, forget the last six seconds and end concentration. NEW: WIS save, permanent resolution-relative episodic loss, all currently maintained Concentration scope and independent defense handling. Exact-class completion includes Spell Tether, Crimson Harmony and Tethered Cast under actual maintained-concentration rules; it does not alter their source cards.

<a id="spell-mental-tap"></a>

### Mental Tap

**ID:** `mental-tap` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; no enemy-only, non-boss or biological restriction is added. | Instantaneous damage; qualifying next-save benefit up to 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve that original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** The target makes an Intelligence save against your spell DC. Failure: 1d4 psychic damage. Success: no damage. After defenses and actual HP handling, calculate actualDamageDealt as temporary HP actually absorbed plus ordinary HP actually lost, excluding overkill and later state assignments. Only a value greater than zero grants you +1 to your next actual saving-throw event before the benefit expires.

After defenses and actual HP handling determine actualDamageDealt. If it is greater than zero, establish the +1 benefit immediately at that point. It cannot modify the target’s already-resolved initial Intelligence save or any saving throw that resolved before actualDamageDealt became known. A saving throw subsequently caused by that damage, including your own concentration save if you targeted yourself, can be the next qualifying save and may consume the benefit. At your next actual saving-throw event after the benefit exists, apply +1 under the strongest-applicable-flat-bonus rule and consume it before resolving the save. Consumption still occurs if a stronger bonus supersedes it or a source assigns an automatic save result with no die to modify; if no saving throw event occurs, no consumption occurs. Actual concentration/death saves qualify when their own rules classify them as saving throws. One pending Mental Tap benefit per caster; a later qualifying actual-damage event replaces it with a fresh endpoint. A later zero-damage or successful-save cast does not erase an existing benefit.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** A positive attempted or post-defense packet that causes neither temp-HP absorption nor ordinary HP loss, including a complete HP-floor prevention, grants no benefit. Psychic immunity or other prevention retains its actual scope. The spell grants no RP, extra Action, rest refresh, copied damage, extra saving throw or automatic success. No banking several +1 uses, save DC change, alteration of completed consequences or modifier to checks/attacks is granted. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S, 1d4 psychic and caster +1 next save only if damage is dealt. NEW: INT save with no damage on success, numeric actualDamageDealt trigger and one-minute entitlement. Exact-review timing repair establishes the benefit immediately when positive actualDamageDealt is known; a subsequently triggered concentration save can consume it, while already-resolved saves cannot change.

### Friends

**ID:** `friends` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self, keyed to one creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; actual hostility is resolved only after casting costs commit. | Up to 1 minute, no concentration. Preserve that original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** No save is added. After costs commit, determine whether the chosen creature is actually non-hostile toward you. If not, create no benefit and give no separate hostility diagnostic. If eligible, you gain advantage on actual Charisma checks directly interacting with that creature for the duration.

The benefit includes whatever actual Charisma skill/task is legitimately used in that interaction, not only Persuasion or Deception. It does not grant an otherwise unavailable check or determine its outcome. If the creature becomes actually hostile toward you while the application lasts, this application ends and does not resume merely because its attitude later improves. Hidden but established hostility is still actual; a faction, species, alignment, reputation score, appearance or suspicion alone does not establish it. One active Friends target per caster; a successful eligible new application replaces the old one. A cast that creates no eligible benefit does not itself replace an existing valid application.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** This is a caster-side social benefit, not Charmed, an unwilling-to-harm restriction or control of choices/beliefs. No advantage on attacks, saves, ordinary spellcasting or unrelated checks. Written broader mental/Enchantment defenses retain their actual scope. No automatic post-expiry hostility, notification, friendship, loyalty, confession or reputation change is added. Ordinary observers can notice casting and infer things from actual interactions; the spell does not erase those observations. After initial legal application there is no continuing 30-foot tether, but any actual interaction still needs its normal communication and task permissions. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/V,S and advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature. CONFLICT RULING: Self keyed to a creature selected within the raw 30 feet; NEW one-minute duration replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: post-payment hostility test, actual hostility ending and one eligible target/application per caster.

<a id="spell-soothe-animal"></a>

### Soothe Animal

**ID:** `soothe-animal` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect, addressed as a Beast or animal; its actual qualifying classification is checked at effect resolution. | Up to 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve that original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** After costs commit, determine whether the target has an actual Beast classification or an explicit current source-authorized animal record/tag. Appearance, a profile name or a transformation that leaves relevant creature classification unchanged is not sufficient. An actual transformation that changes the relevant record can qualify. An ineligible target receives no effect without a separate classification diagnostic. An eligible target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no new effect. Failure: the target becomes genuinely calm for the duration.

While calm it does not voluntarily initiate attacks or knowingly harmful actions. It may move, flee, defend itself with nonharmful choices, interact, perceive and otherwise act normally. It receives no commands and is not made loyal or friendly. End this calm immediately when another creature commits an attack or knowingly harmful effect against it, before that hostile effect resolves; a miss or later prevention does not undo this ending. It also ends on any positive resolved damage packet to the target after defenses and before temp-HP absorption, including environmental damage. A fully prevented zero packet does not count by itself. This “takes damage” ending is distinct from Mental Tap’s numeric damage-dealt benefit. Ended calm never resumes after the danger passes.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** The spell does not remove Frightened or another named condition; retain their actual restrictions even while ordinary agitation is calmed. No taming, ownership, domination, forced movement, standing/reputation change, blanket whole-Action denial or permanent attitude change. A previously committed action is not retroactively undone merely by this new restriction. One active Soothe Animal calm record per target across casters; a later failed save replaces its deadline, while a later successful save leaves an existing valid record intact. The Beast/animal predicate is checked when the spell resolves. A later transformation or classification change does not by itself end an already-applied calm on the same continuing creature unless that transformation’s actual rules expressly end or suppress the effect. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S and one minute calming a beast or animal, without concentration. NEW: actual classification predicate, WIS save, voluntary-harm restriction and harm-ending rule. Exact completions place hidden classification after payment and distinguish positive damage packets from zero prevention. The exact-review repair keeps classification as an application-only predicate; later changes do not themselves dispel the calm.

### Minor Suggestion

**ID:** `minor-suggestion` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; declare one simple single-purpose idea and a language in which you can formulate it. | Up to 1 minute of mental salience, no concentration; one Persuasion-check benefit may be consumed earlier. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve that original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. |

**Resolution:** After costs commit, resolve whether the target actually understands the chosen language and the declared idea is harmless in the actual circumstances. A hidden incompatibility or hazard creates no planted idea and gives no diagnostic of its reason. Otherwise the target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no new effect. Failure: the idea appears in its conscious mind as a plausible, salient option for the duration; it can freely reject that option. It need not hear the verbal component to receive the mental idea, but V/S casting requirements still apply.

For the duration, you have advantage on your first actual Persuasion check directed to the target specifically to encourage that exact idea; consume that benefit when the check begins even if advantage was already present or disadvantage cancels it. The idea’s temporary salience can remain until expiry after the benefit is consumed. One active Minor Suggestion per caster/target pair; a later successful implant replaces the old idea/benefit/endpoint without accumulating several suggestions from that caster. Other casters retain separate records without stacking advantage on one roll. The spell does not make its subject believe the idea is true or necessarily its own invention, erase awareness of observed casting, or force any decision.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** Harmlessness is judged from actual circumstances, not caster phrasing. Reject ideas that directly require self-harm, harming another creature, entering an actual meaningful hazard, surrendering/discarding materially valuable property, revealing a protected/private secret, a hostile act, or knowingly violating a binding oath/duty. If changed circumstances make the proposed act non-harmless before expiry, end its magical salience and unused bonus without revealing the hidden reason. Ordinary memory that the idea was presented remains. No compelled Action, movement, obedience, Charmed, confession, dispossession, eight-hour command, permanent belief/memory replacement or truth verification occurs. Actual social-task legality still governs whether a Persuasion check exists and what success means. A later saved/invalid cast does not erase an existing valid application merely by being attempted. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S and a simple harmless idea planted in the mind. NEW: language compatibility, WIS save, one-minute salience and one Persuasion-check advantage. Exact completions defer hidden compatibility/harmlessness to post-payment resolution, add one application per caster/target, and end magic if the actual proposal becomes harmful.

<a id="spell-beguiling-gaze"></a>

### Beguiling Gaze

**ID:** `beguiling-gaze` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature with which you can establish mutual visual gaze or an actual analogous directed visual sense, within 30 feet and line of effect. | One target round, no concentration, or until maintained contact ends. Ends at the end of the target's first future regular turn, excluding the entire current target turn if one is already in progress. Outside initiative, expires 6 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the selected virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes and absence; end-phase effects resolve before end-marker cleanup. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no new lock. Failure: the gaze locks. While locked, the target cannot voluntarily avert its primary gaze from you or deliberately close, cover or otherwise block its relevant visual organs in a manner that would meaningfully break or evade the maintained gaze, regardless of the stated reason for doing so. Ordinary momentary blinking that does not meaningfully break mutual visual contact remains possible. An actual involuntary loss of sight or visual contact can end the lock normally.

While the lock remains, treat the target as looking at/meeting your gaze for a separate rule that expressly asks that question. This spell supplies no gaze attack of its own and creates no universal facing or field-of-view system. The target can move, attack, cast, interact, choose other legal targets and perceive through ordinary peripheral or other senses normally. It gains no generic attack/Perception disadvantage and loses no Action, Reaction or movement. It is not compelled to follow you to preserve range or sight.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.

**Limits:** End the lock immediately if you and the target exceed 30 feet, actual line of effect or mutual visual contact breaks, either becomes unable to maintain the relevant sight, or you voluntarily end the gaze; voluntary release requires no extra Action. This includes actual Blindness or an outside intervention that blocks the required view. A creature with no eyes can qualify only if its actual sense/anatomy supplies a genuine directed-gaze analogue; a creature name or theme cannot invent one. One active Beguiling Gaze per caster; a later failed target save replaces that caster’s prior lock. A successful target save does not itself replace the old lock, but actually breaking prior contact to establish a new gaze can end the old lock independently. An ended lock never resumes merely because distance or sight later returns. Other exact gaze powers retain their own costs, saves, targeting, effects and defenses; the lock bypasses none except the expressly prevented voluntary aversion. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S, mutual eye lock and inability to look away for one round. NEW: WIS save, real gaze analogue, maintained contact/range, voluntary-aversion rule and exact first-future-target-turn endpoint. No generic facing engine, compelled approach or hard whole-Action denial is imported.

Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; end-phase effects precede cleanup. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Charisma save. Success: no new effect. Failure: apply Stunned and a separate unaware rider for the duration. The shared hard-control guard prevents the Stunned package if its allowance is unavailable; it does not itself prevent the separately printed unaware rider. This rider neither deletes older memories nor invents sensory knowledge when it ends. **Limits:** Unaware adds no Unconscious, Prone, dropped items, adjacent automatic criticals, Blindness/Deafness condition or extra attack modifier of its own. The creature may act to the extent its actual remaining conditions permit, using retained knowledge and legal nonsensory choices. One unaware record per source caster/target; a later failed save refreshes that record without stacking penalties. A hard-denial history never refreshes with it. Independently valid sources/causes remain until each ends; ending Mesmerize restores neither concentration nor missed events. Hard whole-Action/turn components use the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their own defense checks. A successfully established hard component claims the allowance once, not again each turn; ending, dispelling, replacing or suppressing it does not refund the encounter history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.

NEW: single perceived creature, operational unaware definition, exact future-end clock and independently scoped components. Exact-review completion distinguishes a guard-blocked Stunned package from narrower inherited-component immunity; unaware is not a second invented Action-denial condition.

### Pacify

**ID:** `pacify` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect and presently treat as an enemy using ordinary information; this declaration reveals no hidden hostility. | One target round, no concentration. Ends at the target's first future regular-turn END, excluding the entire current target turn if already underway. Outside initiative, the deadline is six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; end-phase effects precede cleanup. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new restriction. Failure: it cannot voluntarily initiate an attack or begin/cast a spell whose selected mode includes a damage-dealing payload during the duration.

The prohibition applies across Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and other actual attack/cast permissions. A spell with multiple modes can be cast through a genuinely nondamaging mode. Deliberately established delayed or ongoing damage from that selected cast counts; a miss, successful victim save, immunity or hoped-for zero damage does not turn a damage payload into a nondamaging mode. Existing attacks/spells whose commitments already occurred are not undone or stopped retroactively by this application. The creature retains movement, interactions, non-damaging spells/control and other legal choices.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** This is not a blanket ban on every harmful nonattack technique and does not forbid harm merely because it is harmful: use the printed attack/damaging-spell categories. Truly involuntary acts retain their separate rules. No harm-ending clause is added; being attacked does not remove Pacify. This limited prohibition does not consume the whole-Action hard-control allowance merely because the creature lacks attractive alternatives. One Pacify restriction per caster/target; later failed save refreshes it, successful save does not remove it; independent other-caster records keep their own deadlines. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, enemy cannot attack or cast damaging spells for1round. End a Sleep application when its target receives a positive damage packet after defenses and before temporary HP, when another creature within physical reach spends an Action rousing it, on its deadline, or through an applicable removal rule. Physical rousing by that Action ends all applications of this ordinary Sleep spell on that creature, but does not cure unrelated Unconscious causes. All Sleep applications independently see a qualifying damage event. The waking damage attack resolves using the conditions present for its roll/hit, then the damage event ends Sleep; no retroactive critical/hit reversal.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** A fully prevented zero packet does not wake by damage; positive packet can wake even if an HP floor prevents actual numeric HP loss. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. ### Confusing Flash

**ID:** `confusing-flash` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. | Pending until the target’s next regular turn; a single commanded behavior during that turn, then ends. Exclude any current in-progress target turn. Extra turns do not execute it. If no initiative exists when a compelled combat act matters, establish ordinary initiative; if no action sequence is needed, resolve the same one ordinary action/movement opportunity within six elapsed seconds. No indefinite pending command. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no command. On failure, roll a neutral1d2 immediately:1=Attack,2=Flee. Determine the branch before any caster/controller choice. Attack reserves/spends the shared hard-control allowance when its future command is established; if blocked, apply no Attack command and no substitute Flee. Flee is movement compulsion, not a whole-Action denial.

At the next regular turn after required start-phase events and before voluntary actions/movement, resolve the branch. Attack: if the creature can take its ordinary Action, neutrally select with equal probability among other creatures it can presently perceive and legally attack with at least one available ordinary weapon, natural or unarmed attack. The target/controller chooses one legal ordinary attack method against that victim and spends its normal Action on exactly that one attack; no Multiattack, extra attack, spell, charged technique or optional resource expenditure is compelled. Normal finite ammunition for its chosen attack is still required and spent. If no legal victim/method or no ordinary Action is available, no attack occurs and the command ends; it never turns an unavailable Action into an available one. Flee: spend as much of its ordinary available movement as reasonably possible increasing distance from the caster along a legal route it knows is not immediately self-destructive; the target/controller chooses the route. No automatic Dash; other Actions, BA and Reactions remain available. A blocked route allows only the actual safe meaningful movement possible. Compelled use of its movement can provoke ordinary opportunity attacks; it is not a push/pull displacement.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** No deliberately self-directed attack, known lethal route, remote victim discovery or caster-selected random victim. Mandatory movement/attack occurs once, not on every extra turn or repeated save. One pending Confusing Flash per target across casters; a later successfully established branch replaces the prior pending behavior, but no spent hard-control history is refunded. A saved-against or guard-blocked new branch creates no replacement. A legal attack remains genuinely compelled and is not made voluntary merely by another Charmed relation; actual absolute prohibitions still govern. Other independent compulsion rules retain scope and cannot supply extra action budgets. Hard whole-Action/turn components use the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their own defense checks. A successfully established hard component claims the allowance once, not again each turn; ending, dispelling, replacing or suppressing it does not refund the encounter history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.

| Reaction — when a perceived enemy begins an Action in numbered initiative, after commitment but before its first main outcome | 30 ft | One creature you perceive and ordinarily identify as an enemy within30feet and line of effect, with a qualifying Action currently beginning in established numbered initiative. | Triggering-Action interruption is immediate; opportunity-attack restriction ends at the END of the current numbered round, even if little of that round remains. No extension to the target’s next turn, added round or out-of-initiative window. |

**Resolution:** After the triggering Action’s actual commitments/beginning hooks but before its first main outcome, cast this Reaction. Only an Action qualifies, including a separately authorized extra Action; not a Bonus Action, Reaction, individual later attack within an already-resolving Attack Action or held-spell release that is merely a Reaction. The creature makes an Intelligence save. Success: neither new component. Failure: cancel the still-pending whole Action if the shared hard-control allowance and actual defenses permit, and independently prevent its opportunity attacks through the numbered-round endpoint.

For Attack, interrupt before any attack outcome and cancel that whole pending Action. For a spell Action, normal costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and beginning hooks are already committed; they remain. Distract is itself a counterable spell; nested interruption uses normal last-in/first-out order, resuming surviving parents once without repaying or replaying hooks. One creature may attempt ordinary/same-named Distract at most once against one pending Action unless an exact source grants another attempt; claim that attempt at legal Distract cast commitment, including if this cast is later countered. Another Reaction alone supplies no extra attempt. If the parent Action is no longer pending when this legal Distract resolves, it cancels nothing and claims no hard-denial allowance for a nonexistent cancellation; its failed-save opportunity-attack rider can still apply.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** Completed outcomes, beginning-hook consequences and costs cannot be undone. No general Reaction loss, cancellation of every action on a turn, or free target/rank identification. Ordinary Counterspell remains a different source and its ordinary spell-negation does not spend the hard-denial allowance. An unused or already-canceled Action supplies no new trigger; there is no qualifying Distract trigger outside established numbered initiative. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.

### Voice of Peace

**ID:** `voice-of-peace` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it. |

**Resolution:** If the chosen creature cannot hear and understand your words at resolution, no ceasefire applies. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: none. Failure: establish a ceasefire toward you and the creatures it then actually recognizes as your participating allies; record those participants at application.

The target cannot voluntarily initiate an attack or knowingly harmful effect against those recorded participants. It can act, move, speak, decline negotiation, defend through nonharmful choices and act against nonparticipants normally. End the ceasefire immediately if you or a recorded participating ally commits an attack or knowingly harmful effect against the target or someone the target actually recognizes at that event as its ally. Commitment breaks it even on a later miss/prevented effect. Mere insult, argument, approach, suspicion or unsupported threat does not count. Already committed outcomes are not reversed. Participants are fixed for this application: later allies are not silently enrolled; a new paid successful cast can establish a new set.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** Initial hearing, shared language, range and line of effect are not ongoing tethers. No forced treaty, agreement, Diplomacy success, permanent alliance, faction standing or Charmed condition. Recognized relationships use actual established knowledge, not a hidden membership/allegiance scan. One ceasefire per caster/target; new failed save replaces that caster’s old application/participant set/deadline, successful save or ineligible application leaves a valid old one intact. Other-caster ceasefires retain separate participants and endpoints. This limited harm restriction is not whole-Action denial. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, one enemy’s ceasefire unless provoked. NEW: WIS, minute, initial hearing/language and participant/provocation scope. Exact completion snapshots the protected participating group while checking actual recognition of the target’s allies at a provoking event.

<a id="spell-command"></a>

### Command

**ID:** `command` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect; speak one word in a language you know. Actual hearing/understanding and hidden impossibility/prohibited conduct are resolved after payment, not through a free targeting oracle. | One commanded regular turn, no concentration; ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding the current turn if underway. Extra turns do not execute the order. Outside initiative, resolve one ordinary behavior opportunity within6elapsed seconds; establish initiative if combat timing matters. |

**Resolution:** If it cannot hear/understand the word, no command applies. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new command. Failure: it must perform a legal bounded interpretation on its next regular turn, using only its actual existing permissions. An impossible or prohibited command creates no behavior; no replacement word is chosen. Reserve the shared hard-control allowance when establishing any actual whole-Action/turn component. If blocked, only independently satisfiable non-hard movement/interaction portions may apply; do not invent another command.

After ordinary start-phase events, obey before contradictory voluntary choices. Approach: spend ordinary available movement toward you by a safe legal route, stopping on reaching an adjacent legal space or exhausting safe meaningful progress. Flee: spend ordinary available movement away by a safe legal route. Neither forces Dash or grants movement. Drop: ordinarily release one releasable held object chosen by the target/controller, using its actual ordinary release permission; ownership never transfers and normal later recovery remains possible. Halt: refrain from voluntary movement for that turn, without imposing Speed0 or preventing actual involuntary transport. Grovel: become/remain Prone for that turn if capable, without automatically losing Actions or legal crawling. Other one-word commands may require at most one coherent ordinary action/movement/interaction within this same turn and the limitations below; the word never grants an otherwise unavailable action or named condition. The target/controller chooses lawful details, safe route and object where the word leaves choices.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** No compelled attack/knowingly harmful act, direct self-harm, known serious hazard, protected/private secret disclosure, permanent surrender/ownership transfer, knowing binding-oath/duty violation, spell or optional limited-resource expenditure. If circumstances make the commanded behavior prohibited or impossible before execution, that portion fails rather than rewriting the word or extending the deadline. One pending Command application per target across casters; a later legally established failed-save application replaces it. No restoration of an older replaced command or spent hard-control allowance. A saved-against/wholly invalid new command creates no replacement. Simultaneous unresolved decisions use ordinary initiative order, else a fixed neutral order, never a caster’s after-the-fact preference. Unaffected Actions/BA/Reactions and movement remain; one-time Drop/Approach/Flee instructions finish once satisfied, while Halt/Grovel persist for the affected turn. Compelled movement uses the target’s movement and can provoke normal opportunity attacks. Hard whole-Action/turn components use the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their own defense checks. A successfully established hard component claims the allowance once, not again each turn; ending, dispelling, replacing or suppressing it does not refund the encounter history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, actual one-word compulsion for1round. NEW: WIS/hearing/language and bounded safe-command procedure. Exact completions retain other bounded words, define ordinary action costs, nonbanking competition and one-time versus turn-long instructions; they do not turn compulsion into voluntary advice.

<a id="spell-alignment-suggestion"></a>

### Alignment Suggestion

**ID:** `alignment-suggestion` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect. No requirement that its alignment be known; hidden canonical axes are resolved after paid casting. | Concentration, up to1minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it. |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target, retaining all independent actual alignment effects/records. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.

The changed values are the target’s actual effective canonical alignment for rules that query those axes during the overlay, including real alignment-gated spells/items. Example: baseline Chaotic Evil targeted by a Lawful Good caster becomes Neutral Neutral; one such overlay never jumps two steps. Its values remain fixed until expiry/removal/replacement and do not recompute every time another underlying record changes. Unchanged/unoverlaid axes follow their actual underlying records. An independent effect such as Corrupted can change underlying alignment while this spell persists; that change remains and is exposed when the applicable overlay ends. One Alignment Suggestion overlay per target across casters; recasting cannot use its old overlay as a staircase for another same-spell step.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** The spell grants no automatic knowledge of either character’s axes, including whether a value changed. Actual information protections still govern observations. It never compels matching behavior, belief, confession, loyalty, PvP, personality or oathbreaking; conduct clauses still judge actual conduct. Ending removes only this overlay, without restoring an old alignment snapshot, deleting independent changes or reviving a replaced overlay. Caster orientation is fixed at application, not tracked through later caster changes. Ward tag creates no ward. More specific alignment-changing effects retain their actual interaction rules; this card does not invent a general priority engine for every unrelated overlay. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,M/F as focus, WIS, concentration minute and actual push toward caster alignment. NEW: temporary canonical one-step overlay on both eligible axes. Exact-review proposals: compute without previous same-spell overlay to prevent recast ratcheting, overlay only genuinely changed axes, fixed values, and no new application when no defined axis changes; independent base changes survive ending.

In initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. Outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it. |

**Resolution:** Use the actual casting class’s school/rank/price: Enchantment rank 2/base 3 RP for Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard or Paladin access; Divination rank 4/base 7 RP for Cleric, Ranger or Shaman access. Actual minimum class levels and repertoire still apply; paying another price does not grant the other placement. Both modes use a Charisma save. Each creature saves once at its first eligible exposure to this application, either on creation, entry or newly exposed line of effect while already geometrically inside. Success makes it unaffected by this cast for the cast’s remainder. Failure creates a communication restriction which is suppressed outside the sphere or behind total cover and resumes on eligible re-entry/exposure without another save.

An affected creature cannot voluntarily assert as true a proposition it currently believes false with intent to deceive. The prohibition covers speech, writing, sign and another actual language-capable communication method; it grants no new communication ability and requires no shared language with the caster. An attempted deliberate false assertion cannot be voluntarily communicated; the creature may choose a lawful statement or silence. It can refuse, remain silent, evade, omit facts, answer narrowly, use literally true misleading wording, state sincerely mistaken beliefs, identify another person’s words as a quote, or use obvious fiction/jokes/hypotheticals not presented as true facts. It need not reveal a secret or provide useful answers.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** No forced speech, objective-truth test, memory search, hidden-belief access or magical disclosure of who saved/failed/is affected is created. The affected creature recognizes its own inability only when it attempts the prohibited assertion, without learning new facts. Existing written records, earlier statements and other people’s observations are not rewritten; ordinary observable behavior remains ordinary evidence, not magical certification. The Divination placement’s behavioral restriction is not magical information acquisition, so Protection from Scrying does not itself authorize lying; independent Divination information effects retain their own protections. The Enchantment placement does not acquire Divination classification. Independent zone casts keep distinct saves, durations, concentration and exposure records; restriction does not stack magnitude, and one successful save does not defeat a different cast. No Charmed, compelled Action, hard-denial use, harm-ending clause or automatic source-rank upgrade is added. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md defines first eligible exposure, independent save histories, temporary total-cover suppression and resumption. The sphere's center stays fixed; moving/teleporting a creature does not move the zone. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: both original placements/Core blocks, actual class school/rank/prices, Action/range 15 feet/V,S,F, 15-foot Enchantment radius and cannot-lie/CHA rule. NEW: unified geometry/procedure with concentration minute, CHA harmonization for the unspecified Divination save, one save per exposed creature/application and exact deliberate-assertion scope. The higher Divination price is preserved as an explicit open balance/source redundancy, not an invented extra benefit.

**ID:** `dire-charm` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

A blocked servant component does not prevent independently legal Charmed. Successful Charmed replaces only this caster’s prior Dire Charm Charmed relation; successful servant control replaces only the one existing Dire Charm servant component on this target across casters. Apply those replacements component by component, only when the corresponding new component really establishes.

At each future regular target-turn beginning, after ordinary start-phase events, you may consciously give one brief audible order in a language the target actually hears and understands. This costs no Action/Bonus Action beyond ordinary brief communication. One coherent order may direct actual ordinary movement, one ordinary Action and one ordinary free interaction, such as approach a door, open it and attack a known guard. An ordered Attack Action uses the creature’s actual native ordinary attack sequence, including inherent Extra Attack or ordinary native Multiattack, without adding attacks beyond that Action. With no valid order, or no actually established servant component, it retains normal agency subject to actual Charmed and other effects. Repeat the recorded Wisdom save at each affected regular-turn END, including the current turn if applied during it; extra turns provide neither orders nor repeat saves. Success ends only components still active from that cast’s application ID.

No harm-ending clause is added. Replacement of servant control leaves existing Charmed relations intact; a Charmed-only cast can coexist with another application’s servant. A repeat save, expiry or removal never deletes replacement components belonging to a later application. Stop scheduling a cast’s saves once none of its components remains. Ending Charmed does not silently end independent servant control, and vice versa. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across classes, spells and companions. It can halt further hostile commitments in a fight already underway; it does not cancel initiative or rewind attacks/spells/effects committed before application. End this creature’s restriction immediately when any creature commits an attack or knowingly harmful effect against it or a creature it actually recognizes at that event as its ally. Commitment ends it even if the attack later misses or harm is prevented. No secret affiliation scan supplies that recognition.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

No alliance, treaty, Charmed, automatic negotiation, blanket Action loss or manufactured hard-control use is imposed. ### Calm Emotions

**ID:** `calm-emotions` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 20 ft | Choose a point you perceive within 20 feet and line of effect. Create a fixed 20-foot-radius sphere centered there. It can affect all creatures within the sphere with line of effect from its center, including allies, yourself and creatures you do not individually perceive; it supplies no roster or hidden-target diagnostic. | Concentration, up to 1 minute. A successfully applied record is active only during eligible exposure to this fixed zone. In initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. Outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it. |

**Resolution:** At a creature’s first eligible exposure to this application, a willing creature may accept automatically; otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. This is one application-specific acceptance/save decision, not a generic waiver of other spells’ saves. A successful save makes it unaffected by this cast for the rest of this cast, even on re-entry. Acceptance or failure creates this cast’s calm record. Geometrically present creatures behind total cover are not yet exposed; later exposure counts as their first eligible entry. Existing results are never rerolled merely because of leaving/re-entering, temporary cover, changed willingness or a new emotional trigger.

While its accepted/failed-save record is exposed, ordinary intense emotion such as panic, uncontrolled anger, grief or euphoria is subdued, and the mechanical effects of its actual Frightened condition records are suppressed. This includes a new Frightened source applied while calm is active: create that underlying source normally, retain its duration/maintenance and scheduled repeat saves, but suppress its Frightened effects while this calm applies. Leaving the sphere, interposed total cover, ending concentration or this application’s expiry removes this source of suppression. Any still-existing Frightened record can resume when no other valid suppressor remains; no initial one-time application event is replayed.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** Acceptance cannot be freely withdrawn to dispel the spell; actual ending/removal permissions still work. No generic Charmed, Stunned, Incapacitated, enchantment, Corrupted, Strain, Dissonance or Refrain removal/suppression is added. A class technique is not disabled because its name/flavor contains rage, fury, empathy or madness: its exact active source must explicitly depend on maintaining an emotional state. Mooncursed, Momentum Rampage, Divine Fury, Fury of the Host and Beast Empathy do not acquire such a dependency here. Their actual separate Frightened riders can be suppressed on affected recipients. Beliefs, memories, grievances, allegiances, judgment and agency remain; this spell does not impose indifference, prevent attacks, end combat, heal resources or repair oaths. Harm is not an additional ending trigger. Independent calm zones retain separate histories and concentration; their identical calming/suppression does not stack numerical magnitude. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md defines first eligible exposure, independent save histories, temporary total-cover suppression and resumption. The sphere's center stays fixed; moving/teleporting a creature does not move the zone. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action/range 20 feet/V,S,F and a sphere suppressing strong emotions. NEW: explicit 20-foot radius, fixed center, concentration minute, application-specific willingness/WIS, first-exposure history, conditional ongoing zone membership and actual Frightened suppression only. Exact current class cards substantiate the thematic-name limit. No creature-type restriction or automatic calming of unrelated class mechanics is imported.

At each future regular target-turn beginning after start-phase events, you may consciously designate its ordinary movement and one ordinary Action for that turn. This mental designation requires no hearing/language or additional Action/Bonus Action. An ordered Attack Action uses its actual ordinary native attack sequence, including inherent Extra Attack or ordinary native Multiattack, without granting another Action or optional resource. Required ordinary ammunition is spent normally. You choose only from information you actually possess; the target/controller supplies legal details left open. Distances use the ordinary map metric. This is a voluntary boundary restriction, not Root, Restrained, Speed 0, a Speed reduction or a whole-Action denial; no hard-control allowance is claimed.

Within 10 feet of the anchor, the creature may move normally, including tangentially, but cannot voluntarily move, self-teleport or willingly accept transport beyond that boundary. It cannot choose voluntary transport away from the anchor’s plane. Actual involuntary movement/teleport/hostile transport can move it outside, without snapback. While involuntarily outside on the anchor’s plane, voluntary movement or transport may reduce or preserve its current distance but cannot increase it; once within 10 feet again, the original boundary governs. This applies the same voluntary rule to walking and transport. If involuntarily moved to another plane, the restriction has no cross-planar distance effect while separated; concentration and the original clock continue. Return to the anchor’s plane before expiry resumes the rule against the original anchor.

Ending concentration ends this application only. Independent boundary applications retain separate anchors/deadlines; legal voluntary movement must satisfy each active restriction, without numerical stacking or new condition identity.
