<a id="spell-hypnotic-pattern"></a>

### Hypnotic Pattern

**ID:** `hypnotic-pattern` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | Choose a point you perceive with line of effect: within 60 feet for actual Enchantment casting access, or within 30 feet for actual Illusion casting access. Center a fixed 30-foot cube on that point, extending 15 feet along each axis. At resolution snapshot every creature physically in the cube with line of effect from its center that can actually see the pattern, including allies and yourself; no selective omission. The numeric range field records the maximum mode, not permission for Illusion to use 60 feet. | Concentration, up to one minute, with independent damage/rousing endings per affected creature. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; no timing-mode change resets it. |

**Resolution:** Use the actual class’s school and rank-3/5-RP access. Enchantment access belongs to Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard and Paladin at their preserved levels; Monk’s actual mode is Illusion. Each eligible creature makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new components. Failure independently attempts Core Charmed toward you and actual Incapacitated. Charmed immunity blocks only Charmed; the Incapacitated component has its own defenses and shared hard-control allowance. A blocked hard component can leave independently legal Charmed. Apply the NEW spell-specific atomic initial batch in the shared rank-three manuscript: snapshot eligibility, resolve saves and legal components, apply every target’s components/immediate consequences, then process queued teardown of this Pattern if your own Incapacitated ended its concentration. Do not abort later targets because of iteration order.

Actual Charmed and Incapacitated retain their separate printed effects. Incapacitated ends applicable existing concentration and denies its ordinary covered action types; it does not inherently set Speed to 0. If self-Incapacitated ends your Pattern, other targets still receive that same initial batch and its real immediate consequences before this cast’s maintained components are removed. The visible lights remain in the fixed cube while concentration lasts but grant no general illumination, concealment or sight through obscurity. This is an initial snapshot: later entrants or initially ineligible creatures do not receive new applications. Later loss of sight does not end an existing application. End both still-present components from this cast on a creature when it receives positive post-defense/pre-temp-HP damage, or when another creature within physical reach uses an Action to rouse one selected Pattern application. Damage resolution preserves already-established hit/critical outcomes. No repeat saves.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** A fully prevented zero damage packet does not wake; a positive packet can wake even when temporary HP or an HP floor prevents ordinary HP loss. Rousing ends one actual cast’s application only, not every Pattern or unrelated condition source. If the helper cannot distinguish several Pattern applications, select one by stable application order without disclosing hidden source metadata. Recasts create independent sources subject to actual concentration transitions and each new hard-component check; an exact multiple-concentration feature does not convert them into refreshes. A Charmed-only remnant receives no invented repeat save. No unaware, Unconscious, Prone, Speed 0 or forced item drop is added. Ordinary darkness/obscurity can prevent initial actual sight even though the pattern itself is visible. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: both schools/rank-3/5-RP class access, Action/V/S/F, Enchantment range 60 and Illusion range 30, concentration minute, Charmed/Incapacitated; Illusion supplies 30-foot cube and WIS. NEW: harmonized cube/save for Enchantment, perceived center/center-LoE/sight snapshot, separate components, waking, and spell-specific atomic self-concentration cleanup. No unprinted Speed 0 or entry aura is imported.

<a id="spell-suggestion"></a>

### Suggestion

**ID:** `suggestion` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One creature you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. State one reasonable finite course of conduct in ordinary language before the save; actual hearing, understanding, hidden reasonableness and prohibitions are resolved after paid commitment. | Up to eight elapsed hours, no concentration. Ends earlier on task completion, actual removal, or when the remaining task becomes materially unreasonable, prohibited or no longer reasonably achievable in its established scope. A single identifiable conditional trigger may be awaited within the same original eight-hour deadline; no expiry reset on initiative, plane or circumstance changes. |

**Resolution:** If the target cannot hear/understand or the instruction is invalid, establish nothing and choose no substitute task. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new compulsion. Failure: establish the legal finite task. If that defined task necessarily requires any whole ordinary Actions, even after a future conditional trigger, establish/claim its hard-control component once now. If blocked, only an independently meaningful compliant soft task achievable with legal movement/interactions may establish. A genuinely established soft remainder can replace a prior Suggestion; a wholly invalid, saved-against or wholly blocked attempt cannot. One active Suggestion per target across casters; a later established task replaces the older without restoring it or refunding hard history.

The target genuinely pursues the established reasonable task using only its existing ordinary movement, Action and interaction permissions. Examples include ordinary travel, finite work, waiting/guarding, delivering/retrieving an ordinary item, speaking or meeting someone. An ordinary hostile act is possible only when actually reasonable given its existing beliefs, loyalties, knowledge and circumstances; the caster gains no diagnostic of those facts. Legal route, method and unspecified details remain target/controller choices. The persistent instruction’s priority timestamp is successful establishment and it uses shared Compelled Budget Arbitration at each relevant opportunity. Outside initiative use ordinary elapsed work/travel; when combat timing matters, establish ordinary initiative and existing budgets. No repeating virtual control cycle or additional Actions is granted.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** No indefinite obey-me relationship, direct self-harm, knowingly serious hazard, unreasonable betrayal/murder of a recognized ally, compelled spellcasting/RP, consumables/charges/limited-use resources, protected/private secrets, permanent surrender of materially valuable property or knowing binding-oath/duty violation. Reasonable ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks and normal required ammunition within actual limits; optional finite riders and special finite-feature ammunition remain forbidden. A task established without a hard component never acquires one later. If new obstacles would necessarily require an unreserved whole Action, use an achievable legal alternative within its original soft scope or end the remaining compulsion. Mere delay/inconvenience or a temporary obstruction does not end a still-reasonable achievable finite task. No repeat save or separate harm-ending clause is added; new violence/facts may instead make remaining conduct unreasonable. Bonus Actions, Reactions and separately granted extra Actions are not commandeered. No hidden future information or new communication ability is supplied. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, actual reasonable-suggestion compulsion for up to eight hours; effect overrides Instantaneous placeholder. NEW: WIS, hearing/language, no concentration, finite task/conditional trigger, actual reasonableness/resource/conduct limits, establishment-time hard reservation, same-spell replacement and persistent arbitration timestamp. Stronger than Minor Suggestion’s optional nudge; high-impact duration/control remains an explicit human-balance concern.

<a id="spell-slow"></a>

### Slow

**ID:** `slow` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action (Enchantment); Reaction (Transmutation) | 60 ft | Actual Enchantment mode: choose up to six creatures you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. Actual Transmutation mode: the triggering creature must be perceived within 60 feet and line of effect and must be selected; choose up to five additional such creatures. The actual casting class determines school/mode; paying the same rank-3/base-5-RP price never grants the other package. | Both modes: concentration, up to one minute. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; no timing-mode change resets it. |

**Resolution:** Enchantment uses an Action and an independent Wisdom save per target. Transmutation uses a Reaction when a creature you perceive within 60 feet/line of effect begins a distinct voluntary movement segment or begins an Action on its own actual turn, after required declaration/commitment and before the segment’s first step or Action’s first main outcome. An extra turn can trigger; Bonus Actions and Reactions cannot. Transmutation gives each chosen target an independent Constitution save. Success: no new effect for that target. Failure: apply only that actual mode’s independently defended rider set. Each affected creature repeats that mode’s recorded WIS or CON save at every affected regular-turn END, including the current regular turn if applied during it; success ends that cast’s application on that creature. Extra turns grant no ending saves. Outside initiative an otherwise legally established ongoing effect uses the specifically bound six-second END-save cadence, never a new Reaction trigger.

Enchantment failure: half Speed under existing strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration; -2 AC; -2 Dexterity ability checks and Dexterity saving throws, expressly excluding initiative; and at most one full Action commitment per actual turn. It changes no DEX score/modifier, DEX attack/damage, spell DC or other unnamed derived statistic. AC has only its separate -2. Count an Action already committed before application toward the ceiling; an already-legally-committed second Action still finishes, but no further Action can be committed that turn. The ceiling applies independently on extra turns; it retains Bonus Actions, Reactions and inherent attacks in a legal Attack Action. Transmutation failure: half Speed, -2 AC and no future Reaction commitments. It imposes no DEX penalty or Action ceiling. Already-committed unresolved Reactions remain on the LIFO stack. Neither mode grants unprinted spell delay, attack-count restriction, Action/Bonus-Action interchange, cancellation or teleport restriction.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

**Limits:** Transmutation’s movement trigger is one distinct segment, such as moving, performing an Action, then resuming movement; choosing another square during continuous movement is not a new segment, and individual feet/tiles are never new triggers. A paid Slow remains independent if a legal nested interruption removes the original parent Action: resolve it against still-legal selected targets, without refund, revival or parent cancellation. A surviving parent Action continues after the interrupt stack; movement recalculates remaining legal allowance before the next expenditure, keeping all movement already spent. The one-Action ceiling, Reaction denial and other soft riders do not claim whole-Action hard-control allowance. Actual narrowly scoped defenses can suppress individual components. Each cast/mode retains separate caster, concentration, saves and deadline. Half-Speed records compete against the same pre-control Speed, then existing later systemic multipliers apply. Identical Slow -2 AC and DEX penalties do not add; independent Enchantment and Transmutation casts may supply their distinct surviving riders together. Enchantment access: Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard, Paladin. Transmutation access: Dragoon, Druid, Mage, Monk, Ranger, Shaman, Tinker. Preserve each exact minimum class level. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: both school/rank-3 modes, 60 feet, V/S/F, up to six targets; Enchantment Action/half Speed/-2 AC/-2 DEX/one action, and Transmutation Reaction/half Speed/-2 AC/no Reactions. NEW: WIS versus CON, concentration minute/repeat END saves, explicit distinct-segment/Action Reaction window with mandatory triggering target, scoped DEX exception and full-Action ceiling. No mode union from a single cast; independent overlaps keep provenance.

### Ray of Frost

**ID:** `ray-of-frost` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |

Strike one creature with a freezing ray for 1d8 cold damage and a temporary 10-foot Speed reduction.

**Scaling:** None; damage remains 1d8 and Speed reduction remains 10 feet.

### Sacred Flame

**ID:** `sacred-flame` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you can perceive within range; total cover still blocks targeting | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** The target makes a Dexterity save against your spell save DC. On failure, it takes 1d8 radiant damage. On success, it takes no damage.

Radiant flame descends on one creature. The spell ignores AC or save bonuses provided solely by half cover or three-quarters cover, but total cover prevents targeting.

**Scaling:** None; damage remains 1d8 at all class levels.

**Limits:** A successful save negates all damage; there is no half damage. 'Ignores cover' is bounded to cover bonuses and does not permit targeting through total cover, walls, or blocked line of effect. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, V/S components, and Dexterity save are retained. Source explicitly says the save negates damage, so no half-damage rule is added. Cover language is operationally bounded rather than treated as permission to ignore total cover.

### Hellish Rebuke

**ID:** `hellish-rebuke` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reaction — when a creature within 30 feet that you can perceive deals damage to you | 30 ft | The creature that triggered the Reaction | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** Each target makes a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking 2d10 fire damage on failure or half on success.

After a creature damages you, use your Reaction to force that source to make the stated save. The triggering damage is not undone. You must remain able to take a Reaction after the damage.

**Scaling:** None; damage remains 2d10 at all class levels.

**Limits:** Cannot target a different creature, cannot trigger from self-inflicted damage, redirected damage for which the selected creature was not the source, or copied damage that lacks an originating creature. Verify range/perception before paying; an already illegal target cannot trigger a cast. If a legal paid cast is later countered or interrupted it is not refunded. It cannot recursively trigger itself from reflected or copied damage. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Reaction, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S/F components are preserved. The source explicitly ties the Reaction to being damaged but supplies no save or attack resolution; automatic 2d10 against the triggering source is the NEW provisional resolution. F is represented as an existing class casting focus. REVIEW CORRECTION: Core generic Automatic or opposed wording does not establish automatic damage. This pilot explicitly adds a Dexterity save for half; the initial no-save draft is retained in the audit only.

<a id="spell-freezing-touch"></a>

### Freezing Touch

**ID:** `freezing-touch` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | One creature you perceive and can physically touch within your actual legal reach, with line of effect. The 5-foot reference describes ordinary Touch reach; the spell does not grant extended reach. | Instantaneous damage; delayed Speed rider during one next-regular-turn window, no concentration. Follow the explicit onset/expiry procedure in Effect, rather than applying an immediate one-round slow. |

**Resolution:** Make one melee spell attack. Miss: no damage or scheduled rider. Hit: deal 1d4 cold and establish one pending -5-foot Speed rider under its own defenses.

In initiative, schedule onset at the target’s next future regular-turn START, excluding any current turn entirely, and expiry at that same future regular turn’s END. There is no immediate slowing. Start processing precedes voluntary movement; end-phase events precede expiry. If initially cast outside initiative, schedule onset at application +6 elapsed seconds and expiry at +12. If initiative begins while onset is pending, map onset to the next actual regular target START even if before original +6; expiry is the earlier of that affected regular END and original +12. No +6 not-before floor remains, and reaching +12 first ends the pending rider without later activation. If initiative begins after outside onset has occurred, the active rider simply retains its original +12 expiry, with no new full-turn window. Effects initially created in initiative preserve both original future START and corresponding END as virtual markers on exit; no restart. Extra turns neither activate nor consume these regular markers, but an already-active rider affects movement during an extra turn within its active interval. Compute Speed with the existing strongest adverse slow from pre-control Speed, minimum 0, followed by independently applicable system modifiers; retain already-spent movement.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** Multiple Freezing Touch penalties never add -5 repeatedly. Each hit can schedule a separate future window; a hit during an already-slowed regular turn may schedule its next regular turn. Pending/active records retain their own endpoints through suppression, absence, initiative reordering and travel. No Frozen, Rooted, forced movement or whole-Action denial is added. A hit establishes the independent rider under its own defenses even if the damage is reduced to 0; immunity to the damage type alone does not prevent that rider. A later independent application retains its own endpoint; ending one removes only that application, and equal penalties/prohibitions do not stack magnitude. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base rank 0 costs 0 RP but does not waive real extra costs or Refrain. V requires audible speech; S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception. No F is added. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles only actual damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, Touch, V/S, 1d4 cold and -5 feet next turn. NEW: melee spell attack; hit-based independent Speed rider; delayed next-regular-START/END window; outside +6/+12 and exact initiative-entry transition with retained +12 cap. This is not an immediate generic one-round slow.

| Mage | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| Wizard | 0 | 1 | 0 |

### Flame Lash

**ID:** `flame-lash` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|

An object worn/carried by an unwilling creature needs an actual separate object-targeting permission; this spell grants none. | Instantaneous spell; any ignited ordinary fuel continues only as a mundane fire under its own material/environmental rules. No concentration. |

**Resolution:** Make one melee spell attack with 30-foot reach, against the actual target AC. Miss: no damage or ignition. Hit: deal 1d6 fire; check the independently scoped object-ignition rider.

If the actual hit target is an ordinary flammable object/portion with adequate fuel that can sustain mundane ignition, ignite it subject to actual material, ignition and fire defenses. This is an independent successful-hit rider rather than a positive-damage trigger. The resulting flame uses ordinary mundane-fire procedures. Nonflammable or saturated material does not become combustible. Creature damage does not automatically ignite clothing, armor, hair or carried equipment.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** This unusual 30-foot reach belongs solely to this melee spell attack. It changes no general melee reach, threatened area, opportunity-attack reach, weapon reach or other spell. It grants no additional opportunity attack. No automatic Burning condition, conjured fuel, environmental damage packet or secondary object attack. Legal object defenses and durability remain; ignore none merely because a target is flammable. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED CONFLICT: the effect says melee range while metadata says 30 feet. The reviewed NEW reconciliation is a 30-foot melee spell attack, retaining both original statements. NEW: attack resolution, actual legal object defenses and hit-based ignition boundary. It is not a rewrite to ranged damage or ordinary Touch reach.

<a id="spell-soundburst"></a>

### Soundburst

**ID:** `soundburst` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | Choose a perceived point within 5 feet and line of effect. Affect every creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered there with line of effect from the center, including yourself and allies when geometrically included; no selective omission. | Instantaneous damage; one target-round Deafened, no concentration. The rider ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding its entire current turn if already underway. Outside initiative it ends six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or outside absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; end-phase events precede expiry cleanup. |

**Resolution:** Each affected creature independently makes a Constitution save. Success: no damage or Deafened. Failure: take the shared 1d4 thunder result and independently attempt actual Deafened under its own defenses.

Roll 1d4 thunder once for the cast and use that same raw result for all failed saves, applying each target’s own damage defenses separately. Failed saves apply actual Deafened: use its existing hearing consequences. Thunder resistance/immunity affects damage only unless it also expressly protects hearing/the rider; Deafened immunity prevents only that component. Neither failed-save component requires positive damage from the other.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** The sphere is an initial snapshot, not a persistent zone or entry aura. No Stunned, forced movement, concentration loss, extra save, automatic Burning or generic hard-control claim. Each Deafened application has its own endpoint; removing one leaves unrelated sources. Ordinary noise follows actual hearing/environmental rules, with no invented fixed alarm radius. ### Arcane Echo

**ID:** `arcane-echo` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bonus Action | 30 ft | One willing creature, including yourself, that you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. No ongoing range/line-of-effect tether is created after legal application. | Pending arm: up to one minute, no concentration. In initiative the maximum ends at the caster’s tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that original regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline across initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; no timing-mode change resets it. A generated repeat has its separate recipient-clock expiry described in Effect; consuming/expiring the old arm never expires that independent repeat. |

**Resolution:** On successful resolution establish one pending Arcane Echo arm on the recipient; a new successful arm replaces only their older arm, across all casters. A countered/failed new application replaces nothing. At the recipient’s next legally committed qualifying cast, consume the arm and generate one repeat permission before its counter window. An illegal uncommitted attempt does not consume it.

A qualifying original has actual rank 0 through its chosen class/source, a selected mode with a printed damage payload, and actual committed Action activation. Whether it later hits, is saved against, deals 0 or is countered does not alter qualification. Ready preparation of an Action damaging cantrip qualifies at actual cast commitment; its later release is not another cast. An actual feature conversion to Bonus Action/Reaction does not qualify. Record the original spell ID, actual class/source, school, rank-0 placement and selected damaging mode. Generate one permission to cast that SAME provenance again as a Bonus Action; a new generated permission replaces any older unused repeat on that recipient. It is usable after the original’s entire cast/interrupt stack has resolved, including later that same turn if a legal Bonus Action remains. It expires at the recipient’s first future regular-turn END, excluding the entire recipient current turn if already underway; outside initiative, six elapsed seconds after qualifying commitment. Preserve its original regular/virtual endpoint or absolute deadline across timing changes. At repeat commitment revalidate actual current repertoire/access, components, legal targets and parameters within that same mode, costs and Bonus Action availability. New legal targets/points/parameters are allowed, but no class/school/rank/mode substitution. Consume the repeat permission at its own legal paid commitment, even if later countered/missed/saved against/0damage. The repeat is a genuine independent spell cast with its own rolls, counter window, actual costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and normal cast/outcome hooks. Only its casting type becomes Bonus Action; none of that action budget is granted.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** An Echo-generated repeat can NEVER trigger another Arcane Echo arm, even if a feature changes it back to Action. Other independently qualified normal casts can trigger a later arm. Arcane Echo itself has no damaging mode and cannot qualify. One pending arm and one already-generated repeat may coexist per recipient; a new arm alone does not erase the existing repeat, and the consumed arm’s later expiry cannot erase it. No indefinite stocking, copied spell knowledge, free components, resource duplicate or same-ID cross-class/rank access. A repeat cannot commit inside the original’s pending interrupt stack. A Readied original may remain held after preparation while a later repeat is cast; actual concentration/holding transitions still apply. Countering or ending either independent cast does not revive/refund/cancel the other. Refrain uses actual chronological casts, including any intervening cast; the original and repeat are not assumed consecutive merely because they share identity. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base rank 0 costs 0 RP but does not waive real extra costs or Refrain. V requires audible speech; S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception. No F is added. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles only actual damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Bonus Action, 30 feet, V/S and next damaging cantrip cast again as Bonus Action. NEW: willing recipient, nonconcentration one-minute arm replacing Instantaneous metadata, actual Action/rank0 damaging-mode qualifier, Ready commitment binding, locked provenance, independent next-recipient-END repeat, normal fresh-cast hooks/costs and lineage recursion guard. This is an actual cast, expressly distinct from generic copy exclusions; Universal Cantrip Echo remains a separate source identity.

### Shocking Grasp

**ID:** `shocking-grasp` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |

This source has no Touch requirement. | Instantaneous damage; one target-round restriction on future Reaction commitments, no concentration. The rider ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding its entire current turn if already underway. Outside initiative it ends six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or outside absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; end-phase events precede expiry cleanup. |

**Resolution:** Trigger after the target’s Action commits and its begin hooks occur, before its first main outcome. A Bonus Action, Reaction or movement segment is not this trigger. Spend a legal available Reaction and commit this cast, then resolve its counter/interrupt stack. Make one ranged spell attack against the still-legal triggering target. Miss: no damage or denial. Hit: deal 1d8 lightning and bar new Reaction commitments for the rider’s duration.

The triggering Action is not canceled and its paid costs remain; resume it after surviving interrupts if it still exists. Once Shocking Grasp legally commits, its triggering Action is not an ongoing tether: if another nested legal interrupt cancels that Action, Shocking Grasp still resolves against its still-legal target without reviving/refunding the parent. The no-Reactions rider applies only to future commitments; no already-committed Reaction on the current stack is erased. A normal later Reaction refresh cannot overcome the still-active prohibition, but expiry itself grants no refresh.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** An actual legal action sequence must supply the trigger outside initiative; do not manufacture repeatable free pre-initiative Reaction casts or budgets. It grants no metal-armor advantage, Action cancellation, extra attack or hard whole-Action control. The spell’s broad Reaction trigger remains an explicit human-balance question. Current-turn exclusion applies to duration even though that current Action supplied the trigger. A hit establishes the independent rider under its own defenses even if the damage is reduced to 0; immunity to the damage type alone does not prevent that rider. A later independent application retains its own endpoint; ending one removes only that application, and equal penalties/prohibitions do not stack magnitude. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.

NEW: perceived own-turn Action-start trigger after commitment/before outcome; ranged spell attack; hit-based prospective denial until future target END; parent-independent paid interrupt. ### Dancing Lights

**ID:** `dancing-lights` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | Choose one to four distinct perceived points within 30 feet and line of effect, outside solid matter. Actual Evocation or Illusion class/source access determines generating school; both use these same mechanics. | Concentration, up to one minute. In initiative the maximum ends at the caster’s tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that original regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline across initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; no timing-mode change resets it. |

**Resolution:** On successful resolution create up to four nonphysical torch-sized lights at the chosen points. One active Dancing Lights application per caster across school placements. A successful new application replaces that caster’s prior set; normal concentration transition may already have ended it at new cast commitment, and a countered cast restores nothing.

Each light provides real ordinary illumination: bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. This is usable illumination even from an actual Illusion placement. As one existing Bonus Action, consciously move any/all surviving lights once, each along a continuous non-solid path no longer than 30 feet. Each new destination must be perceived with line of effect from the caster and within 60 feet. The path may curve around obstacles but never pass through solid matter, teleport or exceed its actual distance budget. The 60-foot caster-to-light tether is checked continuously during movement of caster or light: exceeding it ends that light immediately, even if a proposed path would later return. One light ending leaves the rest. Losing caster-to-light line of effect after creation does not itself end an unmoving light; it still illuminates subject to ordinary physical barriers. A later command still needs its destination’s perception/line of effect. Lights otherwise stay at their points; no automatic following, formation lock or autonomous movement.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** Opaque barriers block ordinary illumination. Overlapping sets/radii do not add together into greater range or a higher light category merely by stacking. No heat, fuel, sunlight trait, damage, physical object, collision, attachment, automatic Invisible/Hidden revelation or generic magical-darkness dispel. Ordinary lighting can remove mundane darkness as the actual reason something was unseen; other concealment/senses remain. Commands grant no extra Bonus Action. Loss of concentration, actual removal or expiry ends the relevant lights; a stale endpoint of an older replaced set cannot erase its replacement. Actual multiple-concentration features do not bypass the one-set-per-caster cap. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.

<a id="spell-chill-touch"></a>

### Chill Touch

**ID:** `chill-touch` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | One creature you perceive and can physically touch within your actual legal reach, with line of effect. The 5-foot reference describes ordinary Touch reach; no extended reach is granted. Use the actual Evocation or Necromancy placement available to the chosen class; access is not unioned. | Instantaneous damage; one target-round broad current-HP-gain prohibition, no concentration. The rider ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding its entire current turn if already underway. Outside initiative it ends six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or outside absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; end-phase events precede expiry cleanup. |

**Resolution:** Make one melee spell attack. Miss: no damage or restriction. Hit: deal 1d8 necrotic and establish the independent HP-gain prohibition under its actual defenses.

While affected, any event increasing the target’s current HP produces 0 gain: spell/feature/potion healing, passive regeneration, natural recovery, natural-20 death-save 1HP, Stable-state 1HP and other direct restoration. Apply HEALING_DEATH_PLAYTEST.md: ordinary healing’s legal amount and genuine excess become0; ordinary activation costs remain committed, while a reserve spent only for actual restored HP spends0. Independent non-HP components still resolve. A blocked natural20 uses the already-reviewed bridge: Stable at0, death counters cleared, immediate d4-hour recovery deadline and preserved used-turn marker. A due Stable1HP recovery remains subject to its existing blocked-deadline procedure; this spell never rerolls or resets that deadline.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** No Undead/biological target prerequisite or special Undead rider. The prohibition does not itself block stabilization, successful death-save state changes, temporary HP, condition removal, damage prevention, maximum-HP changes or independent non-HP components. A maximum-HP change does not authorize a separate current-HP increase through this prohibition. Actual resurrection returned HP is the existing LIFE TRANSITION exception and is not blocked; no corpse/soul/resurrection seal is created. Actual death/condition-removal procedures retain their scope, without duplicating an identity or refreshing spent resources. This is an HP-state rule, not a cosmology ruling. A hit establishes the independent rider under its own defenses even if the damage is reduced to 0; immunity to the damage type alone does not prevent that rider. A later independent application retains its own endpoint; ending one removes only that application, and equal penalties/prohibitions do not stack magnitude. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base rank 0 costs 0 RP but does not waive real extra costs or Refrain. V requires audible speech; S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception. No F is added. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles only actual damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: both Evocation/Necromancy sources and actual access, Action, Touch, V/S, 1d8 necrotic and cannot regain HP. NEW: melee spell attack, hit-based independent broad current-HP-gain prohibition, explicit future-target-END duration, state-recovery bindings and existing resurrection life-transition boundary. Authoring clarification deliberately refines initial conference healing-only wording to the source’s broader HP-gain scope.

**ID:** `chain-jolt` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

Declare their resolution order at commitment; the same creature/object cannot receive both jolts. | Instantaneous, no concentration. |

**Resolution:** After the cast survives its interrupt window, make one ranged spell attack independently against each still-legal chosen target in declared order. Each hit deals an independently rolled 1d8 lightning; each miss deals nothing. Each attack has its ordinary attack-reaction opportunities and its own attack/damage event.

One cast supplies at most these two attacks. A lost or invalidated target receives no substituted jolt and provides no retargeting. One attack’s outcome does not change the other’s die or convert the spell into a freely bouncing chain.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** No automatic Stunned, Reaction denial, unselected secondary creature, extra reach or free ongoing link. Objects must be independently legal targets with actual object AC, durability and material/damage defenses. This spell grants no generic permission to target an unwilling creature’s worn/carried equipment, no invented object statistics and no automatic secondary equipment damage. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

### Magic Missile Storm

**ID:** `magic-missile-storm` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | Allocate exactly three numbered missiles 1, 2, 3 at cast commitment among one to three distinct creatures you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. Several missiles may share a recipient. Lock every allocation and the fixed1→2→3 resolution order before effects; no later reassignment. | Instantaneous, no concentration. |

**Resolution:** After the ordinary cast/counter window, resolve numbered missiles in order. Each missile automatically hits its still-legal assigned creature, with no attack roll or save, and deals an independently rolled1d4+1 force as its own damage packet. A creature that becomes an illegal target before an unresolved allocation receives no new corpse/object attack; that allocation is simply spent without retargeting or a location oracle.

Each of the three missiles is a separate auto-hit/damage event: apply actual DR, temporaryHP, Wounds, concentration and per-hit/packet callbacks separately where their real triggers require it. Do not combine three allocated missiles into one 3d4+3 packet or count each die as more events. NEW named interaction: only for the ordinary Shield spell’s expressly named Magic Missile exception, this spell counts as Magic Missile. At committed allocation each distinct recipient supplies one such Shield targeting opportunity for this Storm, available before that recipient’s first missile damage resolves. A willing eligible recipient can be protected by a legal Shield cast within its own actual30-foot/source/repertoire/Reaction rules; Shield has its normal cost and nested counter window. Later missiles do not reopen that allocation opportunity once its first missile damage has resolved. While Shield is actually active, every unresolved Storm missile allocated to that protected creature is prevented from dealing damage; allocations remain spent, and an auto-hit is not converted into a miss merely because its damage is prevented.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** This bridge neither renames an identity nor grants general auto-hit immunity. It does not cover Mage Arcane Missile or other class features/names. Shield is not automatically known or cast, and the Storm creates no new Reaction resources. There is no critical-hit attack roll, physical projectile item, recoverable missile or free retarget after Shield/death/immunity. Ordinary source conditions still govern hit versus positive-damage hooks; damage prevented by Shield supplies no positive damage, HP loss or positive-damage trigger merely because an auto-hit occurred. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual target/area defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action,30 feet,V/S/F,three auto-hit missiles each1d4+1. NEW: force type, numbered locked allocation/order, separate independent dice/packets and one Shield allocation trigger per recipient. <a id="spell-arcane-shield-shatter"></a>

### Arcane Shield Shatter

**ID:** `arcane-shield-shatter` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | Select one individually perceptible ongoing magical shield effect and designate one creature it currently protects. Both its legal effect-targeting locus and that creature must be perceived, within 30 feet and line of effect from you, at commitment and resolution. This spell grants no detection/identification ability or free owner/rank diagnostic. For a distributed Protective Sphere, use the explicit boundary/inside-creature procedure in Effect. | Instantaneous ending and subsequent damage, no concentration. |

**Resolution:** After paid commitment, resolve actual hidden eligibility: spell origin, recorded generating rank 0–1, eligible protective identity, ongoing operational defense of the designated creature, and susceptibility to ending. Failure of any required predicate means no ending, no damage, no replacement target and no refund. If eligible, automatically end exactly that selected effect/component through its ordinary parent/dependency callbacks. Only after successful ending, deal one automatic1d8 force packet to the designated still-legal creature. No attack/save is added. If the effect cannot actually end, there is no damage fallback.

NEW eligible-shield definition: one individually perceptible ongoing magical effect generated by an actual rank-0 or rank-1 spell whose source expressly identifies or describes it as a shield, barrier, ward or unambiguous equivalent magical protective layer, and which currently retains at least one operational defensive component protecting the designated creature. Defensive components include attack/AC protection, damage prevention/reduction/absorption, projectile or creature interception, saving-throw protection, or an actual magical defensive boundary. A generic defensive benefit does not qualify without that source-qualified identity. Stronger same-stat numerical supersession does not end eligibility; actual complete suppression of every defensive component prevents eligibility until protection resumes. An active conditional defense need not currently be triggered. The actual generating rank controls, not RP spent, discount, dispeller level or a different class placement. Reviewed examples: Arcane Ward, active Shield, active Barrier Flicker, Corruption Ward and unconsumed Minor Elemental Ward qualify subject to all gates. Rank-1 Abjuration Alignment Shield qualifies without a currently attacking opposed-alignment creature; its rank-3 Conjuration application fails the rank ceiling. Resonance Shield qualifies only if its own accepted current temporary-HP grant has points remaining and has not expired/depleted/replaced. The reviewed finite source-owned grant is an ongoing effect despite old Instantaneous metadata; this does not make historical instantaneous consequences generically dispellable. Remove only that actual accepted grant administratively, never a discarded historical grant or a replacement False Life/class pool. Administrative removal is not damage, a hit or paid absorption and triggers depletion/removal hooks only where their actual wording covers it. For Protective Sphere, choose one perceived actual boundary point within 30 feet/line of effect as the effect locus, and one perceived creature actually inside it also within 30 feet/line of effect. That creature need not be the owner, and no projectile must be in flight. End the whole one selected maintained sphere application and its actual dependencies, not a hole or segment; overlapping independent spheres remain. An outside creature cannot be designated merely through hypothetical protection by the sphere.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** Generic temporary HP, generic resistance/save buffs, information-only wards, permanent magic, items, class engines, creature traits, ordinary physical shields and spell-created purely physical objects fail this predicate unless another exact rule expressly makes that source eligible. In the reviewed comparison set, Alarm Ward, Warning Ward, False Life and Resistance are excluded. A word appearing in a name does not establish source-qualified eligibility. A save ward consumed before resolution is no longer an ongoing target. A shield numerically superseded by a stronger modifier remains distinct from wholly suppressed protection; hidden failure supplies no reason diagnostic. Ending an independent component leaves siblings unless actual parent rules link them; selecting an entire maintained application invokes its normal ending/concentration cleanup. No arbitrary sibling purge, stale-grant removal or resource restoration. Barrier Flicker’s brief eligibility grants no Action/interrupt permission: a separately legal timing mechanism must let Shatter resolve before Flicker ends. This spell’s source word arcane maps to force only for this1d8; no global arcane-to-force alias is created. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-1 placements have base 2 RP; real source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual target/area defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action,30 feet,V/S/F,shield-spell ending plus1d8arcane damage. NEW: one effect/one protected creature, actual rank 0–1 ceiling, finite semantic shield predicate and twelve explicit comparison dispositions, paid hidden predicates, successful ending before automatic damage, spell-local force interpretation, tempHP identity conservation and whole-Sphere targeting. No existing249 operational card or class engine is rewritten. Runtime eligibility metadata and numerical balance remain open.

### Ignition Bolt

**ID:** `ignition-bolt` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | One creature or independently legal object you perceive within 5 feet and line of effect. The source’s5-foot casting range is retained. The primary target determines a separate5-foot-radius splash on a hit. | Instantaneous, no concentration. |

**Resolution:** Make one ranged spell attack against the still-legal primary target. Capture its actual impact position when the attack legally resolves, before damage consequences. Miss: no primary damage or splash. Hit: roll one base 1d10 fire; the primary takes that amount. On a critical hit, roll one additional attack-only1d10 for the primary. The extra critical die is never part of the splash value.

On a hit, every OTHER creature within 5 feet of the captured impact point with line of effect from that point makes a Dexterity save, including you/allies if geometrically included. Failure: take the same base 1d10 fire result. Success: half that base result rounded down. Apply each creature’s actual defenses. The primary never receives the splash again. Primary destruction, movement or disappearance caused by its damage does not move or erase the captured impact center or already-established splash. If the primary became illegal before attack resolution, no attack/impact/splash is created.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** The primary attack packet and each secondary area packet remain distinct; area damage never critically doubles. No Burning, automatic mundane ignition, persistent fire, unselected object splash or extended casting range. A missed attack supplies no invented impact location. Objects must be independently legal targets with actual object AC, durability and material/damage defenses. This spell grants no generic permission to target an unwilling creature’s worn/carried equipment, no invented object statistics and no automatic secondary equipment damage. Initial area targets are a snapshot at resolution, with no selective omission or later entry damage. Each affected creature uses its own save/defenses; a shared raw damage roll is not a shared defensive result. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

### Earth Tremor

**ID:** `earth-tremor` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | Choose a perceived point on an actual physical supporting surface within 30 feet and line of effect. Affect a10-foot-radius patch on ONE contiguous supporting surface associated with that center, with line of effect from the center. Initial creature targets are every creature actually standing on/physically supported by that eligible patch, including you/allies; no selective omission. | Instantaneous initial damage; difficult terrain up to one minute, no concentration. In initiative the maximum ends at the caster’s tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding a start already underway/passed. Outside initiative it ends 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; no timing-mode change resets the maximum. |

**Resolution:** Each initially supported creature makes a Dexterity save. Roll3d6 bludgeoning once. Failure: full raw result; success: no damage; each creature’s actual defenses apply. Regardless of individual saves, the eligible patch becomes difficult terrain for its finite duration.

The patch is a magical movement-cost effect on existing ground, floor or platform, not permanent material alteration. Its source-defined support/line-of-effect topology does not propagate through walls, floors/ceilings to another storey, or onto disconnected/stacked platforms merely because they fit a3D radius. Air/open water supplies no qualifying supporting surface. A normal building floor can qualify without receiving structural damage. Moving through the patch uses ordinary difficult-terrain costs; flying creatures not using that surface do not incur its cost. Separate casts retain their own patches/deadlines, but identical overlapping difficult terrain does not multiply the cost.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** No recurring damage on later entry, Prone, structural cracking/collapse, excavation, rubble inventory, permanent terrain or physical difficult-terrain object survives ending. Expiry, actual removal or eligible dispelling ends the relevant magical patch; it neither rebuilds nor damages the real surface. Initial creature damage and the shared terrain effect are separate, so a successful save prevents only that creature’s initial damage. Initial area targets are a snapshot at resolution, with no selective omission or later entry damage. Each affected creature uses its own save/defenses; a shared raw damage roll is not a shared defensive result. No Burning, Frozen, Deafened, Poisoned or other unnamed condition arises merely from the damage type. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual target/area defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

### Witch Bolt

**ID:** `witch-bolt` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. Each later pulse rechecks the same continuing creature, perception,30-foot range and line of effect; those are pulse-attempt gates, not a continuous range/sensory tether between opportunities. | Concentration, up to one minute. In initiative the maximum ends at the caster’s tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding a start already underway/passed. Outside initiative it ends 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; no timing-mode change resets the maximum. Target death/ended continuing creature existence ends the tether; it is not maintained on a corpse, replacement or later resummoned/revived creature. |

**Resolution:** Make one ranged spell attack at initial resolution. Miss: no initial damage or sustained tether. Hit: deal1d12 lightning and establish the tether under its independent defenses, even if the damage becomes0. An actual defense separately preventing the tether still applies. No repeat save is added.

Starting on your next future regular turn after establishment, you may use one ordinary Action for at most one maintenance pulse on each regular turn while the tether remains. A pulse against the currently legal target automatically deals1d12 lightning with no attack/save and no additional RP. It activates the existing spell rather than casting again: no new Dissonance, Refrain, cast-begin hooks, Counterspell window or concentration transition. Actual damage/outcome hooks still apply at their real trigger scope. There is no pulse on the cast turn, no extra-turn pulse, and no second pulse because an extra Action exists. An extra Action can serve its otherwise legal purposes but does not create a pulse allowance. If target eligibility or ordinary Action availability is absent, no pulse occurs; you can retain concentration and try a later unused regular-turn opportunity. Declining maintenance also causes no pulse rather than ending the spell.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** Outside initiative, create a spell-specific six-second pulse-opportunity schedule: first opportunity at application+6, then every 6 seconds strictly before the original+60 maximum. A used pulse requires an ordinary Action-length behavior opportunity; it is not automatic round damage or a new spell cast. When hostile sequencing matters establish ordinary initiative. On entry, map the next opportunity to your next actual regular turn, which may occur before projected+6 if no virtual pulse was yet used; preserve the original+60 maximum. If a virtual pulse was already used in the currently open six-second opportunity, the first mapped real turn’s Witch Bolt pulse is already consumed, but its ordinary Action remains available for OTHER legal uses. Do not import the separate dominated-creature whole-behavior-budget bridge. Already-used opportunities never replay. After mapping, each future regular turn has at most one new pulse opportunity; extra turns never create one. On exit/reordering, retain already-established regular/virtual opportunities, their used histories and original maximum rather than creating another schedule. The tenth future caster-START maximum or absolute deadline expires before any new voluntary pulse at that time. Temporary cover, invisibility/unperceived state, distance or no Action can prevent a pulse without ending concentration; target death/ended existence does end this creature-only tether, and later resurrection cannot restore it. No corpse channel, damage without an Action, refunded initial costs, duplicate opportunity or resource-reset loop. ### Shatter

**ID:** `shatter` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 10 ft | Choose a perceived point within 10 feet and line of effect. The initial area is a 10-foot-radius sphere around it. After interruption but before any damage, fix one snapshot of all eligible creatures, ordinary nonmagical discrete objects and bounded structural sections within the sphere with center line of effect. | Instantaneous, no concentration; actual damaged objects retain ordinary damage consequences. |

**Resolution:** Roll one shared 3d8 thunder base and one shared additional 1d8 thunder object bonus. Each affected creature makes a Constitution save: failure takes the base; success takes half the base, rounded down. Creatures never receive the object bonus. Each eligible object or selected structural section takes base plus bonus as ONE grouped thunder packet, without a save, using its actual durability/material/damage defenses. Apply recipient defenses independently; do not turn the four damage dice into separate packets.

Eligible objects are ordinary nonmagical objects that are unattended, caster-held, or deliberately offered/exposed by willing holders; hostile worn/carried inventory is not automatically included. For each actual distinct large structural whole or terrain feature, select at most one contiguous exposed section wholly within the original sphere and bounded by a 5-foot cube. Use the eligible section containing its line-of-effect-reachable point nearest the spell center. Resolve equivalent nearest-point ties by stable neutral geometry/order fixed before damage, not caster choice or post-damage Director optimization. The Director determines actual structural identity and hidden boundaries without revealing them merely because the spell was cast. Arbitrarily naming bricks/panels/floorboards does not multiply one structure’s packets. A genuinely separate freestanding object remains independent. A large discrete object beyond the damage scale of its actual durability rules receives damage only to its legal affected section, not automatic transfer through the entire object. Fix all recipients and sections before any packet; destroying cover cannot expose new targets or cause another scan. Actual later support/collapse/falling consequences follow their own rules. Initial area recipients are a snapshot at resolution, with no selective omission or later entry damage. Apply the stated geometry and line of effect from the origin/center before damage removes cover; allies and caster are included only when the card actually includes their occupied space. Roll the stated raw area damage once, then apply each recipient’s save and defenses independently. Halved damage rounds down before individual defenses. Distinct recipients retain separate damage packets and callbacks. No attack critical applies to area save damage.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** The short 10-foot point range and separate 10-foot radius both apply. No damage extends outside the selected section/sphere, no automatic whole-building collapse or propagation is granted, and no Deafened, construct vulnerability, magic-item suppression or named shattered condition is added. No one can choose a concealed load-bearing element or optimize sections after damage outcomes. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-2 placements have base 3 RP; actual source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Action, 10-foot casting range, V/S/F, 3d8 thunder in 10-foot radius and extra object damage. NEW: perceived point/sphere, CON half for creatures, shared +1d8 for legal nonmagical objects in one grouped packet, fixed pre-damage snapshot and deterministic bounded structural section procedure.

<a id="spell-acid-arrow"></a>

### Acid Arrow

**ID:** `acid-arrow` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature or independently legal object you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. | Instantaneous initial attack plus one finite ongoing delayed rank-2 spell rider per successful hit, no concentration. Creature: execute at its first future regular END, excluding its current turn. Object: execute at the caster’s first future regular END, excluding the caster’s current turn. Outside initiative: application +6 seconds. Preserve the original corresponding regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline across entry/exit/reorder, absence, plane change and extra turns. |

**Resolution:** Make a ranged spell attack. Miss: no damage or delayed rider. Hit: resolve 4d4 acid, doubling only those initial attack dice on a critical. After that packet, if the same recipient remains the same continuing eligible creature/object, attach the delayed rider unless an actual defense prevents it. Initial damage reduced to 0 does not itself prevent attachment. Merely reaching 0 HP is not automatically death or loss of continuing creature identity. If the initial packet actually kills/ends that creature identity or destroys that object before attachment, no rider is created.

At its scheduled marker, an existing unsuppressed rider deals a separately rolled 2d4 acid to the same continuing recipient as one nonattack packet, then ends. This is an existing-effect consequence, not a cast: no RP, Dissonance, Refrain, cast-begin hook or Counterspell window; ordinary damage/outcome hooks keep their actual predicates. No delayed critical dice. Every qualifying hit has an independent source-owned rider, including same-ID casts by the same or different owners; they coexist rather than refresh or replace. Simultaneous due riders resolve in stable application order as separate packets. An eligible dispel/removal can end a specific pending rank-2 rider before execution despite the source’s Instantaneous cast metadata. Suppression never pauses its marker. If suppressed when due, consume the one-shot event without damage, end that rider, and never replay it after suppression lifts. Movement, lost range/line of effect/perception, caster absence and identity-preserving transformation do not alone end the rider. Actual death/ended continuing creature identity, object destruction or replacement/resummoning ends its recipient’s rider; resurrection/recreation does not inherit it. Actual transformation/source rules may independently end or suppress it.

**Scaling:** None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.

**Limits:** No delayed retargeting to a corpse, replacement or last location; no extra-turn acceleration or timing reset; no washing/scraping removal procedure, physical recoverable arrow or mundane acid material. The ordinary attack and delayed packet remain separate. A directly selected object must be perceived, within range and line of effect, and independently legal: unattended, held by the caster, or deliberately offered by a willing holder. This gives no general permission to target hostile worn/carried inventory. Use actual object AC, durability and defenses; the spell does not automatically destroy an object. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-2 placements have base 3 RP; actual source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: stable ID Acid Arrow, initial 4d4 acid and next-round 2d4. SOURCE-EVIDENCE ADOPTION: possible Melf’s Acid Arrow Core metadata supplies Action/30 feet/V,S,F/Instantaneous without identity/access merger. NEW: ranged attack, miss-none, post-initial-packet attachment, exact one-shot marker, coexistence, dispellable ongoing rider and suppression-at-execution consumption.

## Illusion

<a id="spell-ghost-sound"></a>

### Ghost Sound

**ID:** `ghost-sound` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One point you can perceive within range from which the sound originates | Instantaneous; the created sound may last no longer than 6 seconds |

**Resolution:** No roll when created. A creature actively scrutinizing the sound while it is occurring may use an Action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the sound as illusory.

Create one minor illusory sound from the chosen point, such as footsteps, a knock, a whisper, an animal noise, a dropped object, or another brief sound no louder than a normal shout.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Cannot deal damage, create thunder or sonic force, reproduce a supernatural command, supply a verbal spell component, perfectly authenticate another creature's identity, or transmit hidden knowledge you do not possess. The sound creates no physical source or cover. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are preserved. The 6-second maximum and exact Investigation-vs-Spell-DC disbelief procedure are NEW provisional illusion mechanics.

### Minor Image

**ID:** `minor-image` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 5 ft | One visual illusion fitting entirely inside a 5-foot cube whose nearest point is within range | Concentration, until the start of your next regular turn |

**Resolution:** The illusion appears automatically. A creature that uses an Action to scrutinize it makes an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the image as illusory.

Create a static visual illusion that fits inside a 5-foot cube. It can depict a creature, object, surface feature, or visible phenomenon but produces no sound, smell, heat, force, or physical substance.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The illusion cannot provide actual cover, support weight, block movement, create a usable object, cause damage, emit real light, conceal by physically obstructing line of effect, or trigger mechanisms. Creatures may still fail to realize it is false until they successfully Investigate. Cantrip repeats use Refrain. Physical passage through the image reveals its lack of substance to the interacting creature; no check is required to recognize that direct evidence. A known illusion grants no mechanical cover or blocked line of sight.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 5-foot range, V/S components, and concentration concept are retained, but Core says up to 1 minute while the source summary explicitly says the image lasts 1 round. This pilot follows the source's 1-round duration, expressed as concentration until the start of your next regular turn. Investigation vs Spell DC and nonphysical limitations are NEW provisional illusion rules.
