### Distort Voice

**ID:** `distort-voice` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self | 10 minutes |

**Resolution:** None.

Alter the audible qualities of your own voice for 10 minutes. You may make it higher, lower, rougher, smoother, older, younger, resonant, muffled, or otherwise noticeably different while remaining within the range of a humanoid-like voice.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Does not perfectly imitate a specific individual, confer a language, provide a verbal component in a voice you could not otherwise produce, increase volume beyond a normal shout, silence your speech, or grant advantage automatically on Deception. Listeners may still identify you from wording, mannerisms, context, or successful ordinary checks.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 10-minute duration, and V/S components are retained. Core lists a 30-foot range, but the source effect specifically alters 'your voice'; this pilot treats that metadata as incoherent with the effect and changes operational range to self (0 feet), explicitly as a provisional source-effect reconciliation.

<a id="spell-mirror-image"></a>

### Mirror Image

**ID:** `mirror-image` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self; creates 3 illusory duplicates occupying your space and moving with you | Concentration, up to 1 minute or until all 3 duplicates are destroyed |

**Resolution:** When an attack roll directly targets you, randomly select among you and all remaining duplicates with equal probability before the attack roll. If you are selected, resolve the attack against you normally. If a duplicate is selected, resolve the attack roll against your current AC; on a hit that duplicate is destroyed, and on a miss it remains. Area effects ignore the duplicates.

Create three illusory duplicates of yourself. Direct attack rolls may strike a duplicate instead of you until the duplicates are destroyed or concentration ends.

**Scaling:** None; always creates 3 duplicates.

**Limits:** Duplicates have no Actions, HP, independent positions, attacks, bodies, cover, collision, resource triggers, or ability to intercept saving-throw effects. They cannot be deliberately targeted by you or allies to generate procs. A creature that does not rely on sight or explicitly ignores visual illusions targets you normally. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** The two Core V2 entries conflict: one gives 30-foot range and concentration up to 1 minute, while the other gives Self and Instantaneous. Because the source consistently says duplicates of yourself, this pilot uses self range and retains the coherent 1-minute concentration duration. V/S/M/F is represented as a small reflective token or existing class casting focus. Equal random selection and duplicate-hit procedure are NEW provisional mechanics.

<a id="spell-silent-image"></a>

### Silent Image

**ID:** `silent-image` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 15 ft | One static visual illusion fitting entirely inside a 15-foot cube whose nearest point is within range | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** The illusion appears automatically. A creature that uses an Action to scrutinize it makes an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the image as illusory.

Create a static visual illusion contained within a 15-foot cube. It may depict creatures, objects, structures, surfaces, or visible phenomena, but it produces no sound, smell, heat, force, or physical substance.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The illusion cannot move after creation, provide actual cover, bear weight, block movement or line of effect, create usable objects, deal damage, emit real light, trigger traps, or physically conceal a creature from effects that do not depend on sight. Investigation vs Spell DC is the mechanical disbelief procedure. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. Physical passage through the image reveals its lack of substance to the interacting creature; no check is required to recognize that direct evidence. A known illusion grants no mechanical cover or blocked line of sight.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 15-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, V/S/F components, and source 15-foot-cube static illusion are retained. F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Exact Investigation disbelief and nonphysical limitations are NEW provisional illusion mechanics.

**ID:** `illusory-blade` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

<a id="spell-feather-fall"></a>

### Feather Fall

**ID:** `feather-fall` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | Up to 5 willing falling creatures you can perceive within range | Until each target lands, stops falling, or immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting (1 minute), whichever occurs first |

**Resolution:** None; willing legal targets are affected automatically.

Slow each target's downward descent to at most 60 feet at each once-per-round Fall Marker. Use the new provisional falling bridge in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md: dissipate prior uncontrolled momentum on application; if landing while this spell is active, impact is min(3, floor(total distance descended in this fall / 20))d6 bludgeoning. This impact limit is a new playtest decision, not recovered spell text.

**Scaling:** None; maximum descent remains 60 feet per round and target cap remains 5.

**Limits:** Grants no flight, hovering, lateral movement or automatic safe landing. A creature ceases to be affected once it lands or is no longer Falling. Targets cannot be added after casting. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. This Action requires targets still Falling when a legal Action is available; it cannot undo an impact. On expiry aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero and resume ordinary descent at the existing marker with no immediate extra step. Expiry resolves before a coincident Falling Step.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 consistently gives Action, 60-foot range, V/S/F components and the five-creature/60-feet-per-round effect, but lists Instantaneous duration despite sustained descent. Duration, initiative marker, momentum handling and impact formula are NEW provisional decisions agreed with the GPT notebook. See SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for the full procedure and source-search limits. This does not import a Reaction casting time or automatic fall-damage immunity. F is an existing class casting focus.

**ID:** `chill-of-the-crypt` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

Inflict a brief necromantic chill that reduces the target's weapon-attack damage by 1 for one turn.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration despite an ongoing damage penalty and gives no operational opposition mechanic. ### Lifedraw

**ID:** `lifedraw` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One creature you can perceive within range | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** Make a spell attack against the target. On hit, deal 3d6 necrotic damage. On miss, no damage and no healing.

On a hit, deal 3d6 necrotic damage. If the target is a living non-construct creature and takes actual damage, you regain HP equal to half the actual necrotic damage dealt, rounded down.

**Scaling:** None; damage remains 3d6 and healing remains half actual qualifying damage.

**Limits:** Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, remove Wounds, trigger another Lifedraw, generate RP, or count copied/reflected/ongoing damage. Undead, constructs, summons created solely for resource farming, allies, helpless captives, corpses, and other nonliving targets provide no healing even if damaged. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S/F components are retained. Core gives no operational attack/save procedure; spell attack is NEW provisional. Source 3d6 damage and heal-half effect are preserved, with the living-target requirement added as an explicit anti-loop bounded fix.

<a id="spell-summon-lesser-skeleton"></a>

### Summon Lesser Skeleton

**ID:** `summon-lesser-skeleton` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Lesser Skeleton companion | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** No initial roll. The skeleton's commanded melee attack uses your spell attack bonus.

Summon one Lesser Skeleton with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, and one melee attack with 5-foot reach that deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage (choose one type on casting and keep it fixed for that summon) on a hit. It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, it may be commanded with your Bonus Action to move and take its one attack or another basic action; without a command it may move and Dodge.

**Scaling:** None for source-specific AC, HP, and attack die; AC remains 13, HP remains 10, and damage remains 1d6.

**Limits:** All companions you control share one Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action total per round. The skeleton has no unstated resistances, immunities, multiattack, spellcasting, loot, XP, resource generation, death trigger, corpse-proc eligibility, or free healing. It disappears at 0 HP or when concentration ends. Recasting replaces your prior Lesser Skeleton from this spell. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. Source-specific AC 13, HP 10, and 1d6 melee override generic companion values. Speed, saves, checks, attack bonus, command economy, and anti-loop restrictions are NEW provisional specifications required by the shared summon interface. Conference decision: unspecified source melee damage gets a choice of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing, fixed when summoned; this is explicitly provisional.

<a id="spell-death-ward"></a>

### Death Ward

**ID:** `death-ward` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One living creature you can perceive within range and line of effect | Concentration, up to 1 minute; ends when its prevention is used |

**Resolution:** No initial save. While the spell remains active, the first eligible effect that would reduce the target from positive HP to 0 without Core Instant Death or another outright-death result instead leaves it at 1 HP; then the ward ends.

Prevent one positive-to-zero HP crossing. Preserve the raw damage packet, Core Instant Death check, half-maximum/Maiming Wound triggers and attached conditions. The prevented positive-to-zero crossing does not itself create a drop-only Wound save. This is loss prevention, not healing, so a cannot-regain-HP effect does not stop it. Other eligible survival effects are rechecked after the selected prevention resolves; no duplicate automatic use is consumed after the crossing has already been prevented.

**Scaling:** None. Always one eligible crossing and a 1-HP floor.

**Limits:** Does not trigger while the target is already at 0. Does not resurrect, repair a vital body, prevent third death-save failure/fatal Wound death/lethal-track death or override explicitly unpreventable HP loss. Cannot legalize an otherwise unaffordable HP cost. If multiple independently owned wards exist, use only the chosen eligible prevention; unused records retain their own concentration/deadline. This is distinct from Cleric Ritual of Undeath's would-die replacement. Normal spell costs and risk apply.

**Design decisions:** Core Necromancy rank4, 7RP, Action, 60ft and concentration1minute retained with exact class gates. M/F uses the already-reviewed class-focus alternative; no unstated material cost. NEW: living target, explicit positive crossing, outright-death exclusion and competing-prevention procedure. The agreed damage/HP-loss interface is in the candidate guide; reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.

<a id="spell-resurrection"></a>

### Resurrection

**ID:** `resurrection` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 120 ft | One willing dead creature whose sufficiently intact remains are within range and line of effect, and whose death occurred no more than 8 elapsed hours ago | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** No attack or save. Check the dead identity's willingness, sufficient body, exact elapsed death window, location and actual resurrection/soul blockers. On a legal successful resolution, return that identity to life at 1 HP.

Change Dead to Living, assign 1 returned HP, clear death-save counters and any previous Stable recovery deadline. Preserve Wounds, Corruption, Oracle Curse, other persistent death consequences and spent resources. This returned HP is a resurrection state transition, not ordinary healing; ordinary healing reductions and generic living HP-gain prohibitions do not change it. Explicit resurrection or soul blockers prevent return.

**Scaling:** None. One identity returns at 1 HP; no additional targets or restored resources.

**Limits:** Does not create a missing viable body, duplicate a creature, compel an unwilling return, bypass a real planar/soul barrier, clear lethal tracks or repair otherwise lethal persistent afflictions. After successful return, retain Exhaustion6/Expedition6 and enter their protected living-collapse states. Later positive unprevented gain is lethal again; qualifying care and point gates still apply. This candidate remains reviewed for the operational playtest overlay. Known illegal prerequisites prevent activation; a legal cast already paid receives no refund for a later refusal, counter or changed eligibility. Normal RP, Dissonance, Refrain and component rules apply.

**Design decisions:** Core Necromancy rank7, 17RP, Action, 120ft, V/S/F and Instantaneous retained. Class gates remain Cleric/Druid/Wizard13 and Shaman19. NEW provisional design: one target, willingness/body/line requirements, eight-hour elapsed window and1 returned HP. No imported diamond cost or hour-long cast. Reviewed with the healing, life-state and retained lethal-track interface.

<a id="spell-mass-resurrection-denial"></a>

### Mass Resurrection Denial

**ID:** `mass-resurrection-denial` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 120 ft | A fixed 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can perceive within range and line of effect | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** No initial attack or save. Establish the zone; only remains physically inside its area are affected while the spell remains active.

A corpse/remains inside the zone cannot serve as the target or anchor of an effect returning that creature to life. Moving the remains outside removes this spell's block; bringing remains inside while the zone exists subjects them to the block again. Ending concentration or a legal effect capable of dispelling this rank8 spell ends the zone. This spell does not itself damage creatures, animate corpses, bind souls or reverse a resurrection already completed.

**Scaling:** None. The radius, duration and effect do not scale.

**Limits:** Bodyless True Resurrection that uses a legal formation space rather than the blocked remains is not stopped by this corpse-local prohibition alone. No generic dispel or free Counterspell is granted: a remover must already have an operational source that can affect this spell/rank. Normal concentration, costs, Dissonance and Refrain apply. Does not become a permanent resurrection ban after expiry.

**Design decisions:** Core Necromancy rank8, 21RP, Action, 120ft and M/F focus alternative retained; exact class gates stay Cleric/Druid/Wizard15. NEW: 20ft fixed spherical area; concentration up to1minute replaces contradictory Instantaneous metadata because the source describes an ongoing corpse block. Scope and counterplay are explicit provisional decisions. Individually reviewed operational playtest overlay.

### True Resurrection

**ID:** `true-resurrection` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |

Usable remains may be the anchor; otherwise form a viable body in the chosen space. A true name or knowledge of an inferred afterlife-plane location is not required.

Return the one identity to life at1HP, clearing death-save counters and any former Stable recovery deadline. Preserve Wounds, linked persistent consequences, Corruption, Oracle Curse, debts and spent resources. The returned HP is a resurrection state transition, not ordinary healing. Any other remains of this identity lose eligibility to create a second living instance; they remain mundane remains/history evidence as appropriate. No equipment, resources or second creature are created from duplicate remains.

**Scaling:** None. One creature at1HP, with no restored class resources.

**Limits:** An already-living identity is ineligible. A bodyless mode does not bypass an actual soul/identity resurrection block or a source expressly preventing return through a planar barrier. A corpse-local denial alone does not bind the identity. Lethal tracks and persistent afflictions remain; apply their reviewed reconciliation rather than silently removing them. Refusal or a counter after a legal paid activation refunds nothing. Normal spell risk and component rules apply.

<a id="spell-soul-bind"></a>

### Soul Bind

**ID:** `soul-bind` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 120 ft | One living dying creature at0HP you can perceive within range and line of effect; a Dead or Stable creature is ineligible | Pending tether up to1 minute; if target dies while pending, bound identity for24 elapsed hours from that death |

**Resolution:** Target makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC. On success no effect. On failure create a pending Soul Bind tether with an absolute expiry60 seconds after resolution. Target death before that expiry converts it into one soul-bound identity record with expiry24 hours after the death.

Before death, gaining positiveHP or becoming Stable ends the pending tether. After conversion, that identity cannot return by resurrection until the24-hour record ends or a legally capable source removes it. Neither state requires concentration or ends merely because a caster dies/incapacitates. If death begins at or after the pending absolute expiry, conversion does not occur. Only one Soul Bind family record may exist per identity; another failed-save application while still living/dying refreshes to the later pending endpoint without stacked prisons. No post-death recast is legal because the spell targets a living dying creature.

**Scaling:** None. No increased targets, indefinite duration or automatic save failure.

**Limits:** Pending dispel/removal targets the creature. After death, existing remains serve as the local magical anchor for an otherwise eligible dispel/removal; if no remains exist, a source must expressly free the bound identity/soul rather than inventing a physical anchor. A generic cure or under-ranked dispel is not sufficient. The spell grants no commands, ownership, memories, personality change or control over the player. Soul-specific temporal restoration uses its own reviewed interface. Normal costs, Dissonance, Refrain and countering apply.

**Design decisions:** Core Necromancy rank9, 26RP, Action, 120ft, V/S/F and dying-target/resurrection-block purpose retained with Cleric/Druid/Wizard17 access. NEW: Charisma save,1-minute pending/24-hour bound states, no concentration, exact expiry collision, source-family refresh and local removal anchor. These replace the otherwise nonoperational Instantaneous summary with explicit finite aftermath. Wider soul cosmology remains open; individually reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The source specifies an object up to 10 lb within 30 feet but not its displacement distance; moving it up to 30 feet while remaining in range is a NEW provisional specification.

### Minor Enhancement

**ID:** `minor-enhancement` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within range | Until consumed or 1 minute passes |

**Resolution:** None.

Choose Strength or Dexterity when cast. Before the target makes its next ability check using the chosen ability during the duration, it may consume the spell to add +1 to that check.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Must be cast before the check is rolled. Choice of Strength or Dexterity is fixed on cast. Applies to one ability check only, not an attack roll or saving throw. Multiple Minor Enhancement effects do not stack; a new cast replaces the previous one on that creature. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration while the source modifies a future check; the 1-minute-or-consumed duration and before-roll consumption procedure are NEW provisional mechanics.

<a id="spell-mass-polymorph"></a>

### Mass Polymorph

**ID:** `mass-polymorph` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 120 ft | Up to 10 distinct physical creatures you can perceive within 120 feet | Concentration, up to 1 minute; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns |

**Resolution:** Before payment choose 1-10 targets and one legal R4 spell-form profile for each, validating each possible anatomy's space. Willing targets may waive saves. Each unwilling target independently makes a Constitution save. Failure creates that target's transformation link. Each hostile transformed target repeats the save at its original regular-turn end and once per numbered round after positive actual HP damage. Success ends only that target's link. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath. Before payment validate O/O, O/T, T/O and T/T footprint compatibility for every pair of targets; saves resolve independently and successful anatomy changes apply simultaneously.

Each failed/waived target gains exactly one selected R4 anatomy while retaining its own identity, current/max HP, temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, attributes, proficiency, resources, initiative and condition clocks. Each target's supplied natural attack uses the original caster's current spell attack bonus and M. All transformed targets share one concentration record but otherwise resolve their own transformation endings independently.

**Scaling:** Exactly up to 10 creatures. No generic three-target cap and no automatic access to the R9-only greater/elemental profiles.

**Limits:** Casting range and line of effect are checked only when the spell is committed; there is no ongoing range tether. One target ending does not end another. Concentration ending removes every remaining target transformation. No target gains monster stat blocks, multiattack, resources, class features or a second HP pool. Equipment/anatomy, natural-attack taxonomy, damage/reversion and agency follow the shared spell-transformation chassis. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Mass Polymorph identity, Transmutation Rank 9, Druid/Mage/Wizard level-17 access, Action, 120 feet, V/S/F, base 26 RP and explicit up-to-10-creature scope. NEW: one-minute concentration, preselected per-target R4 profiles, independent saves/endings, no ongoing tether and shared same-body transformation rules.

| Eligible class | Rank | Earliest class level | Base RP |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Druid | 9 | 17 | 26 |
| Mage | 9 | 17 | 26 |
| Wizard | 9 | 17 | 26 |

Listed RP is before Dissonance surcharge. Resonance Shield includes its explicit 1 RP conversion cost; other cantrips have base cost 0. All casts still obey Refrain.

<a id="spell-shapechange"></a>

### Shapechange

**ID:** `shapechange` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | Self | Concentration, up to 1 minute; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns |

**Resolution:** Choose one legal R4 or R9 spell-form profile on cast. No save. Once on each of your original regular turns afterward, you may use a Bonus Action to switch to a different legal profile. The new anatomy must fit the available space. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath. No internal switch on the casting turn or an extra turn; first switch is the next original regular turn, then at most one on each later original regular turn.

You retain your identity, current/max HP, temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, attributes, proficiency, resources, initiative and existing effects. Only your current anatomy/profile changes. Each supplied natural attack uses your current spell attack bonus and M. Profile switching does not create a new body, heal, refresh resources, restore temporary HP or reset rest/recharge uses.

**Scaling:** No automatic scaling beyond the bounded R4+R9 profile register.

**Limits:** Only one Shapechange anatomy exists at a time. An identical-profile switch is rejected before Bonus Action payment. Internal switches are not spell casts and do not create new Dissonance or Refrain events. Equipment remains melded through switches. Losing flight while unsupported begins ordinary falling. Actual 0 HP, death or Incapacitated after same-packet prevention ends Shapechange without healing. The spell grants no Druid Buffer Reserve, Form Surge, Shapeshift use or Druid form features. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Shapechange identity, Rank 9, Druid/Mage/Wizard access and class-specific schools, Action, source 120-foot metadata, V/S/F, base 26 RP, and the core concept of changing creature form each round. NEW: operational target narrowed to Self, one-minute concentration, Bonus Action once-per-original-regular-turn switching, finite R4/R9 profiles and same-body state rules. The original 120-foot source field remains preserved in provenance despite the self-target operational narrowing.

<a id="spell-true-polymorph"></a>

### True Polymorph

**ID:** `true-polymorph` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 120 ft | One eligible physical creature or one eligible discrete nonmagical unattended object within 120 feet | Concentration during a 1-minute shaping period; if maintained for the full minute, the transformation persists until dispelled without further concentration; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns |

**Resolution:** Choose creature-to-creature, willing-creature-to-object, object-to-creature, or object-to-object before payment. Creature-to-creature may affect an unwilling target on a failed Constitution save; while shaping, that target repeats the save at each original regular end and once per numbered round after positive actual HP damage. Creature-to-object requires willingness. Objects make no save. If concentration survives the full shaping minute, the result becomes persistent until dispelled. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath.

Creature transformations retain one identity and one HP/durability history. Creature-to-creature uses any legal R4 or R9 spell-form profile. Creature-to-object creates one inert mundane object anatomy without healing or a new durability pool. Object-to-creature uses the object's existing structural HP as its one durability ledger and creates a controlled no-soul companion using an eligible non-humanoid R4/R9 profile and the caster's snapshotted spell statistics. Object-to-object changes only mundane form/material within the bounded utility restrictions.

**Scaling:** No automatic scaling. Permanent attack/DC values supplied by this spell snapshot the original caster's spell attack, spell DC and M when cast. Snapshot PB and source class as well. All True Polymorph supplied attack/DC values use this snapshot from casting, including shaping.

**Limits:** No mode creates XP, loot, a soul, resurrection entitlement, valuable material, consumable stock, ammunition, currency, medicine, food or magical properties. Carried, worn, attuned, magical, artifact, structural-terrain and undefined-durability objects are ineligible. Object-origin creatures cannot receive ordinary HP healing as a means of repairing their source object. Only one active object-origin True Polymorph creature per caster is permitted. Such a creature shares the owner's companion Bonus Action/offensive budget and gains no independent turn/resources. Permanent True Polymorph does not end at 0 HP merely to restore the original form. Death/destruction remains real; later dispelling changes anatomy only and never heals, resurrects or recreates missing matter. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted. Object origin and earliest physical identity persist through every transformation chain. Object-origin creatures never gain a humanoid profile, soul, ordinary healing, resurrection or biological/class/rest resources. Use one actual structural HP ledger; structural0 destroys the object and ends its creature manifestation. Creature-origin object anatomy is actionless, not automatically Incapacitated. Allowed object templates are barrier/slab, ramp/wedge, open-container, static-furniture or simple-one-piece-tool; no actuated mechanism, magical or valuable output. Output size Tiny..Large and within one category of input; output mass cannot exceed recorded input or earliest origin mass; value cannot exceed original documented ceiling. Corpses/remains, magical/attuned/carried/worn/attended/structural objects and undefined structural durability are ineligible. An object-creature reserves its original caster slot on successful shaping; suppression/control change never frees it. At the60-second boundary finish damage, resolve due repeat save, then stabilize only surviving links. Replacing an active True object anatomy requires legal True replacement, not fresh nonmagical/unattended outside-object admission. Creature-origin people retain their CON save against unwilling creature-profile recasts and must consent to object-profile recasts. Returning them to creature anatomy grants no companion slot.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: True Polymorph identity, Rank 9, exact class access/schools, Action, 120 feet, V/S/F, base 26 RP, creature/object scope and meaningful until-dispelled permanence. NEW: one-minute shaping/stabilization procedure, save/agency rules, bounded form register, object eligibility/size/value rules, object-origin companion contract, one controlled-object-creature cap, durability conservation and destruction/dispel semantics.

### Mage Light

**ID:** `mage-light` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One unoccupied point you can perceive within range | 1 hour |

**Resolution:** None.

Create one floating orb of harmless visible light at the chosen fixed point. It illuminates a 20-foot radius sufficiently for ordinary visual perception.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** You may have only one Mage Light orb active at a time; recasting ends the previous one. The orb is stationary after creation, creates no heat or damage, cannot blind, reveal invisibility by itself, ignite objects, trigger solar/light vulnerabilities unless they explicitly react to ordinary light, or serve as a physical object. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, 1-hour duration, and V/S components are retained. The source gives no illumination radius or movement procedure; a fixed 20-foot illumination radius and one-orb cap are NEW provisional mechanics.

### Message

**ID:** `message` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 120 ft | One creature you can perceive within range | Instantaneous |

**Resolution:** None.

Transmit one brief whispered message that could ordinarily be spoken during one Action directly to the target, so only it clearly hears the magical whisper.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The spell does not grant a reply, language comprehension, mind reading, command authority, guaranteed identity verification, communication through total cover or an effect explicitly blocking magical communication, or transmission across planes. The target hears the actual words used and may respond only through ordinary means. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 120-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The 25-word cap, direct-hearing procedure, and no-reply boundary are NEW provisional mechanics because the source only says to whisper to a creature within 120 feet. Conference correction: remove unsupported25-word limit; one Action bounds ordinary speech.

### Arcane Lock

**ID:** `arcane-lock` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One nonliving door, lid, gate, chest, container, hatch, or comparable closable object you can perceive within range | 8 hours |

**Resolution:** None on casting. A creature attempting to force or manipulate the secured closure without your permission makes a Strength or appropriate tool check against your spell save DC.

Magically secure the target closure for 8 hours. You may designate up to 3 creatures when casting that can open or close it normally. Other creatures must succeed on the required check to open it; a successful check suppresses the lock long enough for that opening but does not end the spell.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Does not make the object indestructible, repair it, increase its HP, prevent teleportation through unrelated magic, seal an open passage without a closable object, create a new physical lock, or protect against effects that explicitly dispel or bypass magical wards. One object cannot benefit from multiple Arcane Locks from the same caster. Source placements disagree on rank/RP; those are derived externally and not resolved here.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 consistently gives Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and an Instantaneous metadata duration, while the source requires an ongoing magical lock. An 8-hour duration, authorized-creature list, and force/tool check against Spell DC are NEW provisional mechanics. The three source rank placements remain preserved externally.

### Alarm

**ID:** `alarm` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One fixed 10-foot-radius ground area centered on a point you can perceive within range; choose up to 3 creatures when cast that will not trigger it | 8 hours or until you cast Alarm again |

**Resolution:** None.

Ward the chosen area against intrusion. The first time each round a Tiny-or-larger creature not excluded when cast enters the area, the spell produces a brief magical alarm audible to you and creatures within 60 feet of the ward.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** Only one Alarm from this spell may be active for you at a time; recasting ends the previous Alarm. It reports entry only, not identity, intent, alignment, statistics, exact route, or concealed facts. A creature already inside when the spell is cast does not trigger it until it leaves and re-enters. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S/F components are retained. Core says Instantaneous while the source requires a continuing alarm; 8-hour duration, 10-foot radius, exclusion list, audible trigger, and one-active-alarm cap are NEW provisional specifications.

<a id="spell-unseen-servant"></a>

### Unseen Servant

**ID:** `unseen-servant` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; creates one invisible noncombat helper force | 1 hour |

**Resolution:** None.

Create an invisible force that can move at Speed 30 feet and perform simple mundane tasks you could direct an unskilled helper to perform, such as carrying up to 10 pounds, opening an unlocked door, fetching an unattended object, sweeping, cleaning, arranging mundane items, holding a light object, or operating a simple harmless mechanism. It obeys simple instructions while within 60 feet and able to receive your verbal directions. Giving or changing an instruction in combat uses your Bonus Action and shares the companion command budget; it performs at most one simple noncombat object interaction on that turn. It cannot make attacks or grant the Help action. The servant has a notional location but occupies no space, blocks no movement and provides no cover. It performs its commanded interaction only on an object within 5 feet of that location.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** The servant is not a combat creature and cannot attack, deal damage, impose conditions, provide flanking, make skill checks requiring proficiency or judgment, use weapons, traps, bombs, poisons, healing items, spell items, or other combat consumables, activate class abilities, cast spells, create commodities, perform paid labor that generates free wages or economic output, craft valuable goods, carry creatures, trigger resource/death effects, or serve as physical cover. It cannot manipulate attended objects against resistance. You may maintain only one Unseen Servant at a time. It has no corporeal HP or body and cannot intercept damage; it can be ended by an effect explicitly dispelling or suppressing the sustaining spell. Recasting replaces it and pays the full RP cost.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S/F components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration despite creating an ongoing helper. One-hour duration, Speed 30, 10-pound carrying limit, 60-foot command range, and explicit noncombat-helper boundaries are NEW provisional mechanics. A combat command costs the shared Bonus Action; one harmless interaction per command prevents unpriced parallel combat activity.

<a id="spell-find-familiar"></a>

### Find Familiar

**ID:** `find-familiar` · **Concentration:** yes · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 30 ft | One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Small spirit familiar | Concentration, up to 1 minute |

**Resolution:** No initial roll. The familiar's commanded attack uses your spell attack bonus.

Summon one Small spirit familiar using the shared standard companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP equal to 2 times your class level, Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, and one melee or ranged attack with 5-foot reach or 30-foot range using your spell attack bonus and dealing S d6 damage of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage (choose one type and melee or ranged mode on casting; keep them fixed for that summon). It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command it to move and make its one attack or take another basic action; without a command it may move and Dodge.

**Scaling:** Uses the shared companion profile: AC increases with PB, HP equals 2×class level, and attack damage is S d6 at class levels 1/5/11/17.

**Limits:** All companions you own share one Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action total per round. The familiar gains no unstated flight, invisibility, telepathy, special senses, resistances, immunities, spell delivery, independent spellcasting, Help-based automatic advantage, loot, wages, corpse, resource generation, death trigger, or free resummon benefit. It disappears at 0 HP or when concentration ends. Recasting replaces your prior familiar from this spell. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

**Design decisions:** Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. The source provides no specific familiar statistics, so the existing shared standard-companion profile is used rather than importing another game's familiar block. Command range/perception and anti-loop limits follow the current playtest companion interface.

<a id="spell-harmonic-bulwark"></a>

### Harmonic Bulwark

**ID:** `harmonic-bulwark` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 60 ft | One willing creature you can perceive within 60 feet | Cast instantaneous; accepted temporary HP last until depleted, replaced, or the recipient completes a long rest |

**Resolution:** Automatic after legal payment; temporary-HP strongest-only arbitration then applies.

The chosen willing recipient receives a temporary-HP offer equal to 5 times credited RP. Credited RP is actual base RP paid after exact legal base-cost reductions plus chosen additional X from0..PB. X cannot be discounted. Ordinary surcharges never count toward credited RP. Use canonical ordinary-cast pricing; Refrain changes post-cast Dissonance and is not a new RP surcharge.

**Scaling:** 5 temporary HP per credited RP. Additional conversion RP X is capped by proficiency bonus and must actually be paid.

**Limits:** Additional conversion RP cannot itself be discounted. Payment occurs before nonstack arbitration and is not refunded when a stronger or equal shield remains. A cast with zero credited RP is illegal. Free casts/copies that spend no credited RP create no fresh Harmonic Bulwark shield unless their own exact copy rule expressly copies an already-resolved temporary-HP event. Temporary HP are not healing and use the canonical one-active-buffer rule. Choose X before commitment. Commit Action plus quoted casting payment plus X before countering or arbitration; no post-commit refund. A countered spell offers nothing.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED: Harmonic Bulwark identity, Universal Rank 3, class access/learn levels/base 5 RP, and 5 temporary HP per RP source wording. NEW: Action, 60-foot range, one willing target, V/S/F components, PB cap on discretionary RP, exact credited-RP accounting, and V6-default shield lifetime. Action/range/components resemble the unproven Mana Shield candidate but are adopted only as provisional Harmonic Bulwark design choices; the alias is not treated as source identity.

<a id="spell-vampiric-touch"></a>

### Vampiric Touch

**ID:** `vampiric-touch` · **Concentration:** no · **Components:** V, S, F

| Activation | Range | Targets | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Action | 0 ft | One creature in actual touch reach; no creature-type exclusion is added. | Instantaneous. |

**Resolution:** One melee spell attack against AC: hit 3d6 necrotic; miss no damage or healing.

After damage resolves, heal yourself floor(actualDamageDealt / 2), once from that attack packet. Use eligible final recipient branches under damage sharing without counting the unsplit parent or overkill. Ordinary healing modifiers, prohibitions and caps apply; actual target defenses determine damage, including for Undead/Constructs. The healing is one secondary result and cannot reproduce this attack or create a second Vampiric Touch heal for the same cast. It grants no continuing repeat-attack permission or concentration. Unrelated eligible triggers retain their own restrictions.

**Scaling:** None.

**Limits:** No automatic level scaling, generic upcast or new action budget. Use the actual casting source's access, components, costs, shared concentration and Dissonance/Refrain, then the legal interruption window. Countering or later failure refunds no committed use/payment or displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual source casting modifier; saves use DC 8 + PB + that modifier. Actual defenses, critical rules, core conditions, ordinary life-state rules and source-specific callbacks retain their scopes. Total cover prevents targeting unless this card expressly allows otherwise. For ancestry casts use ANCESTRY_BACKGROUND_PLAYTEST.md; existing ordinary identities retain their actual class/school/rank access and RP price.

**Design decisions:** PRESERVED existing catalog/Core identity, source placement, action, range and components. Explicit operational additions are conference decisions.

| Eligible class | Rank | Earliest class level | Base RP |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Cleric | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Crimson Agent | 3 | 8 | 5 |
| Druid | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Shaman | 3 | 7 | 5 |
| Thief | 3 | 13 | 5 |
| Wizard | 3 | 5 | 5 |

Listed RP is before Dissonance surcharge. Resonance Shield includes its explicit 1 RP conversion cost; other cantrips have base cost 0. All casts still obey Refrain.
